Title: Penjelasan Gubernur Bank Indonesia Pada Rapat Kerja Komisi XI-DPR RI Terkait Perlindungan Nasabah Di Bidang Perbankan
text: EXPLANATION OF THE GOVERNOR OF BANK INDONESIA AT THE RELEVANT WORKING MEETING OF COMMISSION XI-DPR RI CUSTOMER PROTECTION IN THE BANKING SECTOR Dear Chairman and Board Members, Assalaamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh, Sela mat ma lam and saiam prosper for all of us. First of all, let me thank the Chairman of Commission XI and the honourable Members of the Board, who have invited us to attend the Working Meeting today, with the main agenda of the issues surrounding the Banking Customer Protection related to the case of breach of bank customer funds and collection of credit cards by debt collectors. Let me introduce the one who accompanied me, Mr. S.Budi Rochadi, Deputy Governor in charge of payment systems and Mr. Halim Alamsyah, Deputy Governor in charge of banking supervision. Before explaining, we would like to express our deep condolences to the families of the victims, of course there are other parties who know better about the actual incident, but the fact is that there are who leftbehind and we should have our condolences. Regarding the internal control system of banks and the bank supervision system by Bank Indonesia, it will be explained by bpk. Halim Alamsyah, I will present a broader picture. Dear Chairman and Board Member. 1. Banking is an industry where most of the sources of funds come from the public and is an industry that relies on the trust base of the public / customers. In this regard , to provide protection to customers, Bank Indonesiais very concerned with prudential regulation and strict supervision of the banking industry. We always direct and regulate national banks to have strong and layered internal control as an adequate line of defense guna oversee all bank activities against various risks and potential leaks that can occur. 2. The strengthening of internal control is achieved through the issuance of BI provisions on Good Corporate Governance (GCG), Risk Management, Internal Control System, Anti-Money Laundering, APMK ( Card-Based Payment Instruments) and Increasing the effectiveness of the Internal Audit Task Force. 3. Furthermore, to improve the strengthening of protection for customers, we provide mechanisms for Banking Mediation, Customer Complaints, and Transparency of Customer Information &use of Personal Data. 4. Bank Indonesia also conducts regular supervision/inspection based on sampling and follows up with investigative examinations in the event of suspected pidana acts in the banking sector. Nevertheless, even though various precautionary signs have been posted and various efforts to protect the interests of customers have been made to the fullest, once again the first line of defense remains is in the hands of the bank. 5. We record and study a lot in various cases wherever the place is, no matter how strong the internal control will be ineffective or reduced in effectiveness if there is collusion. Especially the breach of customer funds and the case of credit card collection by debt collectors experienced by Citibank, save us, this can happen anywhere, in Indonesia or in other countries. But for us, it remains a record of our serious concern to be resolved at this time and prevented in the future. 6. In relation to the case of breach of Citibank customer funds , we note that there are allegations of abuse of authority of officers banks, weaknesses in the implementation of the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) in addition to the element of negligence and lack of customer prudence. Some of the weaknesses in the implementation of the SOP in question include; non-checking and rechecking of transaction handling, lack of supervision by supervisors of subordinates, lack of strict internal supervision system of citigold operational activities, which in terms of privacy, it has service advantages as well as having a node of vulnerability to misappropriation by bank officers. 7. Meanwhile , the element of negligence and lack of care of the customer is reflected in vulnerable practices such as: the customer leaves a blank (form transfer/book transfer/cash withdrawal) that he has signed to the bank officer, the practice of giving the ATM PIN password to the bank officer. Such non-prudent practices create opportunities and even temptations for bank officers to make transactions for the benefit of bank officers. 8. Regarding the death of Citibank credit card customers associated with collection by debt collectors, we will continue to follow the development of the research carefully and in more depth. 9. Specifically contained in the provisions of PBI and SE BI concerning the Implementation of Card-based Payment Instrument Activities (APMK) has explained the basic principles of credit card debt collection activities, the implementation of which must not conflict with applicable legal regulations. The purpose of this principle is that it must not conflict with the rules of the Criminal Code and Human Rights which clearly prohibit the practice of violence, threats, and other inappropriate treatment in negotiateiasi. 10. Further to the same provisions it is clearly regulated which is the essence that although the bank hands over the implementation of credit card collection to a third party (in this case the Debt Collector), it is necessary contained in its cooperation agreement - clause g of the Publisher's responsibility for any legal consequences arising from the cooperation with such other party. 11. Against the 2 (two) cases that occurred at Citibank, we have been and are following up with coaching steps before this case comes to theface of the mass media. And will continue more in-depth research, so that it can be known the cause of the disaster, settlement and as one of the input materials in determining coaching actions and improvement of forward settings. 12. Of course, learning from these and other similar cases, we will take steps to review and will tighten the rules related to protection to customers, especially activities private banking or excellent service activities, debt collection services, and tightening rules and restrictions (maximum) card extraction kred it. 13. We expect various parties to re-strengthen their roles and functions, from bank supervision by Bank Indonesia, banks to customer participation. As a bank supervisor, Bank Indonesia will conduct more in-depth supervision of banking activities based on the principles of Risk Based Supervision (RBS), including matters that touch customer protection in depth. 14. In terms of bank operational management, bank management is required to improve the strengthening and discipline of adequate and continuous internal control monitoring in accordance with applicable regulations and regulations. Banks are also asked to be responsible for educating customers in order to increase understanding and prudence of the products offered. 15. We, Bank Indonesia will invite banks to make more intensive educational efforts to increase the awareness and participation of bank customers so that customers better understand banking products/services as well as risks in it so that it is expected to encourage customer participation in the prevention and supervision of fraud. 16. Considering the various events and problems related to Debt Collectors, we see, ha I is not only related to the need for limited regulation in the banking industry but more broadly to other financial institution industries. This regulatory initiative is important because it not only transports customer protection widely, but also the need to provide the order and rules of the game related to practices the use of debt collector services in the collection of receivables in this country. Therefore, we consider the need for clarity on the existence of the authority that initiated the institutionalization of the rule in the form of an Act as regulated in various countries such as the United States and Australhe. In our opinion, this needs to be an important agenda of the Government and the Honourable Councillors going forward. Dear Chairman and Board Members, Finally, in line with efforts to realize good governance and in order to continuously encourage the improvement of protection of customers, it is our hope that the input and advice of Board Members, to strengthen and complement the efforts that have been made so far. Jakarta, April 2011 Darmin Nasution
text_original: PENJELASAN GUBERNUR BANK INDONESIA PADA RAPAT KERJA KOMISI XI-DPR RI TERKAIT PERLINDUNGAN NASABAH DI BIDANG PERBANKAN Pimpinan dan Anggota Dewan yang terhormat, Assalaamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh, Sela mat ma lam dan saiam sejahtera bagi kita semua. Pertama-tama, perkenankan saya mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Pimpinan Komisi XI dan Anggota Dewan yang terhormat, yang telah mengundang kami untuk menghadiri Rapat Kerja pada hari ini, dengan agenda utama permasalahan sekitar Perlindungan Nasabah Perbankan terkait kasus pembobolan dana nasabah bank dan penagihan kartu kredit oleh debt collector. Perkenankan saya memperkenalkan yang mendampingi saya, Bpk. S. Budi Rochadi, Deputi Gubernur yang membidangi sistem pembayaran dan Bpk Halim Alamsyah, Deputi Gubernur yang membidangi pengawasan perbankan. Sebelum memaparkan, kami ingin menyampaikan belasungkawa yang mendalam kepada pihak keluarga korban, tentunya ada pihak-pihak lain yang lebih tau mengenai kejadian sebenarnya, namun faktanya ada yang meninggal dan kita patut berbelasungkawa. Mengenai sistem pengendalian internal bank dan sistem pengawasan bank oleh Bank Indonesia akan dijelaskan oleh Bpk. Halim Alamsyah, saya akan memaparkan gambaran yang lebih luas. Pimpinan dan Anggota Dewan yang terhormat. 1. Perbankan adalah industri yang sebagian besar sumber dananya berasal dari masyarakat dan merupakan industri yang mengandalkan basis kepercayaan masyarakat/nasabah. Berkenaan dengan itu, untuk memberikan perlindungan kepada nasabah, Bank Indonesia sangat concern dengan pengaturan kehati-hatian dan pengawasan yang ketat terhadap industri perbankan. Kami senantiasa mengarahkan dan mengatur perbankan nasional agar memiliki internal control yang kuat dan berlapis sebagai line of defense yang memadai guna mengawal seluruh kegiatan bank terhadap berbagai risiko dan potensi kebocoran yang dapat terjadi. 2. Penguatan internal control tersebut ditempuh melalui penerbitan ketentuan BI tentang Good Corporate Governance (GCG), Manajemen Resiko, Sistem Pengendalian Internal, Anti Money Laundering, APMK (Alat Pembayaran Menggunakan Kartu) dan Peningkatan efektivitas Satuan Kerja Audit Internal. 3. Lebih lanjut untuk meningkatkan penguatan perlindungan terhadap nasabah, kami menyediakan mekanisme Mediasi Perbankan, Pengaduan Nasabah, dan Transparansi Informasi & Penggunaan Data Pribadi Nasabah. 4. Bank Indonesia juga melaksanakan pengawasan/pemeriksaan secara berkala berdasarkan sampling dan menindaklanjuti dengan pemeriksaan investigasi dalam hal terjadi dugaan tindak pidana di bidang perbankan. Namun demikian, sungguhpun telah dipasang berbagai rambu-rambu kehati-hatian dan berbagai upaya untuk melindungi kepentingan nasabah telah dilakukan secara maksimal, sekali lagi first line of defense tetap berada ditangan bank. 5. Kami banyak mencatat dan mempelajari dalam berbagai kasus dimanapun tempatnya, sekuat apapun internal control akan menjadi tidak efektif atau berkurang efektivitasnya bila terdapat kolusi. Khususnya pembobolan dana nasabah dan kasus penagihan kartu kredit oleh debt collector yang dialami Citibank, hemat kami, hal tersebut dapat terjadi dimana saja, di Indonesia ataupun di negara lain. Namun bagi kami, tetap menjadi catatan perhatian serius kami untuk diselesaikan saat ini dan dicegah di masa datang. 6. Terkait dengan kasus pembobolan dana nasabah Citibank, kami mencatat adanya dugaan penyalahgunaan wewenang petugas bank, kelemahan pelaksanaan Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) disamping unsur kelalaian dan kurangnya kehati-hatian nasabah. Beberapa kelemahan pelaksanaan SOP dimaksud antara lain; tidak dilakukannya check dan recheck terhadap penanganan transaksi, kurangnya Pengawasan oleh supervisor terhadap bawahan, kurang ketatnya sistem pengawasan internal terhadap kegiatan operasional citigold, yang dari sisi privacy memiliki keunggulan pelayanan sekaligus memiliki simpul kerawanan penyelewengan oleh petugas bank. 7. Sedangkan unsur kelalaian dan kekuranghati-hatian nasabah tersebut, tercermin dari praktek-praktek yang rawan seperti: nasabah menitipkan blanko kosong (formulir transfer/pemindahbukuan/tarik tunai) yang telah ditandatanganinya kepada petugas bank, praktek memberikan password PIN ATM kepada petugas bank. Praktek-praktek yang tidak prudent tersebut menciptakan peluang bahkan godaan terhadap petugas bank melakukan transaksi untuk manfaat petugas bank. 8. Terkait dengan peristiwa meninggalnya nasabah kartu kredit Citibank yang dihubungkan dengan penagihan oleh debt collector, kami akan tetap mengikuti perkembangan penelitian secara seksama dan lebih mendalam. 9. Secara spesifik termuat ketentuan PBI dan SE BI tentang Penyelenggaraan Kegiatan Alat Pembayaran Dengan menggunakan Kartu (APMK) telah dijelaskan prinsip-prinsip dasar kegiatan penagihan hutang kartu kredit, yang pelaksanaannya tidak boleh bertentangan dengan peraturan hukum yang berlaku. Maksud dari prinsip ini adalah tidak boleh bertentangan dengan aturan KUH Pidana dan HAM yang dengan jelas melarang praktek kekerasan, ancaman, dan perlakuan tidak pantas lainnya dalam bernegosiasi. 10. Lebih lanjut pada ketentuan yang sama diatur secara jelas yang intinya bahwa meskipun bank menyerahkan pelaksanaan penagihan kartu kredit kepada pihak ketiga (dalam hal ini Debt Collector), perlu dimuat dalam perjanjian kerjasamanya - klausula tentang tanggung jawab Penerbit terhadap segala akibat hukum yang timbul dari kerjasama dengan pihak lain tersebut. 11. Terhadap 2 (dua) kasus yang terjadi pada Citibank tersebut, kami telah dan sedang menindaklanjuti dengan langkah pembinaan sebelum kasus ini mengemuka di media masa. Dan tetap akan melanjutkan penelitian yang lebih mendalam, agar dapat diketahui sebab musabab, penyelesaian dan sebagai salah satu bahan masukan dalam menetapkan tindakan pembinaan dan penyempurnaan pengaturan ke depan. 12. Tentu belajar dari kasus tersebut dan kasus-kasus serupa lainnya, kami akan melakukan langkah-langkah untuk mereview kembali dan akan mengetatkan aturan terkait dengan perlindungan kepada nasabah khususnya kegiatan private banking atau kegiatan pelayanan nasabah prima, Jasa penagihan hutang, dan aturan pengetatan dan pembatasan (maksimum) pemiiikan Kartu kred it. 13. Kami mengharapkan berbagai pihak menguatkan kembali peran dan fungsinya, dari pengawasan bank oleh bank Indonesia, bank hingga partisipasi nasabah. Sebagai pengawas bank, Bank Indonesia akan melakukan pengawasan lebih mendalam terhadap kegiatan perbankan berdasarkan prinsip-prinsip pengawasan berbasis risiko {Risk Based Supervision /RBS), termasuk hal-hal yang menyentuh perlindungan nasabah secara lebih mendalam. 14. Dari sisi pengelolaan operasional bank, manajemen bank dituntut untuk meningkatkan penguatan dan disiplin pemantauan internal control yang memadai dan berkelanjutan sesuai dengan peraturan dan ketentuan yang berlaku. Bank juga diminta untuk bertanggungjawab melakukan edukasi terhadap nasabah agar meningkatkan pemahaman dan kehati-hatian atas produk-produk yang ditawarkan. 15. Kami, Bank Indonesia akan mengajak perbankan melakukan upaya edukasi yang lebih intensif untuk meningkatkan kepeduiian dan partisipasi nasabah bank agar nasabah lebih memahami produk/layanan perbankan sekaligus risiko di dalamnya sehingga diharapkan dapat mendorong partisipasi nasabah dalam pencegahan dan pengawasan terjadinya fraud. 16. Menimbang berbagai kejadian dan permasalahan terkait dengan Debt Collector, kami melihat, ha I ini tidak saja terkait perlunya pengaturan terbatas pada industri perbankan namun lebih luas lagi hingga industri lembaga keuangan lainnya. Inisiatif pengaturan ini menjadi penting karena tidak saja menyangkut perlindungan nasabah secara luas, namun juga perlunya menyediakan tatanan dan aturan main terkait dengan praktek-praktek penggunaan jasa debt collector dalam penagihan piutang di negeri ini. Oleh karenanya, kami memandang perlunya kejelasan keberadaan otoritas yang berinisiasi melembagakan aturan tersebut dalam bentuk Undang-Undang sebagaimana diatur di berbagai negara seperti Amerika Serikat dan Australia. Hemat kami, hal ini perlu menjadi agenda penting Pemerintah dan Anggota Dewan Yang Terhormat ke depan. Pimpinan dan Anggota Dewan yang terhormat, Akhirnya, sejalan dengan upaya untuk mewujudkan good governance dan dalam rangka senantiasa mendorong peningkatan perlindungan terhadap nasabah, besar harapan kami agar kiranya masukan dan saran Anggota Dewan, untuk memperkuat dan melengkapi upaya-upaya yang telah dilakukan selama ini. Jakarta, April 2011 Darmin Nasution

Title: Pidato Deputi Gubernur, S. Budi Rochadi pada Penutupan Kongres Perbanas dan APCONEX 2009
text: BANK INDONESIA REMARKS BY THE DEPUTY GOVERNOR OF BANK INDONESIA Closing the Congress of Perbanas and APCONEX 2009, Jakarta, May 15, 2009 Dear, - Sdr. Sigit Pramono, Chairman of Perbanas, Sdr. Jos Luhukay, Apconex Steering Committee 2009 - Members of Perbanas, Asbanda and Perbarindo - Happy attendees and invitees, Assalamu'alaikum wr. Wb. Peace be upon us all, Let us give thanks to the presence of Lllahi Robbi because we were able to gather today to attend the closing ceremony of the XVII and Apconex 2009 Perbanas Congress as well as the inauguration of the Chairman of Perbanas for the period 2009-2012. This inauguration is a symbolic representation of the forwarding of the mandate to the new board of directors that has an important meaning that is worth pondering and living. The mandate to consistently and continuously try to give the meaning of his and his organization's service in achieving the benefit of the community. For that, I congratulate the newly inaugurated Chairman of Perbanas. In its 53rd year, Perbanas has long played a role in the development of the national banking industry. It is not an exaggeration if we hope that in this special way, bankers can redefine their commitment to optimize the role of banks as intermediation institutions while still paying attention to strengthening the resilience of the national banking industry in order to support sustainable economic growth and at the same time prepare themselves to face future challenges. Ladies and Gentlemen and Happy Attendees, As we all know, our macroeconomic conditions are experiencing challenges that are not light. The impact of the global financial crisis in the form of tight money market liquidity, pressures on the capital market and economic recession, in a short period of time has reduced the performance of the global economy which in turn has also castrated our nation's efforts to increase economic growth in a better direction. The economic growth target that was originally set in the range of 4-5% should be adjusted to 3-4%. This adjustment is carried out with one of the considerations of the assumption of a source of financing for bank loans, which if the realization of growth can be in accordance with the proposed business plan of 15%, then economic growth is expected to reach the upper limit of the set projection. Although in general, Indonesian banks, whose business characteristics are still largely conventional, were able to survive and be protected from the effects of financial propagation in developed countries, the development of performance until the first quarter of 2009 showed a less than encouraging role in intermediation. In March 2009, credit placements decreased by 0.9% to Rpl.342 trillion compared to the end of December 2008. The low credit growth during 2009 was followed by an increase in bank plantings in SBI by 25% so that it was at a position of Rp208 trillion, with the preference for bank planting in longer tenor SBI. If this trend continues, it is feared that it may complicate the realization of credit growth as expected. Low lending needs to be a concern and one of Perbanas' main agendas in formulating service commitments, considering the role and existence of banks as intermediation institutions and catalysts for sustainable economic growth. Ladies and Gentlemen and Happy Attendees, From the financial crisis that occurred, we can also take valuable lessons for the Indonesian financial market, especially banks, about the importance of efforts to identify various risks that may be contained in transactions and financial product innovations that are developing so rapidly. The development of the global financial system, which moves in line with rapid technological and information innovation, has implications for changes in behavior and integration in the financial system, especially in terms of risk management and transfer. Transaction innovation and financial products consisting of various derivatives are no longer solely based on an underlying transaction in the real sector, which Mr. Jusf Kalla calls ''Stealth Economics". Basically, product innovation and derivative transactions do not always have a negative impact. A well-developed derivative transaction may indicate the maturity of a financial market, which has a role as a mediator and catalyst for economic growth through the acceleration of fund turnover in supporting the needs of economic transactions. What should be considered is that there is a need for an ability to identify risks and the existence of transparency mechanisms for existing products or transactions related to the benefits, costs and risks contained so that we can still empower the benefits by minimizing their negative impacts. Ladies and Gentlemen and Happy Attendees, For Bank Indonesia, the implication of rapid changes in the financial sector, which always contains "risks", is that the achievement of macroeconomic stability is not only focused on price stability, but also related to financial system stability. In terms of monetary policy, changes in the economic environment that raise the role of financial stability in influencing macroeconomic stability have implications for the need for monetary policy formulation that takes into account the role and dynamics of the financial system with all its risks. In terms of banking policy, changes in global financial system behavior require more detailed banking policy arrangements directed at efforts to manage financial system behavior that is procyclical to the economic cycle. Some policies need to be implemented dynamically following the economic cycle as countercyclical measures in the banking sector. Mr. Ladies and Gentlemen who are Happy. That's all I can say. Hopefully, with the new chairman of Perbanas, more creative and constructive thinking can beborn to further increase the contribution of the role of banking as a lubricant for the wheels of the economy in order to grow as expected. Hopefully, Perbanas can increasingly become a professional group that has an important role and is needed by the nation and state. Finally, I once again congratulate the New Chairman of Perbanas and the board. May God Almighty always protect our every step. That's it and thank you. Wassalaamu'alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh. Jakarta, 15th May 2009 BANK INDONESIA S. Budi Rochadi Deputy Governor
text_original: BANK INDONESIA SAMBUTAN DEPUTI GUBERNUR BANK INDONESIA Penutupan Kongres Perbanas dan APCONEX 2009, Jakarta, 15 Mei 2009 Yang Terhormat, - Sdr. Sigit Pramono, Ketua Umum Perbanas, Sdr. Jos Luhukay, Panitia Pengarah Apconex 2009 - Para anggota Perbanas, Asbanda dan Perbarindo - Hadirin dan undangan yang berbahagia, Assalamu'alaikum wr. wb. Salam sejahtera untuk kita semua, Marilah kita panjatkan syukur ke hadirat lllahi Robbi karena kita dapat berkumpul pada hari ini menghadiri acara penutupan Kongres Perbanas XVII dan Apconex 2009 sekaligus pengukuhan Ketua Umum Perbanas periode 2009-2012. Pengukuhan ini adalah sebuah representasi simbolis penerusan amanah kepada jajaran pengurus baru yang memiliki makna penting yang patut direnungkan dan hayati. Amanah untuk secara konsisten dan berkesinambungan mencoba memberikan arti pengabdian dirinya maupun organisasinya dalam pencapaian kemaslahatan masyarakat. Untuk itu saya mengucapkan selamat kepada Ketua Umum Perbanas yang baru saja dilantik. Dalam usianya yang memasuki tahun 53, Perbanas telah sejak lama berperan dalam pengembangan industri perbankan nasional. Sungguh tidak berlebihan jika kami berharap agar diacara yang spesial ini para bankir dapat meredefinisi komitmennya untuk mengoptimalkan peran perbankan sebagai lembaga intermediasi dengan tetap memperhatikan penguatan ketahanan industri perbankan nasional dalam rangka mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi yang berkelanjutan dan sekaligus menyiapkan diri untuk menghadapi tantangan di masa depan. Bapak Ibu serta Hadirin Yang Berbahagia, Sebagaimana kita ketahui bersama, kondisi makroekonomi kita tengah mengalami tantangan yang tidak ringan. Dampak krisis keuangan global berupa keketatan likuiditas pasar uang, tekanan dipasar modal serta resesi ekonomi, dalam waktu singkat telah menurunkan kinerja perekonomian global yang pada akhirnya juga mengkebiri upaya bangsa kita untuk meningkatkan pertumbuhan ekonomi ke arah yang lebih baik. Target pertumbuhan ekonomi yang semula telah ditetapkan pada kisaran 4-5% harus disesuaikan menjadi 3-4%. Penyesuaian ini dilakukan dengan salah satu pertimbangan asumsi adanya sumber pembiayaan kredit perbankan, yang apabila realisasi pertumbuhannya dapat sesuai dengan bisnis plan yang diajukan yaitu sebesar 15%, maka pertumbuhan ekonomi diperkirakan dapat mencapai batas atas proyeksi yang ditetapkan. Meskipun secara umum perbankan Indonesia, yang karaketeristik bisnisnya sebagian besar masih konvensional, mampu bertahan dan terlindungi dari efek rambatan krisi keuangan di negara maju, namun perkembangan kinerja hingga triwulan pertama 2009 menunjukkan peran intermediasi yang kurang menggembirakan. Pada Maret 2009, penempatan kredit mengalami penurunan 0,9% menjadi sebesar Rpl.342 triliun dibandingkan akhir Desember 2008. Rendahnya pertumbuhan kredit selama 2009 tersebut, diiikuti dengan peningkatan penanaman bank dalam SBI sebesar 25% sehingga berada pada posisi Rp208 triliun, dengan preferensi penanaman bank pada SBI bertenor yang lebih panjang. Apabila kecenderungan ini terus berlanjut, dikuatirkan dapat mempersulit realisasi pertumbuhan kredit sebagaimana yang diharapkan. Rendahnya penyaluran kredit perlu menjadi perhatian dan salah satu agenda utama Perbanas dalam merumuskan komitmen pengabdian, mengingat peran dan keberadaan bank adalah sebagai lembaga intermediasi dan katalisator pertumbuhan ekonomi yang berkelanjutan. Bapak Ibu serta Hadirin Yang Berbahagia, Dari krisis keuangan yang terjadi, dapat pula kita ambil pelajaran berharga bagi pasar keuangan Indonesia, khususnya perbankan tentang pentingnya upaya mengidentifikasi berbagai risiko yang mungkin terkandung didalam transaksi dan inovasi produk keuangan yang berkembang demikian pesat. Perkembangan sistem keuangan global, yang bergerak sejalan dengan inovasi teknologi dan informasi yang pesat, telah berimplikasi pada perubahan perilaku dan integrasi dalam sistem keuangan, terutama dalam hal pengelolaan dan transfer risiko. Inovasi transaksi dan produk keuangan yang terdiri dari berbagai turunannya tidak lagi semata dilandaskan pada suatu underlying transaksi di sektor riil, yang oleh Bp. Jusf Kalla disebut sebagai ''Ekonomi Siluman". Pada dasarnya, inovasi produk dan transaksi derivatif tidak selalu memiliki dampak negatif. Transaksi derivatif yang berkembang baik dapat mengindikasikan kedewasaan suatu pasar keuangan, yang memiliki peran sebagai mediator dan katalisator pertumbuhan ekonomi melalui percepatan perputaran dana dalam mendukung keperluan transaksi ekonomi. Yang harus menjadi perhatian adalah diperlukan adanya suatu kemampuan untuk mengidentifikasi risiko dan adanya mekanisme transparansi terhadap produk atau transaksi yang ada terkait dengan manfaat, biaya serta risiko yang terkandung sehingga kita tetap dapat memberdayakan manfaatnya dengan meminimalisir dampak negatifnya. Bapak Ibu serta Hadirin Yang Berbahagia, Bagi Bank Indonesia, implikasi dari perubahan pesat sektor keuangan, yang selalu mengandung"risiko", adalah pencapaian macroeconomic stability tidak semata terfokus pada kestabilan harga, namun juga terkait dengan kestabilan sistem keuangan. Dari sisi kebijakan moneter, perubahan lingkungan ekonomi yang mengangkat peran stabilitas keuangan dalam mempengaruhi kestabilan ekonomi makro berimplikasi pada perlunya perumusan kebijakan moneter yang mempertimbangkan peran dan dinamika sistem keuangan dengan segala risikonya. Dari sisi kebijakan perbankan, perubahan perilaku sistem keuangan global memerlukan pengaturan kebijakan perbankan yang lebih rinci yang diarahkan pada upaya pengelolaan perilaku sistem keuangan yang procyclical terhadap siklus perekonomian. Beberapa kebijakan perlu diterapkan secara dinamis mengikuti siklus ekonomi sebagai countercyclical measures di bidang perbankan. Bapak Ibu dan Hadirin yang Berbahagia. Demikian yang dapat saya sampaikan. Semoga dengan ketua Umum Perbanas yang baru, dapat terlahir pemikiran yang lebih kreatif dan konstruktif untuk lebih meningkatkan kontribusi peran perbankan sebagai pelumas roda perekonomian agar dapat tumbuh sebagaimana yang diharapkan. Semoga Perbanas dapat semakin menjadi sebuah kelompok professional yang memiliki peran penting dan dibutuhkan oleh bangsa dan negara. Akhirnya, sekali lagi saya ucapkan selamat kepada para Ketua Umum Perbanas dan pengurus yang baru. Semoga Tuhan Yang Maha Esa senantiasa melindungi setiap langkah kita. Sekian dan terima kasih. Wassalaamu'alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh. Jakarta, 15 Mei 2009 BANK INDONESIA S. Budi Rochadi Deputi Gubernur

Title: Pidato GBI dalam Acara "Inaugural Session of the International Center for Development in Islamic Finance (ICDIF)"
text: KEYNOTE SPEECH By Governor of Bank Indonesia, Prof. Dr. Boediono, at the Inaugural Session of the International Center for Development in Islamic Finance (ICDIF) Jakarta, 25 June 2008 Bismillahirrahmanirrahim, Excellencies, Ambassadors from participating countries, Distinguished speakers and participants, Ladies and gentlemen, Assalamualaikum Warahmatullah Wabarakatuh, First may I ask you to join me in praising Allah SWT for bestowing us with His unbounded grace and mercy so that we can gather in this important occasion, the inauguration of International Center for Development in Islamic Finance (ICDIF). It is also with His consent that we can today hold the international seminar. Ladies and Gentlemen, According to The Banker magazine, sharia-compliant assets in the world have grown almost 30% per annum in recent years. This growth outstrips most other business segments in financial services. Today, the global Islamic finance industry offers a broad and sophisticated range of financial products and services with approximately 1.3 trillion in designated assets. It is no surprise that major international banks like Standard Chartered, Citigroup and Goldman Sachs continue to expand their interest in this segment. In fact, there are currently more than 400 financial institutions offering Sharia compliant products globally, including Sukuk which has created significant demand in the market for the last five years. Countries like United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Malaysia are competing to become the capital center for Islamic finance. In such competitive environment, Indonesia also has great opportunities to become the capital center for Islamic finance. With a population of more than 1 220 million and the majority of them being Moslems, Indonesia is undoubtedly a very promising market. Since the establishment of its first Islamic bank in 1992, the sharia industry in Indonesia has exhibited relatively steady high growth. Business volume grew considerably well exceeding the growth rate of the banking industry as a whole. Last week, the Islamic banking industry in Indonesia has gained new momentum as the Parliament just passed the new Islamic banking law. Earlier, last April, the Parliament has also ratified a new bill on Islamic Bonds. The establishment of these two bills is expected to provide a legal basis for Islamic banking, thus promoting further the development of Islamic banking and finance. However, we realize that much still needs to be done. There are some issues regarding the basic structure of the products, both for asset finance and fund raising or liability products. These first phase products still need more clarification and clearer guidance not only from the banks but also from the authorities. Another set of challenges ahead lie in developing second phase products, a more wide-based retail secondary market for investment products that comply with Islamic rules. Bank Indonesia, through its sharia banking blueprint, has set itself to help the sharia banking industry to reach 5%from its current less than 2% level in sharia assets to that of the total industrysby the end of 2008. Because of this huge growth in Islamic finance industry, there is a shortage of sharia-bankers. Study by LPPI has shown that in order to reach the ratio of 5% of sharia assets to the total banking assets, the industry needs an addition of 14,000 skilled people. For this very reason, LPPI has initiated to establish ICDIF, the International Center for Development in Islamic Finance, which will focus on education and training to meet the high demand of trained and skillful people in the sharia industry. I very much welcome this initiative. The involvement of Islamic Development Bank (IDB), Islamic Banking and Finance Institute Malaysia (IBFIM), universities both from domestic and abroad, Islamic Insurance Society, as well as Islamic scholars in this new center is surely a clear advantage. I believe that the curriculum and courses developed in 2 the center not only will be of high quality but also meet the international standard. Also, the international seminar held today, I believe, will provide us with new practical ideas in meeting the challenges in human resources development to anticipate the fast growth in Islamic finance industry. To conclude, let me say how happy I am to be with you all at this inaugural session of the International Center for Development in Islamic Finance (ICDIF) this morning. To the distinguished speakers and participants of the seminar, I wish you all success in your deliberation. May Allah bless this new center, the ICDIF, with His taufiq and hidayah. Wassalamualaikum Warahmatullah Wabarakatuh. 3

Title: Penjelasan Gubernur Bank Indonesia Pada Rapat Kerja Panitia Anggaran DPR RI Dengan Depkeu, Bappenas, dan Bank Indonesia, 21 Juni 2006
text: EXPLANATION BY THE GOVERNOR OF BANK INDONESIA AT THE WORKING MEETING OF THE BUDGET COMMITTEE of the House of Representatives Rl WITH THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE, BAPPENAS, AND BANK INDONESIA DATED 21JUNE 2006 Dear Members of the Council, 1. First of all, let us express our gratitude to the Budget Committee of the House of Representatives for inviting us to attend today's Working Meeting which will discuss the Ratification of the Results Report 3 Panja in the Framework of Preliminary Discussions on the Preparation of the 2007 State Budget. At the same time on this occasion we express our apologies for not being able to attend the previous meeting, since there were activities that had been scheduled in advance. 2. As understood, the macroeconomic assumptions for the 2007 State Budget that have been agreed at the Panja A meeting are as follows: Sharpnessi Proposed State Budget 2007 Panja A deal Economic Growth (%) 6,2 - 6,4 6,0- 6,5 Inf Iasi (%) 5,0 - 7,0 6,0- 8,0 Exchange Rate (Rp/IUSD) 9.000 - 9.200 9.000 - 9.500 Tk. SBI Interest Rate 3 mo (%) 8,0 - 9,0 8,5 - 9,5 Oil Price (USD/barrel) 55,0 - 58,0 57,0 - 65,0 Oil Lifting (MBCD) 1.000 1.000 Oil Production (MBCD) 1.045 1.050 Deficit (% of GDP) 0,5 - 0,7 0,7 - 0,9 GDP (Trillion Rupiah) 3.521,1 3.534,4 Tax Ratio (% dari PDB) 13,7 - 14,1 13,7 - 14,2 3. Bank Indonesia considers that the macroeconomic assumptions agreed upon by Panja A are still fundamentally in line with Bank Indonesia's forecast. However, along with the developments that have occurred in recent weeks, we remind that there are still several things that need to be observed, related to the potential for an increase in risk factors, especially external risks, such as the high oil price and the continuation of tight global monetary policy. Therefore, the agreed assumptions need to be followed by consistent measures and strong coordination from all economic authorities in anticipation of various such risks, as well as directing policies to maintain macroeconomic stability and maintain economic growth momentum. 4. In relation to economic growth, Bank Indonesia considers that in 2007, the opportunity for the Indonesian economy to grow higher is quite open. This optimism for future economic performance is based on forecasts of conducive global economic conditions, the ability to stimulate more fiscal stimulus, and the pressure of the Iasi inf. controlled. Therefore. Bank Indonesia is not in a position that is contrary to the economic growth assumptions proposed by the Government and has been agreed by the Panja DPR Rl. However, to achieve this economic growth, it needs to be supported by more rigorous and planned efforts, especially to improve the investment climate, increase efficiency and productivity, and encouraging exports. If a conducive investment climate can continue to be improved, investment and exports of goods and services in 2007 will undoubtedly play a greater role in driving growth. a more equitable economy. Dear Members of the Council, 5. The consistency of macroeconomic policies and the various measures that have been and continue to be taken by the government to improve the investment climate are expected to encourage greater capital inflows in the the framework of direct investment (FDI) and portfolio investment. The opportunity to increase capital inflows remains wide open given the large liquidity in international financial markets and the continued attractive difference between domestic interest rates and rates. international interest. The opportunity for improved export performance, supported by increased investment, is also not impossible as the world economic growth accelerates. The increase in capital inflows, as well as an increase in export activities, will in turn strengthen the balance of payments and support rupiah exchange rate stability . With these considerations, we consider that the exchange rate assumption figures agreed in the 2007 State Budget in the range of Rp9,000 to Rp9,500, are quite conservative and realistic. In relation to the issue of exchange rate, we need to state that although Bank Indonesia will strive to maintain exchange rate stability, the range of The estimated exchange rate agreed in the 2007 State Budget is not a target that must be achieved by Bank Indonesia. 6. Furthermore, with regard to inflation, we are of the view that the inflation assumption figure agreed by panja for the 2007 state budget of 6.0-8.0%, is enough to provide room for higher growth. This inflation assumption figure is not much different from the inflation target mandated to Bl. However, in our opinion, in the future, the inflation assumption figures used in the state budget should not be different from the inflation target set by the government. 7. Regarding the inflation forecast itself, we see that there is still the potential for high inflationary pressures stemming from rupiah depreciation and rising inflation expectations in line with increased economic activity and still high world oil price forecasts. Efforts to gradually reduce the inflation rate will continue to be pursued by Bank Indonesia by not disrupting the ongoing economic growth process. We need to inform the honorable Members of the Board that currently the Government and Bank Indonesia have intensively collaborated in the Coordination Team for Target Setting, Monitoring , and Inflation Control, hereinafter referred to as the Inflation Control Team. Coordination is focused on efforts to reduce the economic burden on high bia, encourage adequate supply and smooth distribution to suppress inflation. 8. With the rate of inflation getting under control going forward, opportunities for interest rate cuts are increasingly open. Under such conditions, the assumption of the SBI interest rate in the state budget in the range of 8.5-9.5% at the end of 2007, we think is still possible. The rate range is expected to provide enough room to support economic growth forecasts. Nevertheless, we need to convey to the respectful members of the Board that the monetary policy response that will be reflected in this rate movement is dynamic and will periodic assessments are carried out on it, so that the policies taken are in accordance with the achievement of the inflation target that has been set. Dear Members of the Council, 9. In closing, allow us to reiterate that although macroeconomic assumptions have been agreed upon, there are still considerable challenges and risks in the Indonesian economy, both domestically and externally sourced. Therefore. Bank Indonesia together with the Government will enhance measures to strengthen coordination through various forums, particularly through interbank and government coordination meetings, as well as through the endalification team. Inflation is to determine strategic measures and coordinate the policies to be taken to find the best solution while minimizing the impact of risks that may arise. Jakarta, 21 June 2006 GOVERNOR OF BANK INDONESIA

Sekaligus pada kesempatan ini kami menyampaikan permohonan maaf karena tidak dapat hadir pada rapat sebelumnya, berhubung ada kegiatan yang telah diagendakan terlebih dahulu. 2. Sebagaimana dimaklumi asumsi makroekonomi untuk RAPBN 2007 yang telah disepakati dalam rapat Panja A adalah sebagai berikut: Asumsi Usulan RAPBN 2007 Kesepakatan Panja A Pertumbuhan Ekonomi (%) 6,2 - 6,4 6,0- 6,5 Inf Iasi (%) 5,0 - 7,0 6,0- 8,0 Nilai Tukar (Rp/IUSD) 9.000 - 9.200 9.000 - 9.500 Tk. Suku Bunga SBI 3 bln (%) 8,0 - 9,0 8,5 - 9,5 Harga Minyak (USD/barel) 55,0 - 58,0 57,0 - 65,0 Lifting Minyak (MBCD) 1.000 1.000 Produksi Minyak (MBCD) 1.045 1.050 Defisit (% dari PDB) 0,5 - 0,7 0,7 - 0,9 PDB (Triliun Rupiah) 3.521,1 3.534,4 Tax Ratio (% dari PDB) 13,7 - 14,1 13,7 - 14,2 3. Bank Indonesia memandang bahwa asumsi-asumsi makroekonomi yang telah disepakati oleh Panja A pada dasarnya masih sejalan dengan perkiraan Bank Indonesia. Namun demikian, seiring dengan perkembangan yang terjadi beberapa pekan belakangan ini, kami mengingatkan bahwa masih terdapat beberapa hal yang perlu dicermati, terkait dengan potensi peningkatan faktor risiko, khsususnya risiko eksternal, seperti masih tingginya harga minyak dan berlanjutnya kebijakan moneter ketat global. Oleh karena itu, asumsi yang telah disepakati tersebut perlu disertai oleh langkah-langkah konsisten serta koordinasi yang kuat dari seluruh otoritas perekonomian dalam mengantisipasi berbagai risiko tersebut, serta mengarahkan kebijakan untuk tetap menjaga stabilitas makroekonomi dan memelihara momentum pertumbuhan ekonomi. 4. Berkaitan dengan pertumbuhan ekonomi, Bank Indonesia memandang bahwa pada tahun 2007, peluang perekonomian Indonesia untuk tumbuh lebih tinggi cukup terbuka. Optimisme terhadap kinerja ekonomi ke depan ini didasarkan pada perkiraan kondisi ekonomi global yang tetap kondusif, kemampuan stimulus fiskal yang lebih besar, dan tekanan inf Iasi yang terkendali. Oleh karena itu. Bank Indonesia tidak berada dalam posisi yang bertentangan dengan asumsi pertumbuhan ekonomi yang diusulkan oleh Pemerintah dan telah disepakati Panja DPR Rl. Namun demikian, untuk mencapai pertumbuhan ekonomi tersebut perlu ditopang dengan upaya yang lebih keras dan terencana terutama untuk memperbaiki iklim invetasi, meningkatkan efisiensi dan produktivitas, dan mendorong ekspor. Apabila iklim investasi yang kondusif dapat terus ditingkatkan, investasi serta ekspor barang dan jasa pada 2007 niscaya akan lebih berperan dalam mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi yang lebih merata. Anggota Dewan yang terhormat, 5. Konsistensi kebijakan makroekonomi dan berbagai langkah yang telah dan terus ditempuh pemerintah untuk memperbaiki iklim investasi diharapkan akan mendorong semakin besarnya aliran modal masuk baik dalam rangka penanaman modal langsung (FDI) maupun investasi portofolio. Peluang untuk meningkatkan aliran modal masuk masih terbuka lebar mengingat besarnya likuiditas di pasar keuangan internasional dan tetap menariknya selisih antara suku bunga domestik dan suku bunga internasional. Peluang untuk peningkatan kinerja ekspor, dengan didukung oleh peningkatan investasi, juga bukanlah hal yang mustahil seiring dengan poyeksi pertumbuhan ekonomi dunia yang semakin baik.. Meningkatnya aliran modal masuk tersebut serta peningkatan kegiatan ekspor, pada gilirannya akan memperkuat neraca pembayaran serta mendukung kestabilan nilai tukar Rupiah. Dengan pertimbangan tersebut, kami memandang bahwa angka asumsi nilai tukar yang disepakati dalam RAPBN 2007 pada kisaran Rp9.000 s.d Rp9.500, cukup konservatif dan realistis. Terkait dengan permasalahan nilai tukar, perlu kami kemukakan bahwa walaupun Bank Indonesia akan berupaya keras menjaga kestabilan nilai tukar, namun kisaran perkiraan nilai tukar yang disepakati dalam RAPBN 2007 tersebut bukan merupakan target yang harus dicapai oleh Bank Indonesia. 6. Selanjutnya, berkaitan dengan inflasi, kami berpandangan bahwa angka asumsi inflasi yang disepakati oleh Panja untuk RAPBN 2007 sebesar 6,0-8,0%, cukup memberikan ruang bagi pertumbuhan yang lebih tinggi. Angka asumsi inflasi ini tidak jauh berbeda dengan target inflasi yang diamanatkan pencapaiannya kepada Bl. Meskipun demikian, menurut hemat kami, ke depan, sebaiknya angka asumsi inflasi yang digunakan dalam RAPBN seyogyanya tidak berbeda dengan target inflasi yang ditetapkan pemerintah. 7. Mengenai perkiraan inflasi sendiri, kami melihat masih terdapat potensi tekanan inflasi yang cukup tinggi yang bersumber dari depresiasi nilai tukar rupiah dan meningkatnya ekspektasi inflasi sejalan dengan meningkatnya kegiatan ekonomi dan masih tingginya perkiraan harga minyak dunia. Upaya untuk menurunkan laju inflasi secara gradual tetap ditempuh oleh Bank Indonesia dengan tidak mengganggu proses pertumbuhan ekonomi yang tengah berlangsung. Perlu kami informasikan kepada Anggota Dewan yang terhormat bahwa saat ini Pemerintah dan Bank Indonesia telah secara intensif telah bekerjasama dalam Tim Koordinasi Penetapan Sasaran, Pemantauan, dan Pengendalian Inflasi yang selanjutnya dinamakan Tim Pengendalian Inflasi. Koordinasi difokuskan pada upaya mengurangi beban ekonomi biaya tinggi, mendorong kecukupan pasokan dan kelancaran distribusi guna menekan inflasi. 8. Dengan semakin terkendalinya laju inflasi ke depan, peluang untuk penurunan suku bunga semakin terbuka. Dalam kondisi demikian, angka asumsi suku bunga SBI dalam RAPBN dengan kisaran 8,5-9,5% pada akhir tahun 2007, kami pandang masih dimungkinkan. Kisaran suku bunga tersebut diperkirakan cukup memberikan ruang untuk menopang perkiraan pertumbuhan ekonomi . Namun demikian, perlu kami sampaikan kepada anggota Dewan yang terhormat bahwa respon kebijakan moneter yang akan tercermin pada pergerakan suku bunga ini bersifat dinamis dan akan dilakukan asesmen sehingga secara berkala terhadapnya, agar kebijakan yang diambil sesuai dengan pencapaian sasaran inflasi yang telah ditetapkan. Anggota Dewan yang terhormat, 9. Sebagai penutup, izinkan kami untuk mengemukakan kembali bahwa walaupun asumsi- asumsi makroekonomi telah disepakati, masih terdapat tantangan dan risiko yang cukup besar dalam perekonomian Indonesia, baik yang bersumber dari domestik maupun eksternal. Oleh karena itu. Bank Indonesia bersama dengan Pemerintah akan meningkatkan langkah-langkah penguatan koordinasi melalui berbagai forum, khususnya melalui Rakortas antar Bank Indonesia dan Pemerintah, serta melalui Tim Pengendalian Inflasi guna menetapkan langkah-langkah strategis dan mengkoordinasikan kebijakan yang akan diambil untuk mencari solusi terbaik sekaligus meminimal dampak risiko yang mungkin timbul. Jakarta, 21 Juni 2006 GUBERNUR BANK INDONESIA

Title: Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia, Dr. Darmin Nasution Pada Acara Peluncuran Lembaga Riset Ekonomi Creco, 1 Maret 2011
text: Creco Research Institute Seminar: Managing the Economy under the Threat of Inflation and The Rapid Inflow of Capital March 1st, 2011 Dr. Darmin Nasution Overview of Monetary/Banking Policy-On Inflation and Capital Inflows Which I respect Vice President of the Republic of Indonesia, Mr. Prof. Dr . Boediono Deputy Minister of Trade, Mr. Mahendra Siregar Mr. Mrs. State Officials Other invited ladies and gentlemen Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh, Good morning and greetings to all of us, Beginning this speech, let me invite the Audience to offer thanksgiving to the presence of Allah Subhanahu WaTa'ala for thanks to His permission and grace we can all attend this seminar. I view, in the midst of a global environment that continues to move more and more dynamic, the holding of this seminar is very useful for sharing thought and input especially in responding to tough challenges in our economy going forward. Happy ladies and gentlemen, The financial crisis of 2008/2009 has changed the order of the economy globally, while it takes a short time for the economy global itself to readjust towards normalcy. Moment this we are witnessing how the global economic recovery is divided 1 into two speeds (multispeed of recovery), namely developed countries and emerging markets, each of which faces economic prospects, challenges, and different policy responses. This discrepancy continues creating uncertainty and fluctuations in global financial markets when this, among other things, is characterized by a shift in investment preferences (risk apetite) and global capital allocation, leading to emerging countries Market. The dynamics of the global environment like this will certainly make challenges for emerging market central banks in maintaining stability macros are increasingly complex, so they require a policy framework that is different than before the crisis. There are at least two implications for central bank tasks in emerging Market. The first implication is that there is a need for central banks to further emphasizes two functions, namely maintaining price stability (inflation) and the financial sector (financial stability) at the same time as two an inseparable function. Valuable lessons from the last global crisis is that under conditions of maintained price stability is not enough to can guarantee the maintenance of financial stability. The potential for a crisis is precisely accumulated because economic actors take risks excessively in conditions where the economy is growing rapidly (economic boom), and inflation was kept stable and low. The second implication, as a consequence of the increasing integration of the market domestic finance with global then the main source of risk and instability will be more of external origin. The rapid flow of capital to emerging markets due to stimulus policies in developed countries and soaring commodity prices into two external risks that addressing the policy response of emerging market central banks on challenges are also increasingly complex. The first challenge is the dilemma 2 which monetary policy faces because the central bank must be in a while overcoming appreciation pressures, controlling inflation, but also maintaining the momentum of economic growth. The second challenge, related in maintaining financial stability due to potential imbalances macroeconomics, asset bubbles, and capital reversal risks in numbers big and sudden. Happy ladies and gentlemen, I would like to briefly convey the 4 (four) main challenges, in where Bank Indonesia must respond simultaneously through a policy mix. The first challenge is how to control inflation to The target direction was 5b11% in 2011 and 4.5b11% in 2012. At amid rising economic activity, soaring oil prices and food commodities in the global market, high excess liquidity in the market domestic finance, and the rapid inflow of capital inflows, hence efforts this inflation control is certainly not light. The increase in investment activities since mid-2010 has indeed been encourage increased production capacity so that it can keep pace strong growth in consumption. This is reflected in core inflation which is still growing moderately. However, core inflationary pressures stemming from external or imported inflation needs to be kept closely monitored in line with soaring commodity prices in global markets including oil prices raw and food. Rising oil prices can have an effect on rising fuel prices non-subsidized mainly at the industrial level. Similarly, price increases 3 food commodities in the global market such as CPO, wheat, soybeans, corn, and rice begins to have an impact, both directly (first round effect) through an increase in input costs, as well as indirect (second round effect) to the development of food prices in the domestic. Inflationary pressures stemming from pressures on oil and food prices as well can have a further impact if it continues to affect inflation expectations in society, and if not responded to will putting pressure on core inflation. Bank Indonesia survey results shows inflation expectations at both the producer and consumer levels in an increasing tendency. We also need to look at the influence of rising inflation expectations and persistent food price hikes against the pressure of rising wage whims, which in turn can be triggering the occurrence of mutually affecting rotations (spiraling-up) between inflation expectations and wages. In financial markets, the strengthening of inflation expectations has been seen since the beginning Last January, reflected in the increase in bond yields accompanied by pressure rupiah depreciation. If the condition is not responded to, it is also feared can trigger the occurrence of mutually affecting rotations (spiraling- up) between inflation expectations and depreciation expectations, thus increasingly worsening the inflation outlook. In addition to cyclical problems as mentioned above, quality problems and the quantity of infrastructure and the inefficiency of the market structure is a weak point that causes inflation in Indonesia to be relatively more high in regional scale. The second challenge is how to optimize the benefits from foreign capital inflows and minimizing the risks. 4 Complications of macro policy management caused by the torrential short-term capital inflows are a problem that is currently faced together by most emerging markets. Problems arises due to inherent risks inherent in the flow of term capital short i.e. the nature of 'procyclicality' in which capital flows in rapidly at a time when the economy is growing rapidly (economic boom), the opposite is flowing it's rushing out at a time when the economy is slowing down. At a time when the economy is growing rapidly capital inflows can encourage the economy is in a state of 'internal imbalances' because capital flows are also trigger inflationary pressures and asset bubbles, and at the same time push into the condition of 'external imbalance' due to the pressure of appreciation caused such capital inflows also worsened the current account balance. Conversely, at a time when the economy is slowing down, capital flows may reverse suddenly so that it triggers the pressure of depreciation and macro instability and financial system. In principle, for Indonesia, foreign capital inflows are still needed as one of the sources of economic financing. Challenge is how great the foreign interest in financial markets is domestic can be directed to facilitate the deepening of financial markets and business financing. The third challenge is how to control excesses liquidity to suit the needs of domestic demand. The rapid inflow of foreign capital further adds to the excesses of liquidity which already exists mainly in the banking sector, so it can provide pressure on macro stability if not managed optimally. 5 In banking conditions experiencing excess liquidity, transmission monetary policy has also become less effective. To overcome this, amid the rapid inflow of capital inflows, the Bank Indonesia is required to continue to develop a monetary operations strategy which is right with various combinations of instruments. Similarly, policy coordination with the Government is also very important in order to manage excess liquidity sourced from operations Government finances. The fourth challenge is how to improve efficiency, banking resilience and competitiveness. Monetary policy transmission will also be less effective if low banking efficiency and fragile capital resilience. Deep regional scale, competitiveness of Indonesian banking in terms of efficiency, capital and assets are still lower than countries area. For example, the ratio of operating expenses to revenue operational (BOPO) and Net Interest Margin (NIM) of Indonesian banks still higher than banking in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Philippines. Happy ladies and gentlemen, The various challenges facing our economy as well as outlined above has its own implications for monetary policy that has to go. These challenges confront the Bank Indonesia is in a trilemma of policy, namely (i) maintaining stability monetary for price stability and at the same time (ii) maintaining value stability exchange and (iii) financial system stability. 6 In practice, no country is in the extreme the trilemma, which is within the three objectives of the trilemma of policy aforementioned in full. In general, emerging market countries prepare for the trilemma by choosing to be in the middle of the (middle ground solution), i.e. with the movement of the exchange rate that under control, and at the same time keeping an effort to keep price stability and financial system stability. In responding to various challenges and trilemmas as has been outlined above, policy rates that under normal circumstances can used as an instrument of monetary policy, being insufficient and should be supplemented with various other policy instruments. To that end, since last year Bank Indonesia formulated a mix of policy instruments monetary, macroprudential, and exchange rate flexibility in a controlled manner. Macroprudential policy complements monetary policy, both for managing domestic liquidity -for example through the implementation of Mandatory Demand Deposits Minimum (GWM)-, as well as to control the rapid flow of capital entry -e.g. through the application of SBI's ownership obligation provisions for one month (One Month Holding Period) and restriction provisions short-term foreign loans (PLN) banks. In 2011, the policy mix will continue to be strengthened and calibrated based on a thorough assessment of leads economy and financial system. The policy mix includes; (i) BI rate policy, (ii) exchange rate policy, (iii) maintain adequacy of foreign exchange reserves, (iii) macroprudential policy for 7 domestic liquidity management, and (iv) macroprudential policy to foreign capital inflows. Happy ladies and gentlemen, In relation to interest rate policy, the BI Rate decision is always consider 5 main factors, namely: (i) projected inflation two years on a year ahead and consistency with the inflation target, (ii) projections economic growth in the next two years, (iii) exchange rate projections and causative factors, including foreign capital flows, as well as their influence on projected inflation and economic growth, (iv) interest rate developments and banking credit, as well as (v) asset valuations in the financial sector. The first two factors are needed to maintain the consistency of the BI rate with achievement of the inflation target taking into account its impact on economic growth. Meanwhile, the last three factors are needed for external balance, monetary stability and system stability financial, as well as for the assessment of transmission mechanisms monetary policy. This implies that the BI Rate decision will performed measurably (measured paces) and changed under conditions timely considering the impact on sustainable economic growth and financial system stability. As part of the policy mix, the interest rate response is critical to further emphasize signals over macroprudential policies that it has been taken first like the Minimum Mandatory Giro (GWM). Dampen increased inflationary pressure amid rising imported inflation as a result of soaring commodity prices also requires provision flexibility for the rupiah exchange rate to strengthen, resulting in an increase in BI 8 Too large a rate can be avoided. However, such flexibility is also must be controlled so that export competitiveness is maintained. The policy mix as I described it, saves me is an adequate solution to respond to increasing challenges current and future complexes. Nevertheless, under conditions where short-term capital flows are considerable, while absorbency economy and financial markets are still limited, hence the policy mix it's still not enough. To achieve optimal results, monetary policy must be carried out in a synergize with fiscal policy, and are supported by other policies, especially to address supply issues and market deepening policies financial. A prudent fiscal policy is essential to keep continuity, but also needs to be accompanied by spending that effective and efficient so that it will further strengthen economic growth while helping to reduce excess liquidity in financial markets. Meanwhile, coordination is established to overcome supply issues and distribution needs to be continuously strengthened, including through optimizing the role of TPI and TPID. Similarly, concrete steps in the framework of market deepening financial is no less important to help reduce risks instability caused by volatile capital flows. Happy ladies and gentlemen, Effective implementation of monetary policy requires institutions finance in particular the banking sector is strong and efficient. Efficiency it can be a node of unraveling intermediation problems, so that it can increase credit and further expected to be more 9 encourage economic growth. Efficiency can also drive the behavior of banks in providing more prudent, selective credit, productive and prospective. Such behavior will also stimulate the practice of banking prudence, which is a prerequisite for the creation of stability financial system. We have started with efforts to improve efficiency with the enactment of the provisions announcing the 'prime lending rate' (PLR). Bank Indonesia is also continuing to prepare further measures, including the implementation of interbank benchmarking. Happy ladies and gentlemen, In closing I would like to invite us together, stakeholders policies, communities in the financial sector, and businesses to be vigilant however, it remains optimistic in responding to the domestic economic outlook. Although it shows significant progress, various imbalances still accompany the global recovery process so that can trigger uncertainty and vulnerability in global financial markets. In such an increasingly dynamic global environment, promoting a healthy business growth orientation by continuing to improve the ability to measure and manage risks that better to be an inevitability. Thus, we all can contribute to realizing economic development that not only does it grow taller, but more importantly it is more quality and continuous. Thank you and may Allah SWT always protect and guide us all. Wassalamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh. 10
text_original: Creco Research Institute Seminar : Mengelola Ekonomi dibawah Ancaman Inflasi dan Derasnya Modal Masuk 1 Maret 2011 Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia Dr. Darmin Nasution Overview Kebijakan Moneter/Perbankan-Tentang Inflasi dan Capital Inflows Yang saya hormati Wakil Presiden Republik Indonesia , Bapak Prof Dr Boediono Wakil Menteri Perdagangan, Bapak Mahendra Siregar Bapak Ibu Pejabat Negara Bapak-Ibu undangan lainnya Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh, Selamat pagi dan salam sejahtera bagi kita semua, Mengawali sambutan ini, perkenankanlah saya mengajak Hadirin untuk memanjatkan puji syukur ke hadirat Allah Subhanahu WaTa'ala karena berkat izin dan rahmat-Nya kita semua dapat hadir dalam seminar ini. Saya berpandangan, di tengah lingkungan global yang terus bergerak semakin dinamis, penyelenggaraan seminar ini sangat bermanfaat untuk berbagi pemikiran dan masukan terutama dalam menjawab tantangan berat dalam perekonomian kita ke depan. Hadirin sekalian yang berbahagia, Krisis keuangan 2008/2009 lalu telah merubah tatanan perekonomian global, sementara diperlukan waktu yang tidak singkat bagi perekonomian global itu sendiri untuk menyesuaikan kembali menuju kondisi normal. Saat ini kita menyaksikan bagaimana pemulihan ekonomi global terbagi 1 kedalam dua kecepatan (multispeed of recovery), yaitu negara maju dan emerging market, yang masing-masing menghadapi prospek ekonomi, tantangan, dan respon kebijakan yang berbeda. Perbedaan ini terus menimbulkan ketidakpastian dan fluktuasi di pasar keuangan global saat ini, yang antara lain ditandai dengan bergesernya preferensi investasi (risk apetite) dan alokasi modal global, yang mengarah ke negara emerging market. Dinamika lingkungan global seperti ini tentunya akan membuat tantangan bagi bank sentral emerging market dalam menjaga stabilitas makro semakin komplek, sehingga memerlukan framework kebijakan yang berbeda dibandingkan sebelum krisis. Setidaknya, terdapat dua implikasi bagi tugas bank sentral di emerging market. Implikasi pertama, adanya keharusan bagi bank sentral untuk semakin mempertegas dua fungsi yaitu menjaga stabilitas harga (inflasi) dan sektor keuangan (financial stability) secara sekaligus sebagai dua fungsi yang tidak terpisahkan. Pelajaran berharga dari krisis global terakhir adalah bahwa dalam kondisi terjaganya stabilitas harga tidak cukup untuk dapat menjamin terpeliharanya stabilitas keuangan. Potensi krisis justru terakumulasi karena pelaku ekonomi mengambil risiko secara berlebihan dalam kondisi dimana ekonomi sedang tumbuh pesat (economic boom), dan inflasi terjaga stabil dan rendah. Implikasi kedua, sebagai konskuensi dari semakin terintegrasinya pasar keuangan domestik dengan global maka sumber utama risiko dan instabilitas akan lebih banyak berasal dari eksternal. Derasnya aliran modal ke emerging market akibat kebijakan stimulus di negara maju dan melambungnya harga komoditas menjadi dua risiko eksternal yang menghadapkan respon kebijakan bank sentral emerging market pada tantangan yang juga semakin kompleks. Tantangan pertama adalah dilema 2 yang dihadapi kebijakan moneter karena bank sentral harus secara sekaligus mengatasi tekanan apresiasi, mengendalikan inflasi, namun juga menjaga momentum pertumbuhan ekonomi. Tantangan kedua, terkait dalam menjaga stabilitas keuangan akibat potensi ketidakseimbangan makroekonomi, asset bubble, dan risiko pembalikan modal dalam jumlah besar dan mendadak. Hadirin sekalian yang berbahagia, Saya ingin menyampaikan secara sekilas 4 (empat) tantangan utama, di mana Bank Indonesia harus merespon secara sekaligus melalui suatu bauran kebijakan. Tantangan pertama adalah bagaimana mengendalikan inflasi ke arah sasaran yaitu 5<b1>1% pada 2011 dan 4.5<b1>1% pada 2012. Di tengah meningkatnya kegiatan ekonomi, melambungnya harga minyak dan komoditas pangan di pasar global, tingginya ekses likuiditas di pasar keuangan dalam negeri, dan derasnya arus modal masuk, maka upaya pengendalian inflasi ini tentu tidaklah ringan. Meningkatnya kegiatan investasi sejak pertengahan 2010 memang telah mendorong peningkatan kapasitas produksi sehingga dapat mengimbangi kuatnya pertumbuhan konsumsi. Hal ini tercermin dari inflasi inti yang masih tumbuh moderat. Namun, tekanan inflasi inti yang bersumber dari eksternal atau imported inflation perlu terus dicermati sejalan dengan melonjaknya harga komoditas di pasar global termasuk harga minyak mentah dan pangan. Kenaikan harga minyak dapat berpengaruh pada kenaikkan harga BBM non-subsidi terutama di tingkat industri. Demikian pula, kenaikkan harga 3 komoditas pangan di pasar global seperti CPO, gandum, kedelai, jagung, dan beras mulai berdampak, baik secara langsung (first round effect) melaui kenaikkan input cost, maupun tidak langsung (second round effect) terhadap perkembangan harga pangan di domestik. Tekanan inflasi yang bermula dari tekanan harga minyak dan pangan juga dapat memberikan dampak lanjutan apabila terus mempengaruhi ekspektasi inflasi di masyarakat, dan apabila tidak direspons akan memberikan tekanan ke inflasi inti. Hasil survey Bank Indonesia menunjukkan ekspektasi inflasi baik di tingkat produsen dan konsumen dalam kecenderungan meningkat. Kita juga perlu mencermati pengaruh naiknya ekspektasi inflasi dan persistensi kenaikkan harga pangan terhadap tekanan kenaikkan tingkah upah, yang pada gilirannya dapat memicu terjadinya perputaran yang saling mempengaruhi (spiraling-up) antara ekspektasi inflasi dan upah. Di pasar keuangan, menguatnya ekspektasi inflasi sudah terlihat sejak awal Januari lalu, tercermin dari meningkatnya yield obligasi disertai tekanan depresiasi rupiah. Apabila kondisi tersebut tidak direspon juga dikawatirkan dapat memicu terjadinya perputaran yang saling mempengaruhi (spiraling- up) antara ekspektasi inflasi dan ekspektasi depresiasi, sehingga semakin memperburuk outlook inflasi. Selain permasalahan siklikal seperti tersebut di atas, permasalahan kualitas dan kuantitas infrastruktur serta kurang efisiennya struktur pasar merupakan titik lemah yang menyebabkan inflasi di Indonesia relatif lebih tinggi dalam skala kawasan. Tantangan kedua adalah bagaimana mengoptimalkan manfaat dari aliran masuk modal asing dan meminimalkan risikonya. 4 Komplikasi pengelolaan kebijakan makro yang ditimbulkan oleh derasnya arus masuk modal jangka pendek merupakan permasalahan yang tengah dihadapi bersama oleh sebagian besar emerging market. Permasalahan timbul karena risiko inherent yang melekat pada aliran modal jangka pendek yaitu sifat 'procyclicality' di mana modal mengalir masuk deras pada saat ekonomi tumbuh pesat (economic boom), sebaliknya mengalir deras keluar pada saat ekonomi melambat (economic slowdown). Pada saat ekonomi tumbuh pesat aliran modal masuk dapat mendorong ekonomi ke dalam kondisi 'internal imbalances' karena arus modal turut memicu tekanan inflasi dan asset bubble, dan sekaligus mendorong ke kondisi 'external imbalance' karena tekanan apresiasi yang ditimbulkan arus modal masuk tersebut juga memperburuk neraca transaksi berjalan. Sebaliknya, pada saat ekonomi melambat, arus modal dapat berbalik mendadak sehingga memicu tekanan depresiasi dan instabilitas makro dan sistem keuangan. Pada prinsipnya, bagi Indonesia aliran masuk modal asing masih diperlukan sebagai salah satu sumber pembiayaan perekonomian.Tantangannya adalah bagaimana besarnya minat asing terhadap pasar keuangan domestik dapat diarahkan untuk memfasilitasi pendalaman pasar keuangan dan pembiayaan dunia usaha. Tantangan ketiga adalah bagaimana mengendalikan ekses likuiditas agar sesuai dengan kebutuhan permintaan domestik. Derasnya aliran masuk modal asing semakin menambah ekses likuiditas yang telah ada terutama di sektor perbankan, sehingga dapat memberikan tekanan terhadap stabilitas makro apabila tidak dikelola secara optimal. 5 Dalam kondisi perbankan yang mengalami ekses likuiditas, transmisi kebijakan moneter juga menjadi kurang efektif. Untuk mengatasi hal tersebut, di tengah derasnya arus modal masuk, Bank Indonesia dituntut untuk terus mengembangkan strategi operasi moneter yang tepat dengan berbagai kombinasi instrumen. Demikian pula, koordinasi kebijakan dengan Pemerintah juga menjadi sangat penting dalam rangka mengelola ekses likuiditas yang bersumber dari operasi keuangan Pemerintah. Tantangan keempat adalah bagaimana meningkatkan efisiensi, ketahanan dan daya saing perbankan. Transmisi kebijakan moneter juga akan berjalan kurang efektif apabila efisiensi perbankan rendah dan ketahanan permodalannya rapuh. Dalam skala regional, daya saing perbankan Indonesia dari segi efisiensi, permodalan dan aset masih lebih rendah dibandingkan negara-negara kawasan. Misalnya, rasio biaya operasional terhadap pendapatan operasional (BOPO) dan Net Interest Margin (NIM) perbankan Indonesia masih lebih tinggi dari perbankan di Singapura, Malaysia, Thailand dan Filipina. Hadirin sekalian yang berbahagia, Berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perekonomian kita sebagaimana diuraikan di atas memiliki implikasi tersendiri terhadap kebijakan moneter yang harus ditempuh. Berbagai tantangan tersebut menghadapkan Bank Indonesia pada sebuah trilemma kebijakan, yaitu (i) menjaga stabilitas moneter untuk stabilitas harga dan sekaligus (ii) menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar dan (iii) stabilitas sistem keuangan. 6 Dalam prakteknya, tidak ada negara yang berada dalam titik ekstrim trilemma tersebut, yaitu berada dalam ketiga tujuan trilemma kebijakan tersebut secara penuh. Secara umum, negara-negara emerging market mensiasati trilemma tersebut dengan memilih berada di tengah-tengah (middle ground solution), yaitu dengan pergerakan nilai tukar yang terkendali, dan pada saat yang bersamaan tetap berupaya menjaga stabilitas harga dan stabilitas sistem keuangan. Dalam menyikapi berbagai tantangan serta trilemma sebagaimana telah diuraikan di atas, suku bunga kebijakan yang dalam keadaan normal dapat digunakan sebagai instrumen kebijakan moneter, menjadi tidak cukup dan harus ditambah dengan berbagai instrumen kebijakan lainnya. Untuk itu, sejak tahun lalu Bank Indonesia merumuskan bauran instrumen kebijakan moneter, makroprudensial, dan fleksibilitas nilai tukar secara terkendali. Kebijakan makroprudensial melengkapi kebijakan moneter, baik untuk mengelola likuiditas domestik -misalnya melalui penerapan Giro Wajib Minimum (GWM)-, maupun untuk mengendalikan derasnya arus modal masuk -misalnya melalui penerapan ketentuan kewajiban kepemilikan SBI selama satu bulan (One Month Holding Period) dan ketentuan pembatasan pinjaman luar negeri (PLN) jangka pendek bank. Pada tahun 2011 ini, bauran kebijakan tersebut akan terus diperkuat dan dikalibrasi berdasarkan assessment yang menyeluruh terhadap prospek perekonomian dan sistem keuangan. Bauran kebijakan tersebut mencakup; (i) kebijakan suku bunga BI rate, (ii) kebijakan nilai tukar, (iii) menjaga kecukupan cadangan devisa, (iii) kebijakan makroprudensial untuk 7 pengelolaan likuiditas domestik, dan (iv) kebijakan makroprudensial terhadap aliran masuk modal asing. Hadirin sekalian yang berbahagia, Terkait dengan kebijakan suku bunga, keputusan BI Rate senantiasa mempertimbangkan 5 faktor utama, yaitu: (i) proyeksi inflasi dua tahun ke depan dan konsistensinya dengan sasaran inflasi, (ii) proyeksi pertumbuhan ekonomi dua tahun ke depan, (iii) proyeksi nilai tukar dan faktor penyebabnya, termasuk aliran modal asing, serta pengaruhnya pada proyeksi inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi, (iv) perkembangan suku bunga dan kredit perbankan, serta (v) valuasi aset di sektor keuangan. Dua faktor pertama diperlukan untuk menjaga konsistensi BI rate dengan pencapaian sasaran inflasi dengan mempertimbangkan dampaknya pada pertumbuhan ekonomi. Sementara itu, tiga faktor terakhir diperlukan untuk keseimbangan eksternal, stabilitas moneter dan stabilitas sistem keuangan, sekaligus untuk assessment terhadap mekanisme transmisi kebijakan moneter. Ini berimplikasi bahwa keputusan BI Rate akan dilakukan secara terukur (measured paces) dan dirubah dalam kondisi yang tepat (timely) dengan mempertimbangkan dampaknya terhadap kesinambungan pertumbuhan ekonomi dan stabilitas sistem keuangan. Sebagai bagian dari bauran kebijakan, respon suku bunga sangat penting untuk lebih mempertegas sinyal atas kebijakan makroprudensial yang telah lebih dahulu ditempuh seperti Giro Wajib Minimum (GWM). Meredam peningkatan tekanan inflasi di tengah meningkatnya imported inflation akibat melambungnya harga komoditas juga memerlukan pemberian fleksibilitas bagi nilai tukar rupiah untuk menguat, sehingga kenaikkan BI 8 Rate yang terlalu besar dapat dihindari. Namun, fleksibilitas tersebut juga harus terkendali agar daya saing ekspor tetap terjaga. Bauran kebijakan sebagaimana saya uraikan tersebut, hemat saya merupakan solusi yang memadai untuk merespon tantangan yang semakin komplek saat ini dan kedepan. Meski demikian, dalam kondisi dimana aliran modal jangka pendek cukup besar, sementara daya serap perekonomian dan pasar keuangan masih terbatas, maka bauran kebijakan tersebut tetap tidaklah cukup. Untuk mencapai hasil optimal, kebijakan moneter harus dijalankan secara bersinergi dengan kebijakan fiskal, serta ditopang kebijakan lain terutama untuk mengatasi persoalan pasokan dan kebijakan pendalaman pasar keuangan. Kebijakan fiskal yang prudent sangat penting untuk menjaga kesinambungan, namun juga perlu disertai dengan pembelanjaan yang efektif dan efisien sehingga akan lebih memperkuat pertumbuhan ekonomi sekaligus membantu mengurangi ekses likuiditas di pasar keuangan. Sementara itu, jalinan koordinasi untuk mengatasi persoalan pasokan dan distribusi perlu terus diperkuat, termasuk melalui optimalisasi peran TPI dan TPID. Demikian pula, langkah konkrit dalam rangka pendalaman pasar keuangan tidak kalah penting untuk membantu mengurangi risiko instabilitas yang ditimbulkan oleh arus modal yang volatile. Hadirin sekalian yang berbahagia, Implementasi kebijakan moneter yang efektif memerlukan lembaga keuangan khususnya sektor perbankan yang kuat dan efisien. Efisiensi tersebut dapat menjadi simpul terurainya permasalahan intermediasi, sehingga dapat meningkatkan kredit dan selanjutnya diharapkan lebih 9 mendorong pertumbuhan ekonomi. Efisiensi juga dapat mendorong perilaku bank dalam memberikan kredit yang lebih hati-hati, selektif, produktif dan prospektif. Perilaku tersebut juga akan menstimulasi praktek kehati-hatian perbankan, yang merupakan prasyarat terciptanya stabilitas system keuangan. Usaha peningkatan efisiensi tersebut telah kita mulai dengan pemberlakuan ketentuan mengumumkan 'suku bunga dasar kredit' (SBDK). Bank Indonesia juga masih terus menyiapkan langkah-langkah lanjutan, termasuk pelaksanaan benchmarking antar bank. Hadirin sekalian yang berbahagia, Sebagai penutup saya ingin mengajak kita bersama, pemangku kebijakan, komunitas di sektor kuangan, serta pelaku bisnis untuk waspada namun tetap optimis dalam menyikapi prospek perekonomian domestik. Meskipun menunjukkan kemajuan yang berarti, berbagai ketidakseimbangan masih menyertai proses pemulihan global sehingga dapat memicu ketidakpastian dan kerentanan di pasar keuangan global. Dalam lingkungan global yang semakin dinamis seperti itu, mengedepankan orientasi pertumbuhan bisnis yang sehat dengan terus meningkatkan kemampuan dalam mengukur dan mengelola risiko yang lebih baik menjadi sebuah keniscayaan. Dengan demikian, kita semua dapat turut berkontribusi dalam mewujudkan pembangunan ekonomi yang tidak saja tumbuh lebih tinggi, namun yang lebih penting adalah lebih berkualitas dan berkesinambungan.
