Wb. l.Mengawali sambutan ini, perkenankan saya mengajak Bapak/lbu sekalian untuk bersama- sama memanjatkan puji dan syukur ke hadirat Tuhan YME, karena hanya atas perkenan-Nya kita dapat bertemu dalam suasana yang baik untuk bersama-sama menghadiri dan menyaksikan Wisuda STIE Indonesia Banking School (IBS) Tahun 2015. Atas nama pribadi dan Dewan Gubernur Bank Indonesia, kami mengucapkan selamat kepada wisudawan-wisudawati STIE IBS dan para orang tua yang yang hadir pada acara wisuda hari ini. 2.Sebelum kami membacakan sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia sebagai Ketua Dewan Kurator, ijinkan kami menyampaikan permohonan maaf dari Gubernur Bank Indonesia, Bp Agus Martowardojo, yang tidak dapat hadir dalam wisuda STIE IBS hari ini. Sejak hari Kamis hingga Minggu besok, seluruh Anggota Dewan Gubernur Bank Indonesia berada di Yogyakarta dalam rangkaian kegiatan Board Seminar Kajian Ekonomi dan Keuangan Regional serta koordinasi antara Bank Indonesia-Pemerintah Pusat-Pemerintah Daerah di Yogyakarta. Kegiatan ini merupakan agenda rutin sejak awal tahun 2015 sebagai bagian dari upaya Bank Indonesia mendorong reformasi struktural baik di tingkat pusat maupun daerah. Bapak/lbu dan para hadirin yang berbahagia, <Tantangan perekonomian terkini> 3. Tak terasa sebentar lagi kita akan meninggalkan tahun 2015, tahun yang penuh tantangan bagi perekonomian Indonesia. Saya mencatat setidaknya 4 tantangan yang dihadapi perekonomian Indonesia pada tahun 2015 ini. Pertama adalah ketidakpastian perekonomian global. Kondisi ekonomi global tahun ini ternyata tidak secerah prakiraan semula. Pemulihan ekonomi global memang terus berlangsung di berbagai ekonomi utama dunia, namun dengan kecepatan yang tidak sesuai dengan harapan dan tidak merata. Hal ini ditunjukkan dengan beberapa kali revisi ke bawah proyeksi pertumbuhan ekonomi dunia oleh berbagai lembaga internasional. Harga komoditas dunia pun terus merosot karena melemahnya permintaan, terutama dari Tiongkok. Sebagai negara dengan perekonomian dan sistem keuangan yang terbuka, Indonesia tidak dapat terlepas dari konstelasi perekonomian global tersebut. Apalagi di tengah divergensi kebijakan moneter dunia dan perubahan persepsi risiko eksternal yang menyebabkan dollar AS dalam skala global terus menguat. Berbagai tekanan eksternal tersebut pada gilirannya menimbulkan instabilitas pada perekonomian domestik, antara lain pelemahan nilai tukar Rupiah, keluarnya aliran modal baik di pasar modal maupun pasar saham, serta naiknya imbal hasil atau yield SBN. 4. Kedua adalah perlambatan pertumbuhan ekonomi. Seperti diketahui bahwa hingga triwulan akhir 111-2015, perekonomian Indonesia tumbuh di bawah 5%. Triwulan I tumbuh 4,71%, triwulan II tumbuh sebesar 4,67%, sementara triwulan III yang baru diumumkan minggu yang lalu naik sedikit menjadi 4,73%. Perlambatan ini disebabkan oleh menurunnya kinerja ekspor akibat berlanjutnya penurunan harga sejumlah komoditas primer utama seperti CPO, karet, batubara dan minyak bumi. Penurunan harga komoditas ini menyebabkan pertumbuhan ekonomi di sebagian besar provinsi, yang perekonomiannya berbasis sumber daya alam, terutama di Sumatera dan Kalimantan, menurun drastis. Bahkan di beberapa provinsi mengalami pertumbuhan negatif seperti Provinsi Kaltim-Kaltara, Riau, dan Aceh. Perlambatan ekonomi ini mulai berdampak kepada kenaikan tingkat pengangguran. Tingkat Pengangguran Terbuka bulan Agustus 2015 yang diumumkan 5 November 2015 yang lalu menunjukkan peningkatan dari 5,9% menjadi 6,2% yang disebabkan oleh penurunan jumlah tenaga kerja di sektor pertanian, industri, dan jasa-jasa. Bahkan kenaikan tingkat pengangguran terbuka di Riau dan Kaltim-Kaltara meningkat melampaui angka 7%. 5. Tantanqan ketiqa adalah implementasi Masvarakat Ekonomi ASEAN (MEA) vang akan dimulai akhir Desember 2015. Pada satu sisi komitmen MEA akan membuka peluang pasar dengan aliran barang, jasa, investasi, tenaga kerja dan modal yang lebih bebas. Namun di sisi lain, hal ini juga memberikan konsekuensi semakin tingginya persaingan di pasar domestik masing-masing negara. Dengan potensi pasar yang massive, saya melihat tantangan berat yang paling mendasar dari komitmen MEA tersebut adalah kemampuan kita menciptakan daya saing yang kompetitif. Mampukah kita memanfaatkan MEA sebagai peluang untuk berperan sebaqai pelaku utama dari rantai produksi global, atau kita hanva akan meniadi target pasar dan penonton? Dalam pandangan saya, pada titik inilah kapabilitas kita untuk membaca dan mengantisipasi gerakan ekonomi ke depan semakin teruji. 6. Tantanqan keempat adalah normalisasi suku bunqa bank sentral Amerika Serikat. Isu ini mendominasi dinamika pasar keuangan baik di advanced economy maupun emerging market sejak Mei 2013. Normalisasi suku bunga ini mengakibatkan ketidakpastian yang seringkali mengubah perilaku risk on-risk off dari investor dengan begitu cepat. Pasca rilis data tenaga kerja Amerika Serikat yang membaik di bulan Oktober 2015, survei Bloomberg menunjukkan ekspektasi pasar terhadap kenaikan suku bunga bank sentral Amerika Serikat, Fed Fund Rate, di Desember 2015 meningkat dari 56% menjadi 68%. Bapak/lbu dan para hadirin yang berbahagia, <KebiJakan Bank Indonesia Terkini> 7. Menghadapi tantangan perekonomian yang cukup berat tersebut, berbagai kebijakan telah dilakukan. Di bidanq moneter, Bl tetap mempertahankan kebijakan moneter bias ketat untuk meniaqa market confidence dan menekan defisit transaksi berjalan. Meskipun tekanan terhadap stabilitas makro mulai mereda sehingga terdapat ruang bagi pelonggaran kebijakan moneter, kami masih perlu mencermati tingginya risiko ketidakpastian global khususnya rencana kenaikan Fed Fund Rate pada bulan Desember mendatang dan kesiapan mitigasi risikonya. 8.Sejalan dengan hal tersebut, fokus kebijakan Bl dalam ianqka pendek tetap diarahkan pada lanqkah-lanqkah stabilisasi nilai tukar, memperkuat penqelolaan likuiditas rupiah, serta memperkuat penqelolaan supply- demand valas. Bank Indonesia juga menyambut baik dan mengapresiasi rangkaian paket kebijakan Pemerintah serta OJK dalam mendukung pertumbuhan ekonomi dan reformasi struktural yang diperlukan untuk memperkuat fondasi perekonomian Indonesia. Berbagai langkah kebijakan ini diharapkan mampu menciptakan iklim investasi yang semakin kondusif yang pada gilirannya dapat memperbaiki outlook perekonomian Indonesia. 9-Beberapa langkah kebijakan tersebut telah memberikan dampak positif meskipun belum sepenuhnya memenuhi harapan. Kabar baik terbit minggu yang lalu dimana Fitch Rating memberikan afirmasi atas rating souverign Indonesia dengan outlook yang stabil (BBB-). Hal ini perlu kita syukuri di tengah volatilitas global yang kembali meningkat. Namun, tekanan terhadap rupiah masih belum akan mereda meskipun Bank Indonesia telah cukup banyak melakukan stabilisasi di pasar valas. Menyadari kompleksnya tantangan yang dihadapi, kami akan terus melanjutkan serta memperkuat koordinasi kebijakan antar institusi. <Confidence dan Persepsi Positif> 10. Kita menyadari bahwa tidaklah mudah bagi kita melalui berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perekonomian. Namun kita harus tetap optimis karena sejarah membuktikan bahwa kita memiliki pengalaman yang baik dalam menjalankan reformasi ekonomi. Pertamaj pada masa sebelum orde lama, Indonesia pernah tercatat dalam buku Economics Development yang ditulis Beniamin Higgins pada tahun 1963 sebagai "the chronic drop out" dan dinyatakan sebagai contoh kegagalan dalam mengelola ekonomi. Namun, dalam waktu 30 tahun, IMF dan World Bank menyatakan Indonesia merupakan salah satu "Asian Miracle", dengan pertumbuhan ekonomi yang tinggi dan stabil, transformasi struktural yang berhasil, serta inflasi yang terkendali. 11. Kedua, pada saat krisis keuangan Asia 1997, kita bersama Thailand dan Korea menjadi neqara yang mengalami dampak paling parah, hingga berujung pada krisis politik dan pergantian kekuasaan. Namun, dengan berbagai reformasi yang kita lakukan, pada global financial crisis 2008, Indonesia bersama Tiongkok dan India menjadi sedikit negara yang bertahan dari pusaran krisis ekonomi dunia terbesar setelah krisis ekonomi 1930, dengan masih tumbuhnya pertumbuhan ekonomi di atas 4%. 12. Pengalaman tersebut menyampaikan pesan kepada kita semua bahwa seberat apapun tantangan akan dapat kita lalui sepanjang kita tetap menjaga confidence serta menyampaikan persepsi positif bahwa kita telah, sedang, dan akan melakukan reformasi struktural. Hal ini yang membutuhkan sinergi Indonesia Incorporated, baik pemerintah, bank sentral, OJK serta kalangan dunia usaha termasuk sektor keuangan dan perbankan. Bapak/lbu, para undangan dan hadirin yang berbahagia, 13. Dalam menqhadapi tantanqan ini, khususnya menqhadapi MEA 2015, para pelaku di sektor keuangan harus mempersiapkan diri denqan sebaik-baiknya agar memiliki dava sainq dan profesionalisme vang tinqqi sehingga menjadi bankir kelas satu. Kita harus dapat menunjukkan bahwa insan-insan perbankan serta profesional sektor keuangan Indonesia adalah yang terbaik di kawasan ASEAN. 14. Beberapa hal berikut perlu kita persiapkan untuk meninqkatkan dava sainq para profesional di sektor keuanqan. Pertama, standarisasi kualitas SDM yang link and match denqan kebutuhan pasar. Pendidikan akademik dituntut untuk memiliki kurikulum dan metode pengajaran yang bisa menghasilkan lulusan yang siap pakai. Oleh karena itu, dunia akademik perlu terus meng- update dirinya dengan perkembangan terkini di dunia keuangan yang terus berkembang. Perlu diberikan waktu khusus bagi mahasiswa-mahasiswi untuk berdiskusi dengan para profesional maupun policy maker di bidang keuangan. 15. Kedua, keberadaan sertifikasi kompetensi di sektor keuangan merupakan suatu keniscayaan. Untuk bersaing dengan para tenaga kerja terampil dari negara-negara ASEAN lainnya, gelar sarjana semata tidak cukup. Sekarang semakin banyak profesi baru yang belum banyak disentuh dan membutuhkan sertifikasi-sertifikasi, baik yang bersifat global maupun nasional. Sarjana akuntansi dan manajemen bisa saja menjadi auditor keuangan, manajemen, dan operasional, tetapi belum tentu semua bisa mengaudit sistem informasi, perangkat lunak, dan sistem aplikasi. Padahal 5 tahun mendatang, kita harus bersaing dengan SDM dari negara-negara anggota MEA. 16. Ketiqa, pentingnya menqasah daya sainq SDM di perbankan serta keuangan svariah. Pasca dikeluarkannya UU No 21 tahun 2008 tentang Perbankan Syariah serta maraknya instrumen keuangan syariah seperti sukuk dan pasar modal syariah telah memicu kebutuhan akan tenaga kerja yang yang sangat besar. Disamping memiliki skill di bidang keuangan, SDM keuangan syariah dituntut untuk memiliki pemahaman pada prinsip-prinsip syariah. Meskipun rasio aset perbankan syariah terhadap aset perbankan saat ini masih di bawah 5%, pasokan SDM di bidang perbankan dan keuangan syariah ini masih terbatas. Menghadapi MEA 2015, apalagi dengan keunggulan negara tetangga kita dalam perbankan dan keuangan syariah, rasanya kita perlu duduk bersama untuk mengatasi hal ini. 17. Last but not least, sebaqai landasan dari tiqa hal di atas, sava menqqarisbawahi pentinqnya pendidikan terhadap inteqritas. Saya meyakini bahwa pengetahuan dan keterampilan yang diwujudkan dengan penguasaan standar kompetensi dan keahlian secara professional tidak akan berarti tanpa integritas yang baik, karena bisnis di sektor keuangan adalah bisnis kepercayaan. Bapak/lbu, para undangan dan hadirin yang berbahagia, 18. Akhir kata, kami mengucapkan selamat kepada STIE IBS yang berhasil meluluskan sekitar 120 alumni pada wisuda tahun 2015 ini. Semoga hal ini menjadi motivasi yang lebih baik lagi untuk melahirkan lulusan- lulusan STIE IBS yang lebih baik pada tahun tahun berikutnya. Saya juga mengucapkan selamat kepada para wisudawan-wisudawati STIE IBS. Gelar kesarjanaan maupun magister yang Saudara raih hari ini merupakan bekal Saudara sekalian untuk memasuki dunia baru. Setelah dibekali ilmu perbankan dan keuangan di kampus STIE IBS ini, kinilah saatnya saudara menciptakan value. Saya selalu ingat kata-kata Einstein, "Try not to become a man of success, but rather try to become a man of value. " 19. Semoga niat baik kita untuk membangun bangsa dan negara melalui pengembangan insan perbankan dan sektor keuangan yang berkualitas dan berintegritas senantiasa memperoleh ridho dari Allah SWT. Sekian dan terima kasih. Wassalamualaikum Wr Wb. Jakarta, 14 November 2015 Deputi Gubernur Hendar

Title: A New Phase of Islamic Finance: Capturing the Untapped Area to Improve the Quality of Economic Development (Press Conference by Halim Alamsyah Deputy Governor of Bank Indonesia At The 3rd Bank Indonesia International Seminar on Islamic Finance (BI-ISIF) B
text: Press Conference by Mr. Halim Alamsyah  Deputy Governor of BI The 3rd Bank Indonesia International Seminar on Islamic Finance (BI-ISIF) A New Phase of Islamic Finance: Capturing the Untapped Area to Improve the Quality of Economic Development  Bank Indonesia has held The 3d Bank Indonesias International Seminar on Islamic Finance on 30-31 May 2013, in Bali. The them of the seminar this time is A New Phase of Islamic Finance: Capturing the Untapped Area to Improve the Quality of Economic Development  This BI-ISIF is the third seminar, involving more or less 200 regulators, practitioners, and academicians related to sharia finance and banking both domestic and foreign, and present 20 prominent speakers in the field of sharia finance and economy, among others Islamic Development Bank, State Bank of Pakistan, Bank Negara Malaysia, including International Institutions such as World Bank, International Monetary Fund and Asian Development Bank, and academia from International Islamic University of Islamabad (Pakistan).  The selection of the theme is based on the idea that in the midst of the rapid growth of sharia financial industry, the quality side of the growth also needs to receive attention, without prejudice to the fulfillment of the basic essence and norms of sharia which it is based. Besides, sharia financial industry needs to show its true identity as important supporter of the recovery process and growth of the real sector. The sharia finance must very much involve in advancing social condition of the community, inclusive finance, and financing of various government projects. All are done to achieve the objective or maqasid syariah (Islamic objective) and falah (welfare).  One of the efforts to improve quality of Indonesias economic growth is through more increasing focus of financing from sharia banking to more productive sector. In order to promote this effort, national banking, including sharia banking, needs to increase its financing to productive sector in accordance with its risk profile and capital capability. The larger the bank capital, the bigger its financing portion toward the productive sector. To increase capacities of micro and small entrepreneurs, banks also need to channel their financing to MSME with certain portion from their total financing.  Various efforts to increase the growth quality also need to be supported by increasing the community accessibility to financial services through programs of finance inclusion that become the worlds financial focus at present. This program is intended to eliminate (or reduce) barriers for the community to get access to financial services in order to increase their standard of living which is very much in line with the sharia financial industry as its focus and objective is to create a balance. This program also aims to reduce gap of density level of banking in various areas, especially between unbanked/less banked areas in eastern Indonesia, compared to the highly banked areas in Java and Bali.  Not to be missed, product innovation supported by quality human resources is an important effort to encourage quality economic growth. Product innovation that brings uniqueness and purity of sharia banking products can provide financial service alternatives for the general community. The growth of sustainable sharia banking will encourage more healthy economic growth, as the characteristic of sharia banking that always be based on the real sector as underlying assets, forbid gharar (deceptive uncertainty), and support profit/loss sharing through zakat (obligatory alms), sodaqoh (charity), etc. so as to support social welfare.  The topic of the seminar this time still has a relation to the topics of the previous seminars. The last two BI-ISIF seminars focused on the issue of policy in order to maintain the high growth rate of sharia banking, among others through the development of product variations and human resources, as well as the strengthening of sharia banking role for productive economic activities. In reality, the growth of sharia banking remains high, followed by the improvement of asset structure marked by the return increase of productive financing allocations (in a form of working capital and investment) on one side, and deceleration of consumer financing on the other side1, including a portion of qard (gold-backed bailout) financing potentially utilized for speculative action that is unsound for the 1 Strengthening of sharia bank focus on production sector financing encourages increase of the financing of working capital and investment of BUS and UUS of Rp23.1 trillion, or 38.7% (yoy) higher compared to year 2011 with a growth rate of 31.7% (yoy). Meanwhile, the increase of consumption financing at the same period amounting to Rp21.8 trillion or 50.6% (yoy), decelerated from the 2011 growth of 87.9% (yoy). financial system. Therefore, on this third organization of BI-ISIF, the focus of discussions shall be directed to reassess the essence and objective of sharia finance, and also to dig sources of new industrial growth.  Some subjects in this seminar cover economic review on sharia norms, among others in the context of financial system stability, social and financial inclusion, and also economic function of the government, which is meant to review and find improvement solution in the application of sharia financial on government sector especially which related to the financing of development and infrastructure, where sharia banking currently has not contributed much. Inclusive growth topic will also be discussed with the focus on the expansion of sharia financial institutions roles, including sharia banking in enforcing inclusion of community finance among others through the implementation of social function. The other function is the implementation of a macro-prudential policy, particularly in the context of sharia finance, which will be one of the focuses of Bank Indonesia in the future.  Various episodes of financial crisis have given a lesson that banking industry should focus on its basic function as the provider of financing to the real sector and productive business, in the sense of providing added values to the economy. Such function is very much in accordance with the characteristic of sharia banking developed in Indonesia that constantly shows high intermediation capability to the real sector and does not engage in speculative activities (among other reflected by financing to deposit ratio of sharia conventional banks (BUS) averaging at 90%). Following the strengthening of sharia financial popularity in the landscape of international finance as one the industries with high growth, the organizing of this seminar is also intended to echo the progress and strength of Indonesias sharia banking characteristics above2, aside from expanding cooperation with regulators and actors of international sharia financial.  Indonesias sharia banking industry is expected to further growing rapidly in 2013. With various scenarios of domestic and global economic condition, total assets of sharia banking is projected to grow at level 31% (pessimistic scenario, i.e. of Rp255 trillion) to 50% (optimistic scenario of Rp296 trillion) yoy at the end of 2013. To support the sharia banking industry in order to maintain its high growth, 2 Asset growth of Indonesias sharia banking reached 48.6% (2011) and 34.0% (2012), higher than the growth of global sharia financial industry estimated between 15-20% per annum. Bank Indonesia in cooperation with the relevant authorities will implement policies among others in the form of: o Sharia Banking Financing that Leads More toward the Sectors of Economic Productive and Wider Community. As with the direction of sharia banking in the previous year, in 2013 sharia banking is directed to develop services of production sectors financing. Some breakthroughs that might be taken among others are by entering projects within the government priority scale such as construction, electricity and gas, agriculture and creative industry, productive sector for start-up business, and MSME sector. The policy direction to the productive sector must also be balanced with service equality to provide sharia banking inclusivity to all society crossing regional boundaries and economic capacity limits. o Product Development that Better Meet the Needs of Community and Productive Sector. Bank Indonesia will prioritize supports for development products related to productive sector and be able to better meet the needs of the general public. Those supports among others are to be given through improvement of regulations, product licensing process, product assessment and dissemination of knowledge and skills to analyze financing/productive sector through activities among others workshops and seminars. o Supervisory Transition While Maintaining the Continuity of Sharia Banking Development. After the enactment of Law on OJK (Financial Service Authority), the regulatory and supervisory functions of sharia banking will be transferred to OJK at the end of 2013. In order to smoothen the transfer process, while still maintaining the continuity of banking supervision, Bank Indonesia has prepared various infrastructure required in addition to the new mechanism and coordination process between various existing institutions both nationally and internationally. Besides, development of various regulations on sharia banking related to the management of risk concentration and governance such as sharia bank capitals or guidance on new products and activities, which all are expected to strengthen the resilience of sharia banking during the transition period and ahead.  With the various policies above, it is expected that the growth of sharia banking will continue to increase to the direction that support the economic growth of Indonesia that has better quality. By considering that Indonesia still requires large funding for infrastructure development, and for empowering economic potential in various sector with productive local wealth-based such as agricultural, marine and industrial sectors, and considering the importance of community financial access expansion, the sharia financial industry, including domestic sharia banking which also supported by international sharia financial actors, is expected to continue expanding in untapped areas referred to and to increase their contribution to the economic growth. Thank you. Wabillahi taufik walhidayah, wassalamu alaikum warrahmatullahi wabarakaatuh. Dr. Halim Alamsyah

Title: Speech of the Deputy Governor of Bank Indonesia Ronald Waas Launch of Digital Financial Services and Electronification at Islamic Boarding Schools (Pesantren), Surabaya, 30th October 2015
Subtitle: Launch of Digital Financial Services and Electronification at Islamic Boarding Schools (Pesantren
text: Speech of the Deputy Governor of Bank Indonesia Launch of Digital Financial Services and Electronification at Islamic Boarding Schools (Pesantren) Surabaya, 30th October 2015 Distinguished leaders of Pondok Pesantren Daruut Tauhiid, Bandung Distinguished leaders of Pondok Pesantren Al-Mawaddah, East Java Directors of telecommunications companies PT Telkomsel, PT XL Axiaata and PT Indosat Leaders and employees of Bank Indonesia Ladies and Gentlemen Good day. 1. First of all, let me begin my expressing thanks to the Lord God Almighty for bestowing His blessings that we can all congregate here today to Launch Digital Financial Services at Pesantren along with electronification. 2. This event is part of the 2015 Indonesia Sharia Economic Festival (ISEF) with the theme Empowering the Islamic Economy and Finance towards National Prosperity. Ladies and Gentlemen: 3. History has recorded the interminable journey of Indonesia from the era of struggle and fighting for independence to gaining independence, which were inescapably linked to the role played by santri (Islamic students) who devoted their lives to Indonesias independence and sovereignty. 4. We are all familiar with various national leaders and figureheads who have come from a pesantren background and devoted their lives to the advancement of Indonesia, including the Fourth President of the Republic of Indonesia, Kiai Haji Abdurrahman Wahid, more affectionately known as Gus Dur. The list also includes Syamsuddin, Kiai Haji Hasyim Musyadi and Nurcholis Madjid, which serves to emphasise that the journey of Indonesia is inextricably linked to Islamic boarding schools that are spread throughout the archipelago. 5. Moving forward, we discern an increasingly strategic role for pesantren in various aspects of life in Indonesia, including the economy and, specifically, the Islamic economy. In addition to producing Islamic human resources, pesantren also empower the community, including in relation to the economy and Islamic finance. Ladies and Gentlemen: 6. Indonesia is the most populous Muslim country in the world, therefore, the role of Islamic boarding schools (pesantren) to catalyse development of sharia-compliant financial services is both strategic and crucial. 7. Furthermore, the charisma of leaders at pesantren as role models, as well as the broad network of santri and alumni, coupled with the propensity to develop small businesses, are all supporting factors for pesantren to develop sharia-compliant financial services. 8. To that end, we view prospective efforts to synergise pesantren with players in the financial services industry as promising. Consequently, Bank Indonesia would like to facilitate that process through electronic money issued using Digital Financial Services (DFS). 9. Digital Financial Services (DFS) offer payment system and financial services using third parties as agents and exploiting technology, including cellular telephone technology. This innovative breakthrough answers the challenge of broadening public access to formal financial services wherever they may reside. 10. Efforts to synergise pesantren through electronic money are part of the broader BI strategy to expand financial access to the Muslim population, known as the Islamic Financial Inclusion (IFI) Strategy. Ladies and Gentlemen: 11. As a preliminary measure, Bank Indonesia is facilitating synergy between telecommunications companies (telecoms) and Islamic boarding schools (pesantren). According to the business model developed by Bank Indonesia, synergy between telecoms and pesantren is supported by the respective advantages of each party. 12. Telecoms with their vast experience in serving rural areas have the advantage of technology and communications as well as the necessary e-money applications that are linked to individual phone numbers. Pesantren, on the other hand, are influencers of local communities. 13. Three large telecoms, namely PT Telkomsel, PT Indosat and PT XL Axiata, have signed up for the trials of digital financial services at two pesantren, specifically Daruut Tauhiid in Bandung and Al-Mawaddah in East Java, though a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) that we just witnessed the signing of. 14. The trials at Daruut Tauhiid use a synergic business model with a telecom as the DFS host and a business unit at the pesantren as the DFS partner. 15. At Al-Mawaddah, however, cooperation extends to facilitating school payments from parents to the santri, as well as providing a merchant function to the business unit of the pesantren. 16. Supporting the trials and as we just witnessed a moment ago, Bank Indonesia has signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoU) with PT Telkomsel, PT Indosat and PT XL Axiata to develop the public price information dissemination program through the telecommunications network, including implementation of the National Non-Cash Movement (GNNT). 17. The goal of the MoU is to coordinate and synergise the execution of duties at Bank Indonesia and telecoms in order to support and optimise the public price information dissemination program and foster price stability as well as facilitate GNNT implementation and financial inclusion. Ladies and Gentlemen: 18. The introduction of Digital Financial Services at both pesantren represents a seminal moment in terms of non-cash implementation and we sincerely hope that other pesantren will follow suit. 19. We expect that for those involved with pesantren, DFS will provide more secure, efficient and convenient financial transactions, thereby mitigating the risk of loss. 20. For Bank Indonesia, however, DFS trials have four overarching purposes: (i) to obtain input and feedback on business model development in the community; (ii) to observe the constraints in the field along with mitigation efforts; (iii) to understand public interest; and (iv) to provide regulatory recommendations. 21. DFS trials are also being conducted at other pesantren in order to garner a more comprehensive picture. We expect to produce a generic model from the trials that could be applied to pesantren nationally. 22. In closing, I would like to express my sincere appreciation to all attendees for their active participation and support concerning this event as well as DFS implementation at pesantren. 23. May all our undertakings be blessed by the Lord God Almighty and let Him give us the strength to carry on. Thank you. Deputy Governor of Bank Indonesia Ronald Waas

Title: Speech of The Deputy Governor of Bank Indonesia, Ronald Waas in The Inauguration of Application of Money Settlements For Transactions In The Capital Market By Using BI-RTGS System, Jakarta, 29 June 2015
text: SPEECH OF THE DEPUTY GOVERNOR OF BANK INDONESIA IN THE INAUGURATION OF APPLICATION OF MONEY SETTLEMENTS FOR TRANSACTIONS IN THE CAPITAL MARKET BY USING BI-RTGS SYSTEM Jakarta, 29 June 2015 Distinguished: - Deputy Commissioner II of Capital Market Supervisor of the Financial Services Authority (OJK) of Indonesia, Mr. M. Noor Rachman; - President Director of PT. Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia, Mrs. Margeret Tang; - Chair and Management of Indonesian Custodian Bank Association (ABKI); - Heads of Departments of the Financial Services Authority (OJK) of Indonesia; - Heads of Departments of Bank Indonesia; - Heads of Banks in Indonesia; and - Ladies and gentlemen. Good Afternoon and May God Bless Us All 1. To begin my speech this afternoon, I would like to invite all of us to praise God the Almighty for giving us the opportunity to be in a favorable condition to attend this inauguration of Implementation of Use of BI-RTGS System in Money Settlements for Transactions in the Capital Market. 2. On this favorable occasion, on behalf of all members of the Board of Governors of Bank Indonesia, please allow me to extend my deepest appreciation and gratitude to all parties involved in this cooperation, namely Bank Indonesia, the Financial Services Authority (OJK), Indonesian Central Securities Depository (KSEI), and Custodian Banks, for successfully implementing the use of BI-RTGS System in money Page 1 of 5 settlements for transactions in the Capital Market, or also known as Central Bank Money. Ladies and gentlemen, 3. In the capacity as the Central Bank, the main task of Bank Indonesia is to maintain not only monetary stability, but also financial system stability. Successful monetary stability maintenance by Bank Indonesia without financial system stability maintenance will have less significance in supporting sustainable economic growth. 4. Financial system plays a very significant role in the economy. Experiences show that unstable financial system, which further causes crisis, will result in very high salvage costs. Learning from the past experiences, Bank Indonesia considers that efforts to avoid or reduce potential unstable financial system risks are highly necessary, primarily to avoid a tremendous loss. 5. Bank Indonesia as a macroprudential authority consistently observes every development of the financial system and will take necessary policies to anticipate and mitigate systemic risks, as well as credit, liquidity, and market risks, thereby ensuring maintained financial system stability. Ladies and gentlemen, 6. Stability of the Money Market and Capital Market is a vital component to create financial system stability. Any turbulence in the two markets, which are caused by global or domestic factors, may trigger financial system instability, which may eventually result in a financial crisis. Therefore, in performing the task to maintain financial system stability, Bank Indonesia pays full attention to the development of the Money Market and Capital Market. Page 2 of 5 7. Based on such consideration, Bank Indonesia warmly welcomes and greatly supports the applied use of BI-RTGS System in Money Settlements for Transactions in the Capital Market, which we consider as one of the efforts to mitigate credit and liquidity risks in the implementation of money settlements for securities transactions. 8. By the application of Central Bank Money, mitigation will be possible against credit risks which may occur from potential default by Payment Banks on their obligations. The same applies to liquidity risks, which may occur when any Participants fail to transfer their assets in a quick manner because the relevant Payment Banks are suffering from liquidity problems. By the application of Central Bank Money, such liquidity risks may be mitigated. 9. In addition to risk mitigation, another advantage of money settlements for transactions in the Capital Market through BI-RTGS System is the creation of competitive neutrality because any Banks may perform money settlements for transactions in the Capital Market and they do not depend on any particular Banks. Application of Central Bank Money also increases liquidity management efficiency of every Bank as banks do not necessarily have to own accounts with any other institutions for money settlements for transactions in the Capital Market. Ladies and gentlemen, 10. Bank Indonesias mission in payment system is to manage and maintain secure, efficient, and smooth Payment and Money Management System through access expansion and by considering the national interest. Such mission will be accomplished through two important aspects: first, strengthening of Payment System, and second, being proactive in pioneering cooperation and collaboration. Page 3 of 5 11. Bank Indonesias contribution to the implementation of Central Bank Money in Money Settlements for Transactions in the Capital Market is one of our concrete efforts to accomplish such mission in payment system. Cooperation and collaboration between Bank Indonesia and OJK, KSEI, and Custodian Banks may strengthen payment system in Indonesia, particularly for transactions in the Capital Market. 12. The synergic collaboration is expected to contribute to the economy, monetary stability, and financial system stability by considering the aspects of access expansion and national interest. Therefore, Bank Indonesia will be consistently active to encourage the use of BI-RTGS System in money settlements for transactions in the Capital Market. 13. From the international perspective, application of central bank money in money settlements for transactions in the Capital Market follows the recommendation in the Principles for Financial Market Infrastructures (PFMIs), issued by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and the International Organization of Securities Commissions (IOSCO), particularly Principle 9: Money Settlements, specifying that Financial Market Infrastructure should conduct its money settlements by using current accounts (rekening giro) with the central bank. Ladies and gentlemen, 14. Application of money settlements for transactions in the Capital Market by using BI- RTGS System is an important achievement of the cooperation between Bank Indonesia, OJK, KSEI, and Custodian Banks. Such implementation serves as the first step of using Central Bank Money in money settlements for all Securities transactions in the Capital Market, which will be further developed in phases. Therefore, we expect such constructive cooperation may be continuously improved, so that the next implementation phase may be immediately realized. Page 4 of 5 15. To conclude, may God the Almighty accept all of our efforts for the development of our country, nation, and people and we all be blessed with the strength to implement such efforts. Thank you. Deputy Governor of Bank Indonesia Ronald Waas Page 5 of 5

Title: Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia Agus D.W. Martowardojo pada Sosialisasi Program Pengendalian Inflasi BI, Jakarta, 25 April 2016
text: REMARKS BY THE GOVERNOR OF BANK INDONESIA ON SOCIALIZATION OF BI INFLATION CONTROL PROGRAM Jakarta, 25th April 2016 Which we respect, 95 Governor of Central Java, Mr. H. Ganjar Pranowo, 95 Member of The Board of Governors of Bank Indonesia, 95 Officials of the Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs, Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Cooperatives and SMEs, Ministry of Trade, and Ministry of National Development Planning, 95 Local Government Leaders or those representing, 95 Mr. Prof. DR. Bustanul Arifin, 95 Head of Banking, Academia and Associations, 95 Head of BI Work Unit at Head Office and Head of Bank Indonesia Representative Office, 95 The perpetrators, attendees and invitees were happy. Assalamu'alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh, Good morning and greetings to all of us. 1. Starting this speech, we would like to invite all of us to express our praise and gratitude to the presence of Allah SWT, God Almighty, because for His mercy and grace on this occasion we can participate in the event "Socialization of Bank Indonesia Inflation Control Program". 2. We welcome the implementation of this event, which is a reflection of the cooperation in controlling price stability that has been well established between Bank Indonesia and The Ministry of Agriculture, Local Government, and other relevant stakeholders. Ladies and gentlemen and ladies and gentlemen whom we respect, 3. In accordance with the mandate of the Law, Bank Indonesia is an independent authority that carries out functions and duties in the fields of monetary, macroprudential banking supervision, and payment system. Bank Indonesia aims to achieve and maintain Rupiah stability, which is reflected in two aspects, namely the Rupiah exchange rate and the inflation rate. In line with this mandate, Bank Indonesia has an interest in maintaining inflation at a lace and stable level. 4. Why does the inflation rate need to be maintained? There are at least three reasons, first, inflation is eating away at people's real incomes, which in turn will decrease purchasing power. Inflation makes people poorer, and makes people who are already poor become poorer. Second, uncontrolled inflation creates uncertainty. High inflation affects consumption, investment, and production behavior, ultimately impacting economic growth. Ribs, uncontrolled inflation leads to inefficiency and creates a high cost economy. This will certainly reduce economic competitiveness. 5. Taking this into account, efforts to control inflation need to be our common concern. In-flasi stability is a prerequisite for achieving sustainable economic growth, which will then improve the welfare of the Indonesian people. Besides that is, high economic growth becomes less meaningful if it is followed by a high increase in inflation as well. Ladies and gentlemen and happy attendees, 6. To achieve this goal, Bank Indonesia continues to implement a prudent and consistent policy mix. However, we recognize that achieving low and stable inflation requires cross-agency coordination. This is considering that inflation characteristics in Indonesia are still vulnerable to being influenced by factors from the supply side, be it disruptions in production, distribution, or government policies. To that end, Bank Indonesia continues to strengthen synergy with the Government and other relevant authorities to ensure that inflation control can run properly and effectively. 7. The various efforts made have paid off. In 2015, amidst various challenges that are not light, the stabilizationof indonesia's macroeconomic and financial system can be maintained. This is reflected, among others, in the achievement of the 2015 inflation target which was recorded at 3.35% (yoy). In addition, the upward trend in inflation in the last 10 years is likely to fall. Average inflation in the period 2010 - 2015 reached 5.86%, lower than the average inflation for the period 2005 - 2010 of 8.52%. This is a positive achievement considering that Indonesia's inflation has increased significantly in 2005, 2008, 2013, and 2014, reaching 17.11%, 11.06%, 8.38%, and 8.36%, respectively, as a result of policies reduction of fuel subsidies. 8. On this occasion, let us express our appreciation and gratitude to all parties for the establishment of harmonious coordination and cooperation in efforts to control inflation. In particular, we also express our appreciation to The government has adopted a policy of reducing fuel subsidies, and diverting funds for the allocation of fuel subsidies to finance infrastructure development and social protection for the poor. In addition, we welcome the Government's various economic policy packages aimed at maintaining the momentum of national economic growth. 9. Not to forget, we would like to express our gratitude to all parties who have provided support for the formation of TPID. The number of TPIDs has now reached 451, where all provinces already have TPIDs and the rest in regencies/cities spread throughout Indonesia. Ladies and gentlemen and ladies and gentlemen whom we respect, 10. This achievement should not make us complacent quickly. There are at least two ha I that need our collective attention. First, Indonesia's inflation in general is still higher than other countries, especially ASEAN 5 members, namely Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, and Singapore, which in 2015 reached 2.7%, respectively; 1,5%; -0,85%; and -0.6%. We need to take steps so that the inflation gap can be reduced so that Indonesia can be more competitive in ASEAN. 11. Second, we need to be aware of increasing inflationary pressures from food crop commodities, especially rice, red chili, shallots, garlic, purebred chicken meat, and beef. Historically, volatile commodities have been the main contributors to inflation. This phenomenon also occurred in March 2016. 12. Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation in March 2016 was recorded at 0.19% (mtm), higher than february 2016 of -0.09% and higher than its 6-year history . last (0.05%). Annually, CPI inflation in March 2016 reached 4.45% (yoy) or cumulative January - March 2016 of 0.62% (ytd). 13. The increase in inflation was mainly attributable to volatile foods. Inflation of volatile food for the period of March 2016 is recorded 0.75% (mtm) or 9.59% (yoy), up from the previous month with deflation of -0.68% (mtm). Inflationary pressures on volatile foods in this period primarily stemmed from shallots in line with the increasing intensity of rain and the end of the harvest period. 14. Shallot inflation in March rose significantly, reaching 30.86% (mtm). In the last 5 years, shallot inflation even reached 79.01% (mtm) in March 2013; 60.03% (mtm) in July 2013; and 35.78% (mtm) in December 2015. The commodity weight of shallots is high at 0.66% (mtm). If the increase is more than 10%, then the contribution of shallots can reach more than 0.07% to CPI inflation. With a price increase of 30.86% (mtm) in March 2016, shallot inflation contributed 0.16% from inflation of 0.19% (mtm) or around 80% of national inflation. Father/Mother and ladies and gentlemen, 15. Responding to high inflation of volatile foods commodities, Bank Indonesia initiated several inflation control programs . Bank Indonesia has developed a Strategic Food Price Information Center (PIHPS) that serves as a medium for food price transparency. With the existence of PIHPS, it is hoped that it will create price convergence so as to reduce price fluctuations. 16. Bank Indonesia also implements the Inflation Control Program through cluster development implemented by all Bank Indonesia Representative Offices. The presence of this cluster is expected to increase the productivity of food commodities contributing to inflation, namely through a value chain approach from upstream to downstream. Bank Indonesia's activities include facilitation and technical assistance, breakthrough and pilot initiatives that can boost the productivity of commodities contributing to inflation. 17. Since 2014, inflation control programs through cluster development have focused on commodities that contribute to inflation or support food security, namely rice, shallots, red chilies, daging beef and garlic. 18. Currently, the number of commodity clusters contributing to inflation and food security reaches 167 clusters, covering 13 commodities. In particular, the number of commodity clusters contributing to inflation (rice, shallots, red chilies, and beef) has reached 113 clusters. These clusters are spread across java as many as 35 clusters; Sumatra as many as 24 clusters; Kalimantan as many as 13 clusters; and Sulawesi, Maluku, Papua, Bali, Nusa Tenggara as many as 41 clusters. The cluster assisted by Bank Indonesia currently involves more than 11,000 farmers with a land area of nearly 8,000 ha. 19. Bank Indonesia has also made a breakthrough in developing garlic seeds in collaboration with local governments, relevant agencies/agencies, and academics. The initiative was carried out through the development of a garlic demonstration plot as wide as 3,000 square meters in Tegal Regency which has produced 22.58 tons of garlic per hectare acre. The seed varieties developed have proven to be able to compete with imported white b awang, both in terms of quality and meeting people's tastes. This positive achievement will be followed up with the development of garlic clusters in other regions, especially in Central Java Province. It is expected that the development of garlic clusters can suppress inflation and reduce import dependence. 20. Furthermore, Bank Indonesia together with the Brebes Regional Government also built an shallot training center that opens up opportunities for stakeholders from all over the country to learn onion cultivation. red with the support of the latest technology, so that it can meet industry standards, from production to harvest and post-harvest. 21. We believe that the inflation control program in the form of cluster development by Bank Indonesia with the Ministry of Agriculture and Local Governments has become an initiative and inspiration and reference for the policy makers in the regions. Ladies and gentlemen and ladies and gentlemen whom we respect, 22. Efforts to control inflation in the future will face challenges that are not light. However, Bank Indonesia believes inflation this year 2016 will be in the target range of 4.0%b1l%. Coordination between Bank Indonesia and the Central and Regional Governments needs to be strengthened so that relevant parties can synergize various policies and measures needed. 23. Today's event is expected to further strengthen the commitment of all of us in seeking more effective inflation control. On this occasion, there will also be a Performance Appreciation of the Inflation Control Award Program as an award for the achievement of the performance and participation of stakeholders in increasing the supply of volatile foods commodities. 24. As we can say, may God Almighty always take our steps in an effort to implement the Inflation Control Program, including those based on the development of food security commodities and commodities that are the source of inflationary pressure. Thank you. Wassalamu'alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh. Agus D.W. Martowardojo Governor of Bank Indonesia
text_original: SAMBUTAN GUBERNUR BANK INDONESIA SOSIALISASI PROGRAM PENGENDALIAN INFLASI BI Jakarta, 25 April 2016 Yang kami hormati, <95> Gubernur Jawa Tengah, Bapak H. Ganjar Pranowo, <95> Anggota Dewan Gubernur Bank Indonesia, <95> Pejabat Kementerian Koordinasi Bidang Perekonomian, Kementerian Pertanian, Kementerian Koperasi dan UKM, Kementerian Perdagangan, dan Kementerian Perencanaan Pembangunan Nasional, <95> Para Pimpinan Pemerintahan Daerah atau yang mewakili, <95> Bapak Prof. DR. Bustanul Arifin, <95> Pimpinan Perbankan, Akademisi dan Asosiasi, <95> Pimpinan Satuan Kerja BI di Kantor Pusat dan Kepala Kantor Perwakilan Bank Indonesia, <95> Para pelaku klaster, hadirin dan undangan yang berbahagia. Assalamu'alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh, Selamat pagi dan salam sejahtera untuk kita semua. 1. Mengawali sambutan ini, kami ingin mengajak kita semua untuk memanjatkan puji dan syukur ke hadirat Allah SWT, Tuhan Yang Maha Kuasa, karena atas rahmat dan karunia-Nya pada kesempatan ini kita dapat mengikuti acara "Sosialisasi Program Pengendalian Inflasi Bank Indonesia". 2. Kami menyambut baik pelaksanaan acara ini, yang merupakan cerminan kerjasama pengendalian stabilitas harga yang selama ini telah terjalin dengan baik antara Bank Indonesia dengan Kementerian Pertanian, Pemerintah Daerah, maupun stakeholders terkait lainnya. Bapak/Ibu dan hadirin yang kami hormati, 3. Sesuai dengan amanat Undang-Undang, Bank Indonesia adalah otoritas independen yang menjalankan fungsi dan tugas di bidang moneter, pengawasan perbankan secara makroprudensial, dan sistem pembayaran. Bank Indonesia memiliki tujuan mencapai dan memelihara kestabilan Rupiah yang tercermin dari dua aspek, yaitu nilai tukar Rupiah dan tingkat inflasi. Sejalan dengan mandat ini, Bank Indonesia berkepentingan menjaga inflasi pada level yang rendah dan stabil. 4. Mengapa tingkat inflasi perlu dijaga? Setidaknya terdapat tiga alasan, pertama, inflasi menggerogoti pendapatan riil masyarakat, yang pada gilirannya akan menurunkan daya beli. Inflasi membuat masyarakat menjadi lebih miskin, dan membuat masyarakat yang sudah miskin menjadi semakin miskin. Kedua, inflasi yang tidak terkendali menciptakan ketidakpastian. Inflasi yang tinggi da pat mempengaruhi perilaku konsumsi, investasi, dan produksi, yang pada akhirnya berdampak pada pertumbuhan ekonomi. Ketiga, inflasi yang tidak terkendali menyebabkan inefisiensi dan menciptakan ekonomi biaya tinggi. Hal ini tentunya akan menurunkan daya saing perekonomian. 5. Memperhatikan hal itu, upaya pengendalian inflasi perlu menjadi perhatian kita bersama. Kestabilan inflasi merupakan prasyarat tercapainya pertumbuhan ekonomi yang berkesinambungan, yang kemudian akan meningkatkan kesejahteraan rakyat Indonesia. Selain itu, pertumbuhan ekonomi yang tinggi menjadi kurang bermakna apabila diikuti oleh kenaikan inflasi yang tinggi pula. Bapak/Ibu dan hadirin yang berbahagia, 6. Untuk mencapai tujuan tersebut, Bank Indonesia senantiasa menjalankan bauran kebijakan yang prudent dan konsisten. Namun, kami menyadari bahwa pencapaian inflasi yang rendah dan stabil memerlukan koordinasi lintas instansi. Hal ini mengingat karakteristik inflasi di Indonesia masih rentan dipengaruhi oleh faktor dari sisi suplai, baik itu gangguan produksi, distribusi, maupun kebijakan Pemerintah. Sehubungan dengan itu, Bank Indonesia terus memperkuat sinergi dengan Pemerintah dan otoritas terkait guna memastikan pengendalian inflasi dapat berjalan dengan baik dan efektif. 7. Berbagai upaya yang dilakukan telah membuahkan hasil. Di tahun 2015, ditengah berbagai tantangan yang tidak ringan, stabilitas makroekonomi dan sistem keuangan Indonesia dapat tetap terjaga. Hal ini tercermin antara lain dari tercapainya target inflasi 2015 yang tercatat sebesar 3,35% (yoy). Selain itu, tren kenaikan inflasi dalam 10 tahun terakhir cenderung turun. Rata-rata inflasi pada periode 2010 - 2015 mencapai 5,86%, lebih rendah dibandingkan rata-rata inflasi periode 2005 - 2010 sebesar 8,52%. Hal ini merupakan pencapaian yang positif mengingat inflasi Indonesia pernah naik signifikan pada tahun 2005, 2008, 2013, dan 2014, yaitu masing- masing mencapai 17,11%, 11,06%, 8,38%, dan 8,36%, akibat dari kebijakan pengurangan subsidi BBM. 8. Pada kesempatan ini, perkenankan kami menyampaikan apresiasi dan ucapan terima kasih kepada seluruh pihak atas terjalinnya koordinasi dan kerjasama yang harmonis dalam upaya pengendalian inflasi. Secara khusus, kami juga menyampaikan apresiasi kepada Pemerintah yang telah menempuh kebijakan pengurangan subsidi BBM, dan mengalihkan dana alokasi subsidi BBM untuk membiayai pembangunan infrastruktur dan perlindungan sosial bagi masyarakat miskin. Selain itu, kami menyambut baik berbagai paket kebijakan ekonomi Pemerintah yang bertujuan untuk menjaga momentum pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional. 9. Tidak lupa, ucapan terima kasih kami sampaikan kepada seluruh pihak yang telah memberikan dukungan terhadap pembentukan TPID. Jumlah TPID saat ini telah mencapai 451, dimana seluruh provinsi telah memiliki TPID dan sisanya di kabupaten/kota yang tersebar di seluruh Indonesia. Bapak/Ibu dan hadirin yang kami hormati, 10. Pencapaian ini hendaknya tidak membuat kita cepat berpuas diri. Terdapat setidaknya dua ha I yang perlu mendapat perhatian kita bersama. Pertama, inflasi Indonesia secara umum masih lebih tinggi dibandingkan negara lain, khususnya anggota ASEAN 5, yaitu Malaysia, Filipina, Thailand, dan Singapura, yang pada tahun 2015 masing-masing mencapai 2,7%; 1,5%; -0,85%; dan -0,6%. Kita perlu mengupayakan langkah-langkah agar kesenjangan inflasi tersebut dapat dikurangi sehingga Indonesia dapat lebih memiliki daya saing di ASEAN. 11. Kedua, kita perlu mewaspadai peningkatan tekanan inflasi dari komoditas tanaman pangan, terutama beras, cabai merah, bawang merah, bawang putih, daging ayam ras, dan daging sapi. Secara historis, komoditas volatile foods merupakan penyumbang utama inflasi. Fenomena ini juga terjadi pada bulan Maret 2016 yang lalu. 12. Inflasi Indek Harga konsumen (IHK) di bulan Maret 2016 tercatat sebesar 0,19% (mtm), lebih tinggi dibandingkan dengan Februari 2016 sebesar -0,09% dan lebih tinggi dari historisnya selama 6 tahun terakhir (0,05%). Secara tahunan, inflasi IHK bulan Maret 2016 mencapai 4,45% (yoy) atau kumulatif Januari - Maret 2016 sebesar 0,62% (ytd). 13. Peningkatan inflasi tersebut terutama disebabkan oleh kelompok volatile foods. Inflasi volatile food periode Maret 2016 tercatat sebesar 0,75% (mtm) atau 9,59% (yoy), meningkat dibandingkan bulan lalu yang deflasi sebesar -0,68% (mtm). Inflasi volatile food pada periode ini terutama bersumber dari komoditas bawang merah seiring meningkatnya intensitas hujan dan berakhirnya masa panen. 14. Inflasi Bawang Merah di Bulan Maret naik signifikan, yaitu mencapai 30,86% (mtm). Dalam 5 tahun terakhir, inflasi bawang merah bahkan sempat mencapai 79,01% (mtm) pada Maret 2013; 60,03% (mtm) pada Juli 2013; dan 35,78% (mtm) pada Desember 2015. Bobot komoditas bawang merah termasuk tinggi yaitu 0,66% (mtm). Apabila kenaikannya lebih dari 10%, maka sumbangan bawang merah dapat mencapai lebih dari 0,07% terhadap inflasi IHK. Dengan kenaikan harga sebesar 30,86% (mtm) di bulan Maret 2016, maka andil inflasi bawang merah sebesar 0,16% dari inflasi 0,19% (mtm) atau sekitar 80% dari inflasi Nasional. Bapak/Ibu dan hadirin sekalian, 15. Merespon tingginya inflasi komoditas volatile foods, Bank Indonesia menginisiasi beberapa program pengendalian inflasi. Bank Indonesia mengembangkan Pusat Informasi Harga Pangan Strategis (PIHPS) yang berfungsi sebagai media untuk transparansi harga bahan pangan. Denga n adanya PIHPS diharapkan da pat menciptakan konvergensi harga sehingga dapat mengurangi gejolak harga. 16. Bank Indonesia juga mengimplementasikan Program Pengendalian Inflasi melalui pengembangan klaster yang dilaksanakan oleh seluruh Kantor Perwakilan Bank Indonesia. Kehadiran klaster ini diharapkan dapat meningkatkan produktivitas komoditas bahan makanan penyumbang inflasi, yaitu melalui pendekatan rantai nilai dari hulu ke hilir. Kegiatan Bank Indonesia meliputi fasilitasi dan bantuan teknis, inisiatif terobosan dan percontohan yang dapat mendorong peningkatan produktivitas komoditas penyumbang inflasi. 17. Sejak 2014, program pengendalian inflasi melalui pengembangan klaster difokuskan pada komoditas yang berkontribusi dalam inflasi atau mendukung ketahanan pangan, yaitu beras, bawang merah, cabai merah, daging sapi dan bawang putih. 18. Saat ini, jumlah klaster komoditas penyumbang inflasi dan ketahanan pangan mencapai 167 klaster, yang meliputi 13 komoditas. Secara khusus, jumlah klaster komoditas penyumbang inflasi (beras, bawang merah, cabai merah, dan daging sapi) telah mencapai 113 klaster. Klaster-klaster ini tersebar di wilayah Jawa sebanyak 35 klaster; Sumatera sebanyak 24 klaster; Kalimantan sebanyak 13 klaster; dan Sulawesi, Maluku, Papua, Bali, Nusa Tenggara sebanyak 41 klaster. Klaster binaan Bank Indonesia saat ini melibatkan lebih dari 11.000 petani dengan luas lahan mencapai hampir 8.000 ha. 19. Bank Indonesia juga melakukan terobosan mengembangkan benih bawang putih bekerjasama dengan Pemerintah Daerah, Dinas/Instansi terkait, dan akademisi. Inisiatif tersebut dilakukan melalui pengem ba ngan Demonstration Plot bawang putih seluas 3.000 meter persegi di Kabupaten Tegal yang telah menghasilkan bawang putih sebanyak 22,58 ton per hektar are. Varietas benih yang dikembangkan terbukti mampu bersaing dengan bawang putih impor, baik dari sisi kualitas maupun memenuhi selera masyarakat. Pencapaian positif ini akan ditindaklanjuti dengan pengembangan klaster bawang putih di wilayah lainnya, khususnya di Provinsi Jawa Tengah. Diharapkan pengembangan klaster bawang putih dapat menekan inflasi dan mengurangi ketergantungan impor. 20. Selanjutnya, Bank Indonesia bersama Pemerintah Daerah Brebes juga mem ba ngun training center bawang merah yang membuka peluang kepada stakeholders dari seluruh penjuru tanah air untuk mempelajari budidaya bawang merah dengan dukungan teknologi terkini, sehingga dapat memenuhi standar industri, mulai dari produksi sampai dengan panen dan paska panen. 21. Kami meyakini bahwa program pengendalian inflasi berupa pengembangan klaster oleh Bank Indonesia dengan Kementerian Pertanian dan Pemerintah Daerah telah menjadi inisiatif dan inspirasi serta referensi bagi para pengambil kebijakan di daerah. Bapak/Ibu dan hadirin yang kami hormati, 22. Upaya pengendalian inflasi kedepan akan menghadapi tantangan yang tidak ringan. Namun, Bank Indonesia meyakini inflasi tahun 2016 akan berada pada kisaran target 4,0%<b1>l%. Koordinasi antara Bank Indonesia dan Pemerintah baik di tingkat pusat maupun daerah perlu terus diperkuat sehingga pihak terkait dapat mensinergikan berbagai kebijakan dan langkah-langkah yang diperlukan. 23. Acara hari ini diharapkan dapat semakin memperkokoh komitmen kita semua dalam mengupayakan pengendalian inflasi yang lebih efektif. Dalam kesempatan ini, juga akan dilakukan pemberian Apresiasi Kinerja Program Penghargaan Pengendalian Inflasi sebagai penghargaan atas pencapaian kinerja dan partisipasi stakeholders dalam meningkatkan pasokan komoditas volatile foods. 24. Demikian yang dapat kami sampaikan, semoga Tuhan yang Maha Kuasa senantiasa meridhoi langkah kita dalam upaya untuk melaksanakan Program Pengendalian Inflasi, termasuk di antaranya yang berbasis pengembangan komoditas ketahanan pangan maupun komoditas yang menjadi sumber tekanan inflasi. Sekian dan Terima kasih. Wassalamu'alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh. Agus D.W. Martowardojo Gubernur Bank Indonesia

Title: Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia, Agus Martowardojo pada Grand Launching Bank Indonesia Institute, Jakarta, 22 Agustus 2016
text: GRAND LAUNCHING BANK INDONESIA INSTITUTE Jakarta, 22nd August 2016 Which we respect, 95 Honorary Board of Bank Indonesia Institute, Prof. Dr. Boediono, Dr. M. Chatib Basri, Prof. Dr. Hal Hill and Dr. Andrew Sheng, 95 Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Republic of Indonesia, Mr. Ade Komarudin 95 Chairman of the Regional Representative Council of the Republic of Indonesia, Bp. Irman Gusman 95 Ambassadors of Australia, the United Kingdom, the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and the Federative Republic of Germany, or who represents 95 Our predecessors as Governor of Bank Indonesia, Bp. Rachmat Saleh, Mr. Arifin M. Siregar, Mr. Adrianus Mooy, Mr. Syahril Sabirin 95 Chairman of Commission XI of the House of Representatives of the Republic of Indonesia 95 Minister of Communication and Informatics, Mr. Rudiantara 95 Minister of State Apparatus Empowerment and Bureaucratic Reform, Mr. Asman Abnur 95 Senior Deputy Gand Member of the Board of Governors of Bank Indonesia 95 Chairman of the Board of Commissioners of the Deposit Insurance Corporation, Mr. Halim Alamsyah 95 Leaders of Government Agencies 95 Chairman of the Association of Provincial Governments, Municipalities and Governments of Kabu patents 95 The Rectors of the University and Heads of Corporate Universities / Institutes / Learning Centres of Government and Private Institutions 95 Brothers and Sisters of the Head of the Task Force at Bank Indonesia 95 Faculty Members Bank Indonesia Institute 95 Former Board of Directors and Deputy Governor of Bank Indonesia 95 Ladies and Gentlemen we honor, Assalamu'alaikum Wr. Wb.f Good morning and greetings to all of us, 1. First of all let us give thanks to the presence of Allah Almighty, God Almighty, because only with His approval can we gather this morning in a good atmosphere, to participate in the inauguration of the Bank Indonesia Institute, an institution at Bank Indonesia that will make a strategic contribution in achieving and realizing the excellence of human resources in the future. 2. Together we have presented Mr. Prof. Dr. Boediono, Vice President of the Republic of Indonesia for the 2009-2014 period. It is an honor for Bank Indonesia that the nation's great figures can take the time and are willing to sit on the Honorary Board of the Bank Indonesia Institute together with us, Prof. Dr. BJ Habibie, Prof. Dr. J. Sudradjad Djiwandono, Dr. M. Chatib Basri, Prof. Dr. Joseph E. Stiglitz, Prof. Dr. Hal Hill, and Dr. Andrew Sheng. 3. We believe that the synergy of thoughts and views of leading figures in the Honorary Board will be able to make Bank Indonesia Institute a classy and trusted institution, as well as having an international reputation in the development of superior human resources. 4. It is also a matter of pride and happiness for us that the inauguration of the Bank Indonesia Institute today was also attended by state officials and institutional leaders who have great concerns and are in one view with Bank Indonesia in the creation of high-quality human resources. Ladies and gentlemen and our esteemed audience, 5. Economic development requires the management of various resources, including human resources, in a measurable, optimal, and balanced manner. 6. In this context, economic development will only bring great benefits and value to society and the country if it is carried out by reliable human resources, namely: (i) have proven capacities and capabilities in their fields, (ii) able to dedicate all its capabilities effectively to the progress of the nation, as well as (iii) able to develop excellence based on high religious, cultural, and disciplined values. 7. The quality and reliability of human resources are also needed by Bank Indonesia to be able to work and perform effectively in maintaining the sustainability of the national economy. 8. We are grateful that so far the work and performance of Bank Indonesia, which has been synergized through collaboration and cooperation with the Government, financial services authority, and other authorities and institutions in the financial sector, have been able to maintain macroeconomic stability and secure the financial system that is the lifeblood of the economy. 9. With this achievement, the Indonesian economy in the second quarter of 2016 was able to grow 5.18% (yoy), after previously experiencing a slowdown, and for the whole of 2016 economic growth is expected to be in the range of 4.9% - 5.3% (yoy). Price control efforts also showed good results. The inflation rate from the beginning of the year to July 2016 was recorded at only 1.76% (ytd), so that the inflation target of 4b1.1% in 2016 is expected to be achieved. 10. Meanwhile, the current account deficit remains at the anticipated level and by the end of 2016 is expected to be lower than 2.5% of Gross Domestic Product. Ladies and gentlemen and the audience we respect, 11. Bank Indonesia is mandated by law to achieve and maintain rupiah stability. The mandate must be fulfilled with high commitment and responsibility so that macroeconomic stability and financial system stability can be maintained, so as to provide room for strong, sustainable, equitable and inclusive economic growth. 12. Within this framework, the functions, duties and authorities granted to Bank Indonesia to establish and implement monetary policy, establish and implement macroprudential policy, as well as regulate and maintain a smooth payment system and rupiah management, must be implemented effectively to ensure the achievement of the mandated objectives. 13. In this regard, Bank Indonesia continuously strengthens its internal affairs to ensure that its functions, duties and authorities can be implemented effectively. To that end, Bank Indonesia is currently carrying out a transformation program towards Bank Indonesia's vision as a credible and best central bank in the region, as well as providing more benefits to the nation and the people of Indonesia. 14. This transformation program will accelerate Bank Indonesia's efforts to improve its ability to control inflation and support financial system stability. In addition, this transformation program will also increase Bank Indonesia's innovation in the area of Payment System and Money Management. 15. In the transformation program, there are 5 (five) themes implemented to guide the consistency of achieving Bank Indonesia's vision, namely Policy Excellence, Outstanding Execution, Institutional Leadership, Motivated Organization, and State of The Art Technology. 16. Considering that the transformation program will demand the best resources and thoughts from all levels of Bank Indonesia, on July 1, 2015 , an institution has been established that serves to facilitate the process research, study, and research at Bank Indonesia. We named the institution as Bank Indonesia Institute, which in carrying out its functions is supported by 4 (four) main pillars, namely Learning {Learning'}, Research {Research}, Partnership {Partnership} and Public Exposure. Y7. Strategically, there are two main areas that are the focus of the Bank Indonesia Institute. The first strategic area is to support the realization of Bank Indonesia as a learning-based organization (LBO), which is an institution that ensures its human resources have the best competence and expertise that continues to grow, and be able to anticipate and answer the challenges ahead that are increasingly difficult and complex. 18. In this area, the focus of the activities carried out is the process of carrying out internal human resources of Bank Indonesia which includes learnings related to core substance competencies, namely monetary, financial system stability, market, payment system and Rupiah currency management, which are complemented by substances related to central banking and other macroeconomic disciplines. In addition, the development of internal human resources was also strengthened by the development of managerial and leadership aspects. 19. The second strategic area is to make Bank Indonesia Institute a world-leading institution of research and study in the field of economics and finance. In this case, Bank Indonesia Institute will facilitate discussions on monetary, fiscal, financial, and international trade policies, as well as provide alternative solutions to various origins. the economy that comes to the fore. 20. In this second strategic area, Bank Indonesia Institute carries out its functions by inviting and providing broad opportunities to experts, academics, as well as economic and financial figures , to hone and achieve its excellence in providing the best thinking and solutions for economic development. Ladies and gentlemen and the audience we respect, 21. Before us lies a winding road. The uncertain dynamics of the global economy, the rapidly accelerating digital technologist revolution in the field of finance, and the uneven and inclusiveness of economic development, are just some of the small of the big challenges that have to be faced. 22. Such a complex economic problem certainly demands the presence of a superior human resource and is able to show excellent leadership. Here, Bank Indonesia Institute must be in the right position and show its class in mem ba ng un capacity and ka pa bi litas resources high-quality human beings, as well as being world-leading institutions that are able to provide the best thoughts and alternative solutions for the nation and state. 23. However, the effort is certainly not easy to implement. Moreover, the mandated strategic function is not only to develop the advantages of Bank Indonesia's internal human resources, but also to provide excellent dharma bhakti to help shape leadership superior economy. 24. We believe that the ideals of the nation's founder , which became the foundation of the foundation for the Bank Indonesia Institute, will encourage the establishment of determination in providing the best real work, as well as being a provision for struggle without tired of realizing quality human resources. Bank Indonesia Institute was established not only for the next 10, 20, and 30 years, but will continue to be present to oversee and make the best contribution to the realization of human resources superior. 25. The existence of an Honorary Council supported by national figures and national and international experts whose insights and expertise are undoubtedly able to realize the Bank Indonesia Institute as a world-class institution that has high credibility and reputation. 26. Similarly, with the presence of the Advisory Board chaired by Deputy Governor Dr. Perry Warjiyo, as well as external and internal faculty members of Bank Indonesia who have the ability and expertise in their fields, we believe that it will bring Bank Indonesia Institute to continue to move, move forward, and be able to adapt to the changing dynamics of the environment, as well as make its best contribution in a effective. 27. Strategic partnerships built with various institutions at home and abroad will also enrich insights in the learning, study, and research process that takes place at the Bank Indonesia Institute. 28. In addition, in particular, strategic partnerships with institutions abroad will facilitate the realization of Bank Indonesia Institute as a leading institution that has a strategic contribution in shaping world-class economic leaders . Ladies and gentlemen and our esteemed audience, 29. Concluding our remarks, let us on behalf of the Board of Governors of Bank Indonesia express our appreciation and appreciation to the Honorary Board, Advisory Board, Faculty Members, and invitees who have paid great attention to the inauguration of the Bank Indonesia Institute today. 30. Hopefully, with the inauguration of the Bank Indonesia Institute and the full implementation of study and research activities starting today, it will one day bring Bank Indonesia Institute to become a world-leading learning, study and research institution that makes a strategic contribution to the realization of quality human resources, integrity, and is able to realize a prosperous, prosperous, and just nation. 31. Finally, by asking for the blessings of Allah SWT, Bank Indonesia with a sense of pride and joy presents the Bank Indonesia Institute to Indonesia to be part of the alignment of the movement for the development of superior human resources, in order to realize the nation's future economic leaders who are reliable and of high quality. 32. May Allah Almighty always protect, bless and alleviate every step of our struggle to build the country and prosper the country. Thank you. Wassalamu'alaikum Wr. Wb Agus D.W. Martowardojo Governor of Bank Indonesia

Chatib Basri, Prof. Dr. Hal Hill and Dr. Andrew Sheng, <95> Ketua Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat RI, Bp. Ade Komarudin <95> Ketua Dewan Perwakilan Daerah RI, Bp. Irman Gusman <95> Duta Besar Australia, Inggris, Kerajaan Belanda, dan Republik Federasi Jerman, atau yang mewakili <95> Para pendahulu kami sebagai Gubernur Bank Indonesia, Bp. Rachmat Saleh, Bp. Wb.f Selamat pagi dan salam sejahtera bagi kita semua, 1. Pertama-tama marilah kita panjatkan puji syukur kehadirat Allah SWT, Tuhan Yang Maha Kuasa, karena hanya dengan perkenan-Nya kita dapat berkumpul pada pagi ini dalam suasana yang baik, untuk mengikuti peresmian Bank Indonesia Institute, suatu lembaga di Bank Indonesia yang akan memberikan kontribusi strategis dalam meraih dan mewujudkan keunggulan sumber daya manusia kedepan. 2. Bersama-sama kita pada pagi hari ini telah hadir Bp. Prof. Dr. Boediono, Wakil Presiden Republik Indonesia Periode 2009-2014. Merupakan suatu kehormatan bagi Bank Indonesia bahwa tokoh besar bangsa dapat meluangkan waktu dan bersedia duduk di Dewan Kehormatan Bank Indonesia Institute bersama-sama kami, Prof. Dr. BJ Habibie, Prof. Dr. J. Sudradjad Djiwandono, Dr. M. Chatib Basri, Prof. Dr. Joseph E. Stiglitz, Prof. Dr. Hal Hill, dan Dr. Andrew Sheng. 3. Kami meyakini, sinergi pemikiran dan pandangan dari para tokoh terkemuka dalam Dewan Kehormatan akan dapat menjadikan Bank Indonesia Institute sebagai lembaga yang berkelas dan terpercaya, serta memiliki reputasi internasional dalam pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang unggul. 4. Merupakan kebanggaan dan kebahagiaan tersendiri pula bagi kami bahwa peresmian Bank Indonesia Institute pada hari ini juga dihadiri oleh para pejabat negara dan pimpinan lembaga yang memiliki perhatian besar dan berada dalam satu pandangan dengan Bank Indonesia dalam penciptaan sumber daya manusia yang berkualitas tinggi. Bapak/Ibu dan para hadirin yang kami muliakan, 5. Pembangunan ekonomi memerlukan pengelolaan berbagai sumber daya, termasuk sumber daya manusia, secara terukur, optimal, dan berkeseimbangan. 6. Dalam konteks ini, pembangunan ekonomi hanya akan membawa manfaat dan nilai tarn bah yang besar bagi masyarakat dan negara apabila dijalankan oleh sumber daya manusia yang handal, yakni: (i) memiliki kapasitas dan kapabilitas yang teruji dibidangnya, (ii) mampu mendedikasikan seluruh kemampuannya secara efektif bagi kemajuan bangsa, serta (iii) mampu mengembangkan keunggulan dengan berlandaskan nilai-nilai agama, budaya, dan disiplin yang tinggi. 7. Kualitas dan kehandalan sumber daya manusia tersebut pula yang diperlukan Bank Indonesia untuk dapat bekerja dan berkinerja efektif dalam menjaga keberlangsungan perekonomian nasional. 8. Kami bersyukur bahwa selama ini hasil kerja dan kinerja Bank Indonesia yang disinergikan melalui kolaborasi dan kerjasama dengan Pemerintah, Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, dan otoritas maupun lembaga lainnya di sektor keuangan, telah mampu menjaga stabilitas makroekonomi dan mengamankan sistem keuangan yang menjadi urat nadi perekonomian. 9. Dengan pencapaian tersebut, ekonomi Indonesia pada triwulan II - 2016 mampu tumbuh 5,18% (yoy), setelah sebelumnya sempat mengalami perlambatan, dan untuk keseluruhan tahun 2016 pertumbuhan ekonomi diperkirakan akan berada pada kisaran 4,9% - 5,3% (yoy). Upaya pengendalian harga juga menunjukkan hasil yang baik. Tingkat inflasi dari awal tahun hingga Juli 2016 tercatat hanya sebesar 1,76% (ytd), sehingga sasaran inflasi 4<b1>1% pada tahun 2016 diperkirakan dapat tercapai. 10. Sementara itu, defisit transaksi berjalan juga masih berada dalam tingkat yang diantisipasi dan hingga akhir tahun 2016 diperkirakan akan lebih rendah dari 2,5% Produk Domestik Bruto. Bapak/Ibu dan para hadirin yang kami hormati, 11. Bank Indonesia diberikan amanat oleh Undang-Undang untuk mencapai dan memelihara kestabilan nilai Rupiah. Amanat tersebut harus dipenuhi dengan komitmen dan tanggung jawab yang tinggi agar stabilitas makroekonomi dan stabilitas sistem keuangan dapat terpelihara, sehingga mampu memberikan ruang bagi pertumbuhan ekonomi yang kuat, berkesinambungan, merata, dan inklusif. 12. Dalam kerangka ini, fungsi, tugas, dan kewenangan yang diberikan kepada Bank Indonesia untuk menetapkan dan melaksanakan kebijakan moneter, menetapkan dan melaksanakan kebijakan makroprudensial, serta mengatur dan menjaga kelancaran sistem pembayaran dan pengelolaan uang rupiah, harus dapat dilaksanakan secara efektif untuk memastikan tercapainya tujuan yang diamanatkan. 13. Berkenaan dengan hal tersebut, Bank Indonesia secara berkelanjutan terus melakukan penguatan internal untuk memastikan fungsi, tugas, dan kewenangannya dapat dilaksanakan secara efektif. Untuk itu, saat ini Bank Indonesia tengah menjalankan program transformasi untuk menuju visi Bank Indonesia sebagai bank sentral yang kredibel dan terbaik di regional, serta memberi manfaat lebih bagi bangsa dan rakyat Indonesia. 14. Program transformasi ini akan mempercepat langkah Bank Indonesia untuk meningkatkan kemampuan dalam mengendalikan inflasi serta mendukung tercapainya Stabilitas Sistem Keuangan. Selain itu, program transformasi ini juga akan meningkatkan inovasi Bank Indonesia di area Sistem Pembayaran dan Pengelolaan Uang. 15. Dalam program transformasi tersebut terdapat 5 (lima) tema yang diimplementasikan untuk memandu konsistensi pencapaian visi Bank Indonesia, yaitu Policy Excellence, Outstanding Execution, Institutional Leadership, Motivated Organization, dan State of The Art Technology. 16. Mengingat program transformasi akan menuntut sumber daya dan pemikiran terbaik dari seluruh jajaran Bank Indonesia, pada tanggal 1 Juli 2015 telah didirikan suatu lembaga yang berfungsi untuk memfasilitasi proses pembelajaran, studi, dan riset di Bank Indonesia. Kami menamakan lembaga tersebut sebagai Bank Indonesia Institute, yang dalam menjalankan fungsinya didukung oleh 4 (empat) pilar utama, yaitu Pembelajaran {Learning'}, Penelitian {Research}, Kemitraan {Partnership} dan Public Exposure. Y7. Secara strategis, terdapat dua area utama yang menjadi fokus Bank Indonesia Institute. Area strategis pertama adalah mendukung perwujudan Bank Indonesia sebagai learning-based organization (LBO), yaitu lembaga yang menjamin sumber daya manusianya memiliki kompetensi dan keahlian terbaik yang terus bertumbuh, serta dapat mengantisipasi dan menjawab tantangan ke depan yang semakin sulit dan kompleks. 18. Pada area ini, fokus kegiatan yang dijalankan adalah proses pengembangan sumber daya manusia internal Bank Indonesia yang mencakup pembelajaran terkait kompetensi substansi inti, yaitu moneter, stabilitas sistem keuangan, market, sistem pembayaran dan pengelolaan uang Rupiah, yang dilengkapi dengan substansi terkait kebanksentralan dan disiplin makroekonomi lainnya. Selain itu, pengembangan sumber daya manusia internal tadi juga diperkuat dengan pengembangan aspek manajerial dan kepemimpinan. 19.
