This ability commitment does not only include these 4 (four) things, but also includes the target time for the realization of principal activities, namely at the end of December 2017, as well as their alignment. with the National Payment Gateway (NPG) initiative to be implemented by Bank Indonesia. 11. With the design design in the form of interconnection between switching and not forming a superswitch, it is important to be a concern for the Principal Company , including those to be formed by SOEs that implementasi NPG will focus on the use of existing infrastructure. In this regard, Bank Indonesia is committed to respecting the investment commitments that have been given by the industry in developing the payment system in Indonesia. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen we are interested in, 12. Then, we also need to point out that in the implementation of the NPG later, Bank Indonesia will gradually organize the role of institutions which includes 4 (four) main things, namely: 1) The principal in the future will only perform the switching function. This of course will also apply to the Principal formed by a SOE if he has obtained a permit and operates. 2) Clearing activities will be carried out by a service institution, which we believe to be an independent institution. 3) Settlement activities will be carried out by Bank Indonesia 4) The management and development of domestic payment standards will be carried out by standards institutions, which we also believe must carry out their functions in accordance with best practices. 13. We aim to achieve these forms of institutional arrangements to meet people's expectations of the availability of cheaper services that can reach all levels of society. On the other hand, NPG is expected to encourage the improvement of the types of services and transactions as a whole will increase the sustainability of the national payment system industry. 14. In addition to carrying out their business activities well, we expect players in the national payment system industry to take reasonable advantage of their business activities. Together, we must ensure that consumers benefit and are not faced with an economic inefficiency and rent-off. We certainly don't want that to happen. 15. Specifically regarding domestic payment standards, dalam this opportunity we would like to remind HIMBARA banks that the implementation stage of the National Standard of Chip Technology (NSICCS) has been rolling since the beginning of the year 2016 and in order to be one of the priority agendas. We see that efforts are needed from HIMBARA banks in the preparation process for card migration, host & backend systems, and infrastructure roll-outs. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 16. On this good occasion, we would also like to remind HIMBARA banks that the role of information technology in the future will be very extraordinary. As we follow together, some technologies have created a creative destruction in society, such as e-book technology that replaces conventional books, technology instant messaging communications that replace fixed line telephony, and application-based transportation technology. 17. Therefore, banks must also be prepared. The wider use of Financial Technology (Fintech) in the community is in sight. This is a phenomenon that we do not need to be afraid of, but presumably banks in this case HIMBARA banks should immediately prepare themselves, one of which is by building a unit specifically us in its institutions related to the development of Fintech. 18. Because based on experience in various countries in the world, if we ignore these technological developments and innovations, and we are too comfortable in our comfort zone, we will not be able to facing the challenges ahead, and will instead createn disruption in our own institutions. Therefore, banks need to prepare well to welcome the increasingly rampant use of Fintech in the community. 19. In this case, Bank Indonesia will take steps by establishing a Fintech Office, which will assist actors in efforts to develop Fintech. In addition, Bank Indonesia in the near future will also launch the Regulatory Sandbox initiative, where we will invite Fintech players to be able to simulate business models with support from the central bank, in order to produce optimal benefits for the community, while still prioritizing consumer protection and maintaining economic efficiency. 20. With a variety of Fintech activities that we can categorizeinto: (1) Deposit, Lending, and Capital Raising, including crowdfunding and peer to peer lending models. (2) Payment, Clearing, and Settlement, includes mobile dax\ based payment patterns as well as the web. (3) Market Provisioning, in the form of e-Aggregator. (4) Investment and Risk Management which includes robo advisors dax\ e-trading platforms or e-insurance. We from Bank Indonesia have directed that there are at least 3 (three) aspects that need to be considered by Fintech, namely: (1) Must be an Indonesian legal entity (2) In carrying out its transaction activities, it must be carried out using Rupiah currency (3) Placing funds in the banking system Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 21.In line with the various measures to be pursued by the Government, Bank Indonesia, and also actors in developing the national payment system, specifically related to initiatives to disburse Social Assistance by the Government we also hope that it can be channeled through the national payment system. 22. This will directly increase the ratio of financial inclusion levels in Indonesia, which is currently recorded at only around 36% and is still far behind compared to neighboring countries . If this can be done by onal banks, including by HIMBARA banks, we believe that the level of financial inclusion in Indonesia will be able to increase rapidly. 23. Before closing this speech, we would like to convey that we are paying close attention to how serious and committed the commitment given to realize the plan for the formation of this Principal, and we really appreciate that . But the big work is just beginning, and various challenges will still come to the fore. 24. Therefore, it is important for the Ministry of SOEs, HIMBARA, and Telkom to jointly monitor and ensure the smooth implementation of this plan in the future. Synergy should be carried out not only limited to communication, but also included in the management of resources which of course are definitely needed. 25. A series of action plans that have been implemented bySun need to be monitored intensively and of course need to be accompanied by an excellent coordination relationship. We from Bank Indonesia will also always be open to discuss and provide guidance in line with the strategy and direction of the payment system policy in the future. 26. We hope that the MoU to be signed can be a driver for the birth of a Principal legal entity that is competitive, able to compete healthily, can provide increasingly affordable services for the people, as well as senantiasa puts forward the national interest. 27. Finally, we congratulate you on the synergy that has been established. May God always ease our steps together in realizing a safe, efficient, and reliable national payment system. That's it and thank you. Wassalammu'alaikum Warrahmatullahi Wabarakatuh. Agus D.W. Martowardojo Governor of Bank Indonesia
text_original: -Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia- Penandatanganan MoU antara Bank-Bank Anggota HIM BARA dan PT Telkom Indonesia tentang Pembentukan Perusahaan Prinsipal Jakarta, 9 September 2016 Yang kami hormati: <95> Menteri BUMN, Ibu Rini S. Soemarno <95> Deputi Komisioner Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, Bpk Budi Armanto <95> Direktur Utama Telkom Indonesia, Bpk Alex J Sinaga <95> Ketua Himpunan Bank-Bank Milik Negara (HIMBARA) sekaiigus Direktur Utama BRI, Bpk Asmawi Syam <95> Direktur Utama BNI, BpkAchmad Baiquni <95> Direktur Utama Bank Mandiri, Bpk Kartika Wirjoatmodjo <95> Direktur Utama BTN, Bpk Maryono <95> Para Pejabat Eseion I di iingkungan Kementerian BUMN <95> Bapak/Ibu hadirin undangan yang berbahagia Assaiammuaiaikum Wr. Wb. Seiamat pagi dan Saiam Sejahtera bagi kita semua. 1. Pertama-tama marilah kita panjatkan puji dan rasa syukur kehadirat Tuhan YME, karena hanya atas perkenan-Nya kita semua dapat berkumpul pada pagi hari ini untuk mengikuti bersama " Penandatanganan MoU antara Bank-Bank Anggota HIMBARA dengan Telkom Indonesia tentang Pembentukan Perusahaan Prinsipai" 2. Mengawali sambutan kami, perkenankan kami menyampaikan apresiasi dan ucapan seiamat kepada Kementrian BUMN, Bank-Bank HIM BARA, dan Telkom atas suatu langkah awal yang kami panda ng amat kritikal bagi efisiensi sistem pembayaran nasional mendatang. 3. Bank Indonesia selaku Otoritas Sistem Pembayaran Nasional dalam hal ini tentunya mendukung upaya-upaya yang dilakukan Pemerintah bersama dengan Industri dalam semangat untuk meningkatkan daya saing, meningkatkan efisiensi, dan meningkatkan upaya membangun kemandirian sistem pembayaran nasional. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 4. Sebagai negara berkembang dengan pertumbuhan ekonomi yang mencapai 5,5% (yoy) dalam lima tahun terakhir dan Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) tahun 2015 sebesar Rp 11.540 Triliun, Indonesia tentunya memiliki kebutuhan akan penyediaan sistem pembayaran ritel yang sangat besar. Hal ini diperlukan guna menunjang peningkatan aktivitas ekonomi seluruh masyarakat. 5. Berdasarkan data Bank Indonesia, nominal transaksi Kartu ATM/Debit di tahun 2015 telah menyentuh angka Rp 13 Triliun/hari, dengan volume transaksi mencapai 12,5 Juta transaksi/hari. Capaian tersebut juga diikuti dengan kesinambungan pertumbuhan volume transaksi dalam lima tahun terakhir yang rata-rata tumbuh diatas 20% (yoy). 6. Mencermati perkembangan tersebut, penyelenggara layanan sistem pembayaran ritel, dalam konteks ini termasuk prinsipal, akan menghadapi berbagai tantangan, termasuk tuntutan peningkatan kapasitas, kualitas layanan, keamanan dan integritas sistem, serta keterjangkauan tarif. Apalagi pemrosesan transaksi tersebut dilakukan melalui infrastruktur dan jaringan dari perusahaan prinsipal. 7. Oleh karena itu, kami menyambut baik kajian awal dan tindaklanjut yang responsif dari Kementerian BUMN dalam merealisasikan gagasan pembentukan Prinsipal melalui sinergi BUMN sebagai bagian dari Roadmap Sektor Jasa Keuangan dan Perbankan. 8. Berbekal jangkauan sistem pembayaran ritel perbankan HIM BARA yang mewakili paling tidak 50% dari volume transaksi Kartu Debit nasional, serta kapabilitas Telkom Indonesia yang selama ini telah berpengalaman mendukung HIMBARA dalam penyediaan jaringan ATM LINK, Bank Indonesia menyikapi gagasan ini dengan positif dan meyakini akan nilai tambah yang dapat diberikan. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 9. Setelah mengkaji proposal yang disampaikan Ibu Menteri BUMN perihal rencana pembentukan Prinsipal ini. Bank Indonesia pada tanggal 11 Juli 2016 telah memberikan dukungan dan persetujuan prinsip, serta menyampaikan 4 (empat) hal utama yang perlu dipedomani sbg tindaklanjut, yaitu: 1) Agar membentuk badan hukum yang nantinya akan bertindak sebagai prinsipal. 2) Agar berkomitmen menyediakan sistem yang mampu saling terhubung (interkoneksi) dan saling dapat melayani (interoperability) dengan sistem eksisting yang telah ada. 3) Agar berkomitmen untuk memenuhi standar internasional dan best practices penyelenggaraan sistem pembayaran, seperti penggunaan central bank money dalam aktivitas setelmen. 4) Agar mematuhi syarat dan ketentuan yang akan ditetapkan Bank Indonesia untuk aspek seperti pricing, permodalan, kepemilikan, dan keamanan sistem. 10. Merespon persetujuan prinsip yang diberikan, kami kemudian juga telah menerima pernyataan kesanggupan dari Kementerian BUMN pada 10 Agustus 2016. Komitmen kesanggupan ini selain meliputi 4 (empat) hal tersebut, namun juga termasuk target waktu realisasi kegiatan Prinsipal yaitu pada akhir Desember 2017, serta keselarasannya dengan inisiatif National Payment Gateway (NPG) yang akan diimplementasikan oleh Bank Indonesia. 11. Dengan rancangan desain berupa interkoneksi antar switching dan bukan membentuk suatu superswitch, penting menjadi perhatian bagi Perusahaan Prinsipal termasuk yang akan dibentuk oleh BUMN bahwa implementasi NPG akan fokus kepada penggunaan infrastruktur eksisting. Dalam hal ini, Bank Indonesia berkomitmen untuk menghargai komitmen investasi yang telah diberikan oleh industri dalam mengembangkan sistem pembayaran di Indonesia. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 12. Kemudian, perlu kami garisbawahi juga bahwa dalam implementasi NPG nanti, Bank Indonesia akan secara bertahap menata peran kelembagaan yang meliputi 4 (empat) hal utama yaitu: 1) Prinsipal kedepan hanya akan menjalankan fungsi switching. Hal ini tentunya juga akan berlaku bagi Prinsipal bentukan BUMN apabila telah mendapatkan izin dan beroperasi. 2) Kegiatan kliring akan dilakukan oleh lembaga services, yang kita yakini sebagai sebuah lembaga yang mandiri. 3) Kegiatan setelmen akan dilakukan oleh Bank Indonesia 4) Pengelolaan dan pengembangan standar pembayaran domestik akan dilakukan oleh lembaga standar, yang juga kita yakini harus menjalankan fungsinya sesuai best practices. 13. Bentuk-bentuk penataan kelembagaan tersebut kami tujukan untuk memenuhi ekspektasi masyarakat akan tersedianya layanan yang lebih murah dan dapat menjangkau semua lapisan masyarakat. Di sisi lain, NPG diharapkan akan mendorong peningkatan jenis layanan dan transaksi yang secara keseluruhan akan meningkatkan sustainabilitas industri sistem pembayaran nasional. 14. Selain agar menjalankan kegiatan usahanya dengan baik, kami harapkan para pelaku di industri sistem pembayaran nasional mengambil keuntungan secara wajar dari aktivitas usahanya. Bersama-sama, kita harus memastikan bahwa konsumen mendapat manfaat dan tidak dihadapkan pada suatu inefisiensi dan rente ekonomi. Kita tentunya sangat tidak menginginkan kondisi itu terjadi. 15. Khusus terkait standard pembayaran domestik, dalam kesempatan ini kami ingin mengingatkan kepada bank-bank HIMBARA bahwa tahapan implementasi Standar Nasional Teknologi Chip (NSICCS) telah bergulir sejak awal tahun 2016 dan agar menjadi salah satu agenda prioritas. Kami memandang diperlukan upaya percepatan dari bank-bank HIMBARA dalam proses penyiapan baik untuk migrasi kartu, host & backend system, maupun roll-out infrastruktur. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 16. Dalam kesempatan yang baik ini, kami juga ingin mengingatkan kepada bank-bank HIMBARA bahwa peran teknologi informasi kedepan akan sangat luar biasa. Seperti yang kita ikuti bersama, beberapa teknologi telah menciptakan suatu creative destruction di masyarakat, seperti teknologi e-book yang menggantikan buku konvensional, teknologi komunikasi pesan instan yang menggantikan telefon fixed line, dan teknologi transportasi berbasis aplikasi. 17. Karenanya, perbankan juga harus bersiap. Penggunaan Financial Technology (Fintech) yang lebih luas di masyarakat sudah di depan mata. Ini adalah suatu fenomena yang tidak perlu kita takuti, tetapi kiranya perbankan dalam hal ini bank-bank HIMBARA agar segera mempersiapkan diri, salah satunya dengan membangun sebuah unit khusus didalam institusinya terkait pengembangan Fintech. 18. Karena berdasarkan pengalaman di berbagai negara di dunia, apabila perkembangan teknologi dan inovasi tersebut kita abaikan, dan kita terlalu nyaman pada comfort zone kita, kita justru tidak akan bisa menghadapi tantangan kedepan, dan malah akan menciptakan disruption pada institusi kita sendiri. Oleh karena itu, perbankan perlu untuk mempersiapkan diri dengan baik menyongsong penggunaan Fintech yang semakin marak di masyarakat. 19. Dalam hal ini Bank Indonesia akan mengambil langkah dengan membentuk suatu Fintech Office, yang akan mendampingi para pelaku dalam upaya pengembangan Fintech. Selain itu, Bank Indonesia dalam waktu dekat juga akan meluncurkan inisiatif Regulatory Sandbox, dimana kami akan mengundang para pelaku Fintech untuk dapat melakukan simulasi model bisnis dengan dukungan dari bank sentral, agar dapat menghasilkan manfaat yang optimal bagi masyarakat, namun dengan tetap mengutamakan perlindungan konsumen serta menjaga efisiensi perekonomian. 20. Dengan ragam aktivitas Fintechyang dapat kita kategorikan menjadi: (1) Deposit, Lending, and Capital Raising, termasuk didalamnya adalah model crowdfunding dan peer to peer lending. (2) Payment, Clearing, and Settlement, mencakup pola pembayaran berbasis mobile dax\ juga web. (3) Market Provisioning, da lam bentuk e-Aggregator. (4) Investment and Risk Management yang antara lain berupa robo advisor dax\ platform e-trading atau e-insurance. kami dari Bank Indonesia telah mengarahkan bahwa paling tidak terdapat 3 (tiga) aspek yang perlu diperhatikan oleh Fintech, yaitu: (1) Harus berbadan hukum Indonesia (2) Dalam melaksanakan aktivitas transaksinya, harus dilakukan menggunakan mata uang Rupiah (3) Menempatkan dana pada sistem perbankan Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 21.Sejalan dengan berbagai langkah yang akan diupayakan baik oleh Pemerintah, Bank Indonesia, dan juga para pelaku dalam mengembangkan sistem pembayaran nasional, khusus terkait inisiatif penyaluran Bantuan Sosial oleh Pemerintah juga kami harapkan agar dapat disalurkan melalui sistem pembayaran nasional. 22. Hal ini akan secara langsung dapat meningkatkan rasio tingkat inklusi keuangan di Indonesia, yang saat ini tercatat baru sekitar 36% dan masih jauh tertinggal dibandingkan negara-negara tetangga. Kalau hal ini dapat dilakukan oleh perbankan nasional, termasuk oleh bank- bank HIMBARA, kami meyakini tingkat inklusi keuangan di Indonesia akan dapat meningkat dengan cepat. 23. Sebelum menutup sambutan ini, kami ingin sampaikan bahwa kami mencermati bagaimana keseriusan dan komitmen yang diberikan untuk mewujudkan rencana pembentukan Prinsipal ini, dan kami sangat menghargai hal tersebut. Namun pekerjaan besar baru dimulai, dan berbagai tantangan masih akan mengemuka. 24. Oleh karena itu, penting bagi Kementerian BUMN, HIMBARA, dan Telkom untuk bersama-sama mengawal dan memastikan kelancaran implementasi rencana ini kedepan. Sinergi seyogyanya dilakukan tidak hanya sebatas dalam berkomunikasi, namun termasuk juga dalam pengelolaan resources yang tentunya pasti dibutuhkan. 25. Serangkaian action plan yang telah disusun perlu dimonitor secara intensify dan tentunya perlu disertai hubungan koordinasi yang prima. Kami dari Bank Indonesia juga akan selalu terbuka untuk berdiskusi dan memberikan guidance yang selaras dengan strategi dan arah kebijakan sistem pembayaran nasional kedepan. 26. Besar harapan kami agar MoU yang akan ditandatangani dapat menjadi pendorong lahirnya badan hukum Prinsipal yang berdaya saing, mampu berkompetisi secara sehat, dapat menyediakan layanan yang semakin terjangkau bagi masyarakat, serta senantiasa mengedepankan kepentingan nasional. 27. Akhir kata, kami mengucapkan selamat atas sinergi yang telah terjalin. Semoga Tuhan YME senantiasa meringankan langkah kita bersama dalam mewujudkan sistem pembayaran nasional yang aman, efisien, dan handal. Sekian dan terimakasih. Wassalammu'alaikum Warrahmatullahi Wabarakatuh. Agus D.W. Martowardojo Gubernur Bank Indonesia

Title: Keynote Speech Gubernur Bank Indonesia, Agus D.W. Martowardojo pada Indonesia Fintech Festival and Conference 2016, Jakarta 30 Agustus 2016
text: -Keynote Speech of the Governor of Bank Indonesia- Indonesia Fintech Festival and Conference 2016 Jakarta, 30th August 2016 What we respect: 95 Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs, Mr. Darmin Nasution 95 Chairman of the Financial Services Authority, Mr. Muiiaman D. Hadad 95 Minister of Finance, Mrs. Sri Muiyani Indrawati 95 Minister of Trade, Mr . Enggartiasto Lukita 95 Minister of Communication and Informatics, Mr. Rudiantara 95 Chairman of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry, Mr Rosan Roesiani 95 Banking Leaders 95 The Peiaku Fintech in Indonesia 95 Mr/Ibu happy invited audience Assaiammuaiaikum Wr. Wb. It's morning and Saiam's well-being for all of us. 1. First of all let us offer praise and gratitude to the presence Lord YME, where only for his grace and approval can we all follow this good forum. In the morning of today we welcome and thank the Service Authority Finance and the Chamber of Commerce and Industry for the administration of "Indonesia Fintech Festival and Conference 2016". 2. As we all know with the development of technology already so rapidly, that the daily life of the Indonesian people is inseparable from the role of technology. In the financial sector itself, currently there are many start-up companies that call themselves Fintech companies. 3. Therefore, early discussions about Fintech both in terms of actors, regulators, and users are expected to bring optimal benefits to the welfare of the community. In addition, we can also examine the potential risks and manage them carefully. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 4. The useof technology in the financial sector is actually not a new thing in Indonesia. Various information technology-based financial services have been present and used by the public for a long time. 5. We know together in the 1980s ATM machines were present in Indonesia, which allowed the provision of banking services for 24 hours without having to come to a bank branch office. Then in 2000, the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system as an instantaneous payment system began to be implemented. In 2007, we also learned about the use of electronic money which makes it easier for people to transact financially. 6. Nowadays, especially in recent years, the term Fintech or Financial Technology has become very popular. Fintech as a wishful thinking service based on information technology such as big data, cloud computing, and distributed ledger systems has become a phenomenon, in conjunction with the strong penetration of the internet and the massive use of smartphones in community. 7. In addition, the tightening of the regulatory regime in the body of the formal financial sector after the Global Financial Crisis in 2008 also left a wide financing gap. This then encourages the growing need in the community to get alternative financial solutions, which can be answered by the presence of Fintech. With relatively simple, fast, and distance-restricted procedures, various Fintech services are rapidly being adopted by the public. 8. In this context, we view Fintech as a form of fusion or a hybrid form of technological innovation with a financial services business model that has the potential to bridge needs and drive the activities of the secretariat tor small and micro enterprises, as well as society at large while encouraging financial inclusion. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 9. We note that Fintech activities can be distinguished into 4 (four) main groups, namely: (1) Deposit, Lending, and Capital Raising, including crowdfunding and peer to peer lending models. (2) Payment, Clearing, and Settlement, includes mobile-based payment patterns as well as the web. (3) Market Provisioning, in the form of an e-Aggregator. (4) Investment and Risk Management which includes robo advisors and e-trading or e-insurance platforms. 10. As the Payment System Authority as mandated by law, Bank Indonesia has so far issued a number of provisions related to Payment, Clearing, and Settlement activities that include the implementation of good payment system services. which is carried out by banks and non-bank institutions , including in this case Fintech companies, which carry out the function of the payment system as their core business, or use service payment system as one of the supporters of its activities {enabler). 11. We have issued several policies for instruments and payment system infrastructure that combine technology and financial services. In terms of high value transactions, Bank Indonesia in 2015 has launched Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) and The National Clearing System (SKN) Generation II. 12. In terms of instruments, Bank Indonesia has regulated Card-Based Payment Instruments (APMK) consisting of ATM/Debit Cards and Credit Cards, as well as arrangements for Electronic Money and Fund Transfer Activities. Technology-based and low-cost Fund Transfer activities that are currently rampant have also been directed to follow the current provisions, where business activities must be subject to the Fund Transfer Law and licensed by Bank Indonesia. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 13. In line with the rapid growth of Fintech, we also pay close attention to the development of e-commerce that grows hand in hand in the midst of society. The development of payment method variants, especially in e-commerce transactions in Indonesia, is one of our focuses at Bank Indonesia. 14. We observed how the development of e-commerced transaction behavior is currently still dominated by the Cash on Delivery (COD) method. In addition, we also find a variety of payments via interbank transfers, ATM / Debit cards, Credit Cards, and Money Electronic. Recently, even people have begun to become familiar with payments using electronic wallets. 15. To accommodate such developments, Bank Indonesia will immediately issue a policy related to the Implementation of Payment Transactions (PTP). This arrangement will be closely related to the business model carried out in Fintech. 16. The implementation of business activities in the Fintech business model such as internet payment gateway providers, electronic wallet operators, as well as supporting providers such as ATM / EDC terminals, and Point of Sales (POS) will be regulated in this provision . Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, Y7. We note that these activities are inseparable from risks, especially related to financial system sta bi litas, payment systems, cybersecurity, transaction integrity and security. financial. Therefore, we look at tercan be at least 3 (three) aspects that need to be considered, namely: 18. First, adequate risk management. Second, consumer protection, especially related to data and information protection. Third, strive for transaction efficiency. 19. In this context, Bank Indonesia will require Fintech players operating in Indonesia, especially Fintechs that facilitate the payment system, to (1) be incorporated in Indonesia, (2) use currency Rupiah, and (3) placing funds in the banking system. 20. In addition, we also require all payment system operators, both domestic and global, to operate in Indonesia to process financial transactions domestically. 21. By maintaining a prudential corridor, but without turning off the pace of innovation, we believe that the fintech regulatory environment in the future will be more conducive, namely on the one hand providing certainty for business actors, and the other side still prioritizes consumer protection. Ladies and Gentlemen, Hadin'n whom we respect, 22. We note that arrangements related to Fintech and e-Commerce involve cross-institutions, ranging from arrangements on trade aspects, aspects of providing financial services, aspects of communication technology and informatics, including aspects of payment systems. 23. Therefore, we believe that the synergy between authorities that have been built so far can continue to be improved. Through forums such as the Indonesian Payment System Forum (FSPI) consisting of Bank Indonesia, the Financial Services Authority ,the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Trade, and the Ministry of Communication and Informatics, we can realize the formulation of policies that are in line with industrial dynamics in responding to industrial dynamics. 24. Then, we also encourage and appeal to all Fintech players to be part of the Fintech Association. Especially for Fintech players engaged in the payment system, we direct them to join the Indonesian Payment System Association (ASPI). 25. In addition, Bank Indonesia is committed to continuously monitoring the development of Fintech and its dynamics, through the establishment of a Fintech Office that will intensely follow, study and cooperate with relevant institutions to oversee the development of Fintech in a healthy corridor. 26. We will also create a {regulatory sandbox) laboratory as a means to directly monitor the evolution of business models and the risks that may be inherent from various Fintech business models. Through intensive monitoring, it is hoped that the policy formulation process can be more precise and anticipatory. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 27. Technological innovation in financial services is a necessity. Bank Indonesia as the Monetary Authority, Financial System stability and Payment System will always support the presence and contribution of Fintech to the Indonesian economy, as well as strive to continue to encourage its development to positive direction. 28. In closing, we invite all of us to continue to strengthen collaboration and synergy, so that the national financial and payment industry can grow healthily and competitively. We believe this current of digitalization of the economy can encourage more efficient allocation of resources, and in turn provide greater benefits to society. That's it and thank you. Wassalammu'alaikum Warrahmatuiiahi Wabarakatuh. Agus D.W. Martowardojo Governor of Bank Indonesia
text_original: -Keynote Speech Gubernur Bank Indonesia- Indonesia Fintech Festival and Conference 2016 Jakarta, 30 Agustus 2016 Yang kami hormati: <95> Menteri Koordinator Bidang Perekonomian, Bpk Darmin Nasution <95> Ketua Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, Bpk Muiiaman D. Hadad <95> Menteri Keuangan, Ibu Sri Muiyani Indrawati <95> Menteri Perdagangan, Bpk Enggartiasto Lukita <95> Menteri Komunikasi dan Informatika, Bpk Rudiantara <95> Ketua Kamar Dagang dan Industri, Bpk Rosan Roesiani <95> Para Pimpinan Perbankan <95> Para Peiaku Fintech di Indonesia <95> Bapak/Ibu hadirin undangan yang berbahagia Assaiammuaiaikum Wr. Wb. Seiamat pagi dan Saiam Sejahtera bagi kita semua. 1. Pertama-tama marilah kita memanjatkan puji dan syukur kehadirat Tuhan YME, dimana hanya atas rahmat dan perkenan-Nya kita semua dapat mengikuti forum yang baik ini. Pada pagi hari ini kami menyambut baik dan mengucapkan terimakasih kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan dan Kamar Dagang dan Industri atas penyelenggaraan "Indonesia Fintech Festival and Conference 2016". 2. Sebagaimana kita ketahui bersama perkembangan teknologi sudah sedemikian pesatnya, sehingga kehidupan sehari-hari masyarakat Indonesia tidak terlepas dari peran teknologi. Di sektor keuangan sendiri, saat ini banyak bermunculan start-up companies yang menamakan dirinya sebagai perusahaan Fintech. 3. Oleh karena itu, pembahasan sejak dini mengenai Fintech baik dari sisi pelaku, regulator, maupun pengguna diharapkan dapat membawa manfaat optimal bagi kesejahteraan masyarakat. Selain itu, potensi risiko yang ada juga dapat kita cermati dan kelola dengan seksama. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 4. Penggunaan teknologi di sektor keuangan sesungguhnya bukanlah merupakan hal baru di Indonesia. Berbagai layanan keuangan berbasis teknologi informasi telah hadir dan digunakan oleh masyarakat sejak dulu. 5. Kita kenal bersama di tahun 1980an Mesin ATM hadir di Indonesia, yang memungkinkan penyediaan layanan perbankan selama 24 jam tanpa harus datang ke kantor cabang bank. Kemudian di tahun 2000, sistem Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) sebagai sistem pembayaran seketika mulai diimplementasikan. Di tahun 2007 kita kemudian juga mengenai penggunaan uang elektronik yang semakin memudahkan masyarakat dalam bertransaksi keuangan. 6. Dewasa ini, khususnya dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, istilah Fintech atau Financial Technology menjadi sangat populer. Fintech sebagai layanan keuangan yang berbasis teknologi informasi seperti big data, cloud computing, dan distributed ledger system menjadi fenomena, sei ring denga n kuatnya penetrasi internet dan masifnya penggunaan smartphone di tengah masyarakat. 7. Selain itu, mengetatnya rezim regulasi di tubuh sektor keuangan formal pasca Global Financial Crisis di tahun 2008 juga meninggalkan financing gap yang lebar. Hal ini kemudian mendorong tumbuhnya kebutuhan di masyarakat untuk mendapatkan solusi keuangan alternatif, yang dapat dijawab dengan kehadiran Fintech. Dengan prosedur yang relatif sederhana, cepat, dan tidak dibatasi jarak, berbagai layanan Fintech pesat diadopsi masyarakat. 8. Dalam konteks tersebut, kami memandang Fintech sebagai wujud peleburan atau bentuk hybrid dari inovasi teknologi dengan model bisnis layanan keuangan berpotensi menjembatani kebutuhan dan menggerakan kegiatan sektor usaha kecil dan mikro, serta masyarakat secara luas sekaligus mendorong inklusi keuangan. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 9. Kami mencermati bahwa aktivitas Fintech dapat dibedakan kedalam 4 (empat) kelompok utama, yaitu: (1) Deposit, Lending, and Capital Raising, termasuk didalamnya adalah model crowdfunding dan peer to peer lending. (2) Payment, Clearing, and Settlement, mencakup pola pernbayaran berbasis mobile daw juga web. (3) Market Provisioning, dalam bentuk e-Aggregator. (4) Investment and Risk Management yang antara lain berupa robo advisor dan platform e-trading atau e-insurance. 10. Selaku Otoritas Sistem Pembayaran sebagaimana diamanatkan oleh UU, Bank Indonesia selama ini telah mengeluarkan sejumlah ketentuan terkait aktivitas Payment, Clearing, and Settlement yang mencakup penyelenggaraan jasa sistem pembayaran baik yang dilakukan oleh Bank maupun Lembaga Selain Bank, termasuk dalam hal ini adalah perusahaan Fintech, yang menjalankan fungsi sistem pembayaran sebagai core business-nya, maupun menggunakan jasa sistem pembayaran sebagai salah satu pendukung kegiatannya {enabler). 11. Beberapa kebijakan telah kami keluarkan untuk instrument maupun infrastruktur sistem pembayaran yang menggabungkan antara teknologi dan layanan keuangan. Dalam hal transaksi nilai besar {high value), Bank Indonesia di tahun 2015 telah meluncurkan Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) dan Sistem Kliring Nasional (SKN) Generasi II. 12. Dari sisi instrument, Bank Indonesia telah mengatur Alat Pembayaran Menggunakan Kartu (APMK) yang terdiri dari Kartu ATM/Debet dan Kartu Kredit, serta pengaturan Uang Elektronik dan Kegiatan Transfer Dana. Kegiatan Transfer Dana berbasis teknologi dan berbiaya murah yang saat ini marak juga telah diarahkan untuk mengikuti ketentuan yang berlaku saat ini, dimana aktivitas usahanya harus tunduk pada UU Transfer Dana dan memiliki izin dari Bank Indonesia. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 13. Sejalan denga n pesatnya pertumbuhan Fintech, kami juga mencermati perkembangan e-commerce yang tumbuh beriringan di tengah-tengah masyarakat. Perkembangan varian metode pembayaran, terutama dalam transaksi e-commerce di Indonesia menjadi salah satu fokus kami di Bank Indonesia. 14. Kami mengamati bagaimana perkembangan perilaku transaksi e- commerced\ masyarakat saat ini masih didominasi oleh metode Cash on Delivery (COD). Selain itu kita juga jumpai ragam pembayaran melalui transfer antar Bank, kartu ATM/ Debit, Kartu Kredit, dan Uang Elektronik. Beberapa waktu terakhir bahkan masyarakat mulai akrab dengan pembayaran menggunakan electronic wallet. 15. Guna mengakomodasi perkembangan tersebut, Bank Indonesia akan segera mengeluarkan kebijakan terkait Penyelenggaraan Transaksi Pembayaran (PTP). Pengaturan ini akan memiliki keterkaitan erat dengan model bisnis yang dilakukan dalam Fintech. 16. Penyelenggaraan aktivitas usaha dalam model bisnis Fintech seperti penyedia internet payment gateway, penyelenggara electronic wallet, serta penyelenggara penunjang seperti terminal ATM/EDC, dan Point of Sales (POS) akan diatur dalam ketentuan ini. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, Y7. Kami mencermati bahwa kegiatan tersebut tidak terlepas dari risiko- risiko, khususnya terkait sta bi litas sistem keuangan, sistem pembayaran, cybersecurity, integritas dan keamanan transaksi keuangan. Oleh karena itu, kami memandang terdapat setidaknya 3 (tiga) aspek yang perlu diperhatikan, yaitu: 18. Pertama, pengelolaan risiko yang memadai. Kedua, perlindungan konsumen, terutama terkait proteksi data dan informasi. Ketiga, mengupayakan efisiensi transaksi. 19. Dalam konteks tersebut, Bank Indonesia akan mewajibkan pelaku Fintech yang beroperasi di Indonesia, khususnya Fintech yang memfasilitasi sistem pembayaran, untuk (1) berbadan hukum Indonesia, (2) menggunakan mata uang Rupiah, dan (3) menempatkan dana pada sistem perbankan. 20. Selain itu, kami juga mewajibkan seluruh penyelenggara sistem pembayaran, baik domestik maupun global, yang beroperasi di Indonesia untuk melakukan pemrosesan transaksi keuangan di domestik. 21. Dengan tetap mempertahankan koridor kehati-hatian, namun tanpa mematikan laju inovasi, kami meyakini lingkungan pengaturan Fintech kedepan akan semakin kondusif, yaitu di satu sisi memberikan kepastian bagi pelaku usaha, dan sisi lain tetap mengedepankan perlindungan konsumen. Bapak/Ibu, Hadin'n yang kami hormati, 22. Kami menyadari bahwa pengaturan terkait Fintech dan e-Commerce melibatkan lintas lembaga, mulai dari pengaturan pada aspek perdagangan, aspek penyediaan jasa keuangan, aspek teknologi komunikasi dan informatika, termasuk aspek sistem pembayaran. 23. Oleh karena itu, kami percaya sinergi antar Otoritas yang telah terbangun selama ini dapat terus kita tingkatkan. Melalui wadah seperti Forum Sistem Pembayaran Indonesia (FSPI) yang beranggotakan Bank Indonesia, Otoritas Jasa Keuangan, Kementerian Keuangan, Kementerian Perdagangan, dan Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika, perumusan kebijakan yang selaras dalam merespon dinamika industri dapat kita wujudkan. 24. Kemudian, kami juga mendorong dan menghimbau kepada seluruh pelaku Fintech untuk dapat menjadi bagian dari Asosiasi Fintech. Khusus bagi para pelaku Fintech yang bergerak di bidang sistem pembayaran, kami arahkan agar dapat bergabung dengan Asosiasi Sistem Pembayaran Indonesia (ASPI). 25. Selain itu, Bank Indonesia berkomitmen untuk terus memonitor perkembangan Fintech beserta dinamikanya, melalui pendirian Fintech Office yang secara intens akan mengikuti, mempelajari dan bekerjasama dengan lembaga terkait untuk mengawal perkembangan Fintech tetap dalam koridor yang sehat. 26. Kami juga akan membuat laboratorium {regulatory sandbox) sebagai sarana untuk memonitor secara langsung evolusi model bisnis dan risiko yang mungkin melekat dari ragam model bisnis Fintech. Melalui pemantauan yang intensify diharapkan proses perumusan kebijakan dapat lebih tepat dan antisipatif. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 27. Inovasi teknologi pada layanan jasa keuangan adalah sebuah keniscayaan. Bank Indonesia selaku Otoritas Moneter, SSK, dan Sistem Pembayaran akan senantiasa mendukung kehadiran dan sumbangsih Fintech bagi perekonomian Indonesia, serta berupaya untuk terus mendorong perkembangannya ke arah yang positif. 28. Sebagai penutup, kami mengajak kita semua untuk terus mempererat kolaborasi dan sinergi, agar industri keuangan dan pembayaran nasional dapat tumbuh secara sehat dan berdaya saing. Kami meyakini arus digitalisasi ekonomi ini dapat mendorong alokasi sumber daya yang lebih efisien, dan pada gilirannya memberikan manfaat yang lebih besar bagi masyarakat. Sekian dan terimakasih. Wassalammu'alaikum Warrahmatuiiahi Wabarakatuh. Agus D.W. Martowardojo Gubernur Bank Indonesia

Title: Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia, Agus D.W. Martowardojo "Pameran Kerajinan UMKM Binaan Bank Indonesia" pada pameran Karya Kreatif Indonesia, Jakarta, 26 Agustus 2016
text: "Karya Kreatif Indonesia - Exhibition of MSME Handicrafts Assisted by Bank Indonesia" Jakarta, 26th August 2016 Dear, 95 Mrs. Mufidah Jusuf Kalla 95 Merited Cooperatives and Small and Medium Enterprises, Mr. Anak Agung Gede Ngurah Puspayoga 95 Head of the Creative Economy Agency, Bp. Triawan Munaf 95 Senior Deputy Governor and Member of the Board of Governors of Bank Indonesia 95 Representatives of State Ministries and Institutions 95 National banking leaders 95 Administrators of Dekranas and Dekranasda 95 Representatives of academics, industry associations, and international institutions 95 Happy attendees and invitees Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh, Good morning and greetings to all of us, 1. First of all let us give thanks to the presence of Allah Almighty, God Almighty , because only with His permission can we gather this morning in a good atmosphere, for following the opening of "Karya Kreatif Indonesia - Exhibition of CRAFTS MSMEs Assisted by BI". 2. We are grateful and grateful that in this good atmosphere in the midst of us there has been a figure who has concern for the development of MSME crafts, Mrs. Mufidah Jusuf Kalla. As the Chairman of the National Crafts Council , he always pays high attention to increasing competitiveness and developing MSME resources. 3. This exhibition activity is one of the concrete manifestations of MSME development efforts by Bank Indonesia which aims to encourage the creation and development of new economic activities and preserve the cultural image of the region . This event is also an event to introduce the creative work of MSMEs assisted by Bank Indonesia to the public. Ladies and gentlemen and our esteemed audience, 4. The creation and development of new economic activity has become one of the focuses of our common attention. This effort is necessary considering that in recent years national economic growth has tended to slow down, which is partly due to the increasingly sluggish world economic conditions. 5. The emergence of new economic activities is expected to provide added value which in turn can maintain growth momentum and create jobs. This added value will also be able to increase the economic resilience of households which will contribute to efforts to maintain the sta bi litas of the financial system. 6. Efforts to create new economic activities can be carried out, among others, through the development of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) based on the creative economy. We want to underline two key sentences, namely the development of MSMEs, and the creative economy. 7. MSMEs have an important meaning for the economy. MSMEs are the pillars of the national economy because MSMEs are able to contribute 60.3% of gross domestic product, and absorb 97.0% of the total workforce. In addition, MSMEs have also become catalysts for economic recovery when economic conditions are under pressure, as happened in 1997-1998. 8. However, we realize that MSMEs still face challenges that are not light, such as limited capital, market access, and limited human resource skills. In the era of Free trade at this time, MSMEs must also compete with foreign products that have flooded Indonesia. 9. This condition needs to be a common concern and find a solution. Breakthroughs and creative ideas are needed that can increase competitiveness so that MSMEs can host in their own country, and can even be encouraged to compete abroad. 10. We welcome and express our appreciation to the Government, relevant authorities and agencies, as well as banks, for the various efforts that have been made to encourage the development of MSMEs. In particular, we also support and welcome the government's efforts and attention to the development of MSMEs based on the creative economy. Ladies and gentlemen and the audience we respect, 11. The creative economy is the future of Indonesia. Indonesia has a very potential creative industry and can still be developed in the future. One of the potentials that can be explored is the creative industry related to local culture and wisdom spread throughout the provinces in Indonesia. Cultural capital and local wisdom can be a source of creative industry strength that is not owned by other nations. 12. The creative industry also has a significant contribution to the economy. Statistical data show that in 2010 - 2013 the creative industry grew by 5.6% and had a contribution of 7.1% of GDP. In addition, the creative industry accounts for 6.1% of the export value, and absorbs 10.7% of the total labor force. 13. The results of a mapping analysis conducted by Bank Indonesia in collaboration with the World Bank in 2014 on five small-scale and micro-scale creative industry sectors found that almost all provinces in Indonesia have the potential of the handicraft and fashion industry, and both industrial sectors have higher competitiveness than other creative sectors. The results of the competitiveness analysis also show that the small and micro handicraft industry sector is able to create higher growth in production added value. 14. The huge potential of the handicraft industry sector further confirms that support for the development of the handicraft industry sector needs to be continued and improved. This in turn will be able to boost the tourism sector which currently contributes 10% of the national GDP. 15. However, we realize that on the other hand, the handicraft industry sector still faces obstacles. The survey results show that in general, handicraft industry business actors face three main obstacles, namely: a6 First, limited access to financing. Business actors have limited access to financing, among others, due to limited ability to compile financial reports and limited training for employees related to aspects of financial management. a6 Second, limited market access. Business actors do not yet have a clear target market and are only domestically oriented because they have limited production capabilities. a6 Third, the relatively limited skills of human resources. Business actors have limited skills and knowledge, and do not yet have a special division for research and development. This results in the element of creativity still not being utilized optimally and the production process tends to be carried out traditionally. Ladies and gentlemen and our esteemed audience, 16. Solving these challenges requires the commitment, support, and contribution of all parties. In this regard, Bank Indonesia as an institution mandated by law to carry out the functions, duties, and authorities of monetary policy, establish and implement macroprudential policies, as well as regulate and maintain the smooth running of the payment system and rupiah management, strives to always make the best contribution to the development and empowerment of UM KM. 17. The development and empowerment of MSMEs by Bank Indonesia is focused on two main strategies, namely encouraging the role of banking intermediation to MSMEs, and increasing the capacity of MSMEs. In addition, Bank Indonesia has also strengthened two enabler functions, namely minimizing information gaps, and improving coordination and cooperation with relevant stakeholders. 18. In line with this strategy, Bank Indonesia carries out various MSME capacity building programs such as development of production aspects, marketing and access to capital, including development of entrepreneurial capacity and financial management of MSMEs. 19. In relation to efforts to develop MSMEs and the creative industry, Bank Indonesia carries out the process of creating new economic activity centers, among others, through optimizing the potential of local resources and culture. This is done by developing cooperation between 45 Bank Indonesia Representative Offices and assisted MSMEs that produce traditional fabric products and other handicrafts. 20. For example, in the Sumatra region we develop woven fabrics, songket, jumputan and batik. In the Java region we develop weaving, batik, and embroidery. In the kalimantan and Balinusra Sulampua regions, development is carried out on the potential of local weaving and silk. In addition, karawo embroidery in Gorontalo, ulos weaving in North Sumatra, and Banyumas papringan batik, are examples of MSME development efforts that we have carried out as part of efforts to preserve Indonesia's cultural image. 21. As we said at the beginning, this exhibition event is an event to introduce the creative work of MSMEs assisted by Bank Indonesia to the public. We have made a selection so that the MSME handicraft products displayed have authentic / original value, have cultural value and raise the image of the region, and have high economic value. Ladies and gentlemen and our esteemed audience, 22. Concluding our remarks, let us on behalf of the Board of Governors of Bank Indonesia express our appreciation and gratitude to Mrs. Mufidah Jusuf Kalla, Minister of Cooperatives and SMEs, Head of the Creative Economy Agency, and invitees who have paid great attention to our activities today. 23. On this occasion, we respectfully request that mrs. Mufidah Jusuf Kalla be pleased to officially open this event. 24. Finally, by asking for the blessings of Allah SWT, Bank Indonesia with a sense of pride and joy presents "Karya Kreatif Indonesia - Exhibition of MSME Crafts Assisted by Bank Indonesia". May Allah Almighty always protect, bless and alleviate every step of our struggle to build the country and prosper the country. Thank you. Wassalamu'alaikum Wr. Wb Agus D.W. Martowardojo Governor of Bank Indonesia
text_original: Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia "Karya Kreatif Indonesia - Pameran Kerajinan UMKM Binaan Bank Indonesia" Jakarta, 26 Agustus 2016 Yang Terhormat, <95> Ibu Mufidah Jusuf Kalla <95> Merited Koperasi dan Usaha Kecil dan Menengah, Bp. Anak Agung Gede Ngurah Puspayoga <95> Kepala Badan Ekonomi Kreatif, Bp. Triawan Munaf <95> Deputi Gubernur Senior dan Anggota Dewan Gubernur Bank Indonesia <95> Perwakilan Kementerian dan Lembaga Negara <95> Pimpinan perbankan nasional <95> Pengurus Dekranas dan Dekranasda <95> Perwakilan akademisi, asosiasi industri, dan Lembaga internasional <95> Hadirin dan undangan yang berbahagia Assalamu'alaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh, Selamat pagi dan salam sejahtera bagi kita semua, 1. Pertama-tama marilah kita panjatkan puji syukur kehadirat Allah SWT, Tuhan Yang Maha Kuasa, karena hanya dengan perkenan-Nya kita dapat berkumpul pada pagi ini dalam suasana yang baik, untuk mengikuti pembukaan "Karya Kreatif Indonesia - Pameran Kerajinan UMKM Binaan BI". 2. Kami bersyukur dan terima kasih bahwa pada suasana yang baik ini di tengah tengah kita telah hadir seorang tokoh yang memiliki kepedulian terhadap pengembangan kerajinan UMKM, Ibu Mufidah Jusuf Kalla. Selaku Ketua Umum Dewan Kerajinan Nasional, beliau senantiasa menaruh perhatian yang tinggi terhadap peningkatan daya saing dan pengembangan sumberdaya UMKM. 3. Kegiatan pameran ini merupakan salah satu wujud kongkrit upaya pengembangan UMKM oleh Bank Indonesia yang bertujuan untuk mendorong penciptaan dan pengembangan kegiatan ekonomi baru serta melestarikan citra budaya daerah. Acara ini juga merupakan ajang untuk memperkenalkan karya kreatif UMKM binaan Bank Indonesia kepada masyarakat. Bapak/Ibu dan para hadirin yang kami muliakan, 4. Penciptaan dan pengembangan kegiatan ekonomi baru telah menjadi salah satu fokus perhatian kita bersama. Upaya tersebut diperlukan mengingat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional cenderung melambat, yang antara lain disebabkan oleh makin lesunya kondisi perekonomian dunia. 5. Munculnya kegiatan ekonomi baru diharapkan dapat memberikan nilai tambah yang pada gilirannya dapat menjaga momentum pertumbuhan dan menciptakan lapangan pekerjaan. Nilai tambah ini juga akan dapat meningkatkan ketahanan ekonomi rumah tangga yang akan berkontribusi pada upaya pemeliharaan sta bi litas sistem keuangan. 6. Upaya penciptaan aktivitas ekonomi baru dapat dilakukan antara lain melalui pengembangan Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM) berbasis ekonomi kreatif. Kami ingin menggarisbawahi dua kalimat kunci, yaitu pengembangan UMKM, dan ekonomi kreatif. 7. UMKM memiliki arti penting bagi perekonomian. UMKM adalah penopang ekonomi nasional karena UMKM mampu menyumbangkan kontribusi 60,3% dari Produk Domestik Bruto, dan menyerap 97,0% dari total tenaga kerja. Selain itu, UMKM juga telah menjadi katalis pemulihan ekonomi ketika kondisi perekonomian mengalami tekanan, seperti yang terjadi pada tahun 1997-1998. 8. Namun, kita menyadari bahwa UMKM masih menghadapi tantangan yang tidak ringan seperti keterbatasan permodalan, akses pasar, dan masih terbatasnya ketrampilan sumber daya manusia. Di era perdagangan bebas saat ini, UMKM juga harus bersaing dengan produk asing yang telah membanjiri Indonesia. 9. Kondisi ini perlu menjadi perhatian bersama dan dicarikan solusinya. Diperlukan terobosan dan ide kreatif yang dapat meningkatkan daya saing sehingga UMKM dapat menjadi tuan rumah di negeri sendiri, dan bahkan dapat didorong untuk bersaing di luar negeri. 10. Kami menyambut baik dan menyampaikan apresiasi kepada Pemerintah, otoritas dan instansi terkait, serta perbankan, atas berbagai upaya yang telah dilakukan untuk mendorong pengembangan UMKM. Secara khusus, kami juga mendukung dan menyambut baik upaya dan perhatian pemerintah terhadap pengembangan UMKM yang berbasis ekonomi kreatif. Bapak/Ibu dan para hadirin yang kami hormati, 11. Ekonomi kreatif adalah masa depan Indonesia. Indonesia memiliki industri kreatif yang sangat potensial dan masih dapat dikembangkan kedepannya. Salah satu potensi yang dapat digali adalah industri kreatif yang terkait dengan kebudayaan dan kearifan lokal yang tersebar di seluruh provinsi di Indonesia. Modal kebudayaan dan kearifan lokal tersebut dapat menjadi sumber kekuatan industri kreatif yang tidak dimiliki oleh bangsa lain. 12. Industri kreatif juga mempunyai kontribusi yang cukup signifikan terhadap perekonomian. Data statistik menunjukkan bahwa bahwa pada tahun 2010 - 2013 industri kreatif tumbuh 5,6% dan memiliki kontribusi 7,1% dari PDB. Selain itu, industri kreatif menyumbang 6,1% terhadap nilai ekspor, dan menyerap 10,7% dari total tenaga kerja. 13. Hasil analisis pemetaan yang dilakukan oleh Bank Indonesia bekerja sama dengan World Bank tahun 2014 terhadap lima sektor industri kreatif skala kecil dan mikro menemukan bahwa hampir semua provinsi di Indonesia memiliki potensi industri kerajinan dan fesyen, dan kedua sektor industri tersebut memiliki daya saing yang lebih tinggi dibanding sektor kreatif lainnya. Hasil analisis daya saing juga menunjukan bahwa sektor industri kerajinan ska la kecil dan mikro mampu menciptakan pertumbuhan nilai tambah produksi yang lebih tinggi. 14. Potensi sektor industri kerajinan yang besar ini semakin mengkonfirmasi bahwa dukungan terhadap pengembangan sektor industri kerajinan perlu dilanjutkan dan ditingkatkan. Hal ini pada gilirannya akan dapat mendorong sektor pariwisata yang saat ini telah menyumbangkan 10% dari PDB nasional. 15. Namun, kita menyadari bahwa di sisi lain, sektor industri kerajinan masih menghadapi kendala. Hasil survei menunjukkan bahwa secara umum pelaku usaha industri kerajinan menghadapi tiga kendala utama, yaitu: <a6> Pertama, terbatasnya akses pembiayaan. Pelaku usaha memiliki keterbatasan akses pembiayaan antara lain disebabkan oleh keterbatasan kemampuan dalam menyusun laporan keuangan dan terbatasnya pelatihan bagi karyawan terkait dengan aspek manajemen keuangan. <a6> Kedua, terbatasnya akses pasar. Pelaku usaha belum memiliki target pasar yang jelas dan hanya berorientasi domestik karena memiliki keterbatasan kemampuan produksi. <a6> Ketiga, relatif terbatasnya ketrampilan sumber daya manusia. Pelaku usaha memiliki keterbatasan ketrampilan dan pengetahuan, serta belum memiliki divisi khusus untuk riset dan pengembangan. Hal ini mengakibatkan unsur kreativitas masih belum dimanfaatkan secara optimal dan proses produksi cenderung dilakukan secara tradisional. Bapak/Ibu dan para hadirin yang kami muliakan, 16. Pemecahan atas tantangan tersebut memerlukan komitmen, dukungan, dan kontribusi semua pihak. Dalam hal ini, Bank Indonesia sebagai lembaga yang diberikan amanat oleh undang-undang untuk menjalankan fungsi, tugas, dan kewenangan menetapkan dan melaksanakan kebijakan moneter, menetapkan dan melaksanakan kebijakan makroprudensial, serta mengatur dan menjaga kelancaran sistem pembayaran dan pengelolaan uang rupiah, berupaya untuk senantiasa memberikan kontribusi yang terbaik bagi pengembangan dan pemberdayaan UM KM. 17. Pengembangan dan pemberdayaan UMKM oleh Bank Indonesia difokuskan pada dua strategi utama, yaitu mendorong peran intermediasi perbankan kepada UMKM, dan peningkatan kapasitas UMKM. Selain itu, Bank Indonesia juga memperkuat dua fungsi enabler, yaitu meminimalisir kesenjangan informasi, dan meningkatkan koordinasi dan kerjasama dengan stakeholders terkait. 18. Sejalan dengan strategi itu, Bank Indonesia melakukan berbagai program peningkatan kapasitas UMKM seperti pengembangan aspek produksi, pemasaran dan akses permodalan, termasuk pengembangan kapasitas kewirausahaan dan pengelolaan keuangan UMKM. 19. Terkait upaya pengembangan UMKM dan industri kreatif, Bank Indonesia melakukan proses penciptaan pusat aktivitas ekonomi baru, antara lain melalui optimalisasi potensi sumber daya dan budaya lokal. Hal ini dilakukan dengan mengembangkan kerjasama antara 45 Kantor Perwakilan Bank Indonesia dengan UMKM binaan yang menghasilkan produk kain tradisional dan kerajinan lainnya. 20. Sebagai contoh, di regional Sumatera kami mengembangkan kain tenun, songket, jumputan dan batik. Di regional Jawa kami mengembangkan tenun, batik, dan bordir. Di regional Kalimantan dan Balinusra Sulampua pengembangan dilakukan terhadap potensi tenun dan sutera setempat. Selain itu, sulam karawo di Gorontalo, tenun ulos di Sumatera Utara, dan batik papringan Banyumas, adalah contoh upaya pengembangan UMKM yang telah kami lakukan sebagai bagian dari upaya pelestarian citra budaya Indonesia. 21. Sebagaimana kami sampaikan di awal, acara pameran ini adalah ajang untuk memperkenalkan karya kreatif UMKM binaan Bank Indonesia kepada masyarakat. Kami telah melakukan seleksi sehingga produk- produk kerajinan UMKM yang ditampilkan memiliki nilai otentik/original, memiliki nilai budaya dan mengangkat citra daerah, serta memiliki nilai ekonomis yang tinggi. Bapak/Ibu dan para hadirin yang kami muliakan, 22. Mengakhiri sambutan kami, perkenankan kami atas nama Dewan Gubernur Bank Indonesia menyampaikan apresiasi dan terima kasih kepada Ibu Mufidah Jusuf Kalla, Menteri Koperasi dan UKM, Kepala Badan Ekonomi Kreatif, serta para undangan yang telah memberikan perhatian besar kepada kegiatan kami pada hari ini. 23. Pada kesempatan ini, kami mohon dengan hormat agar kiranya Ibu Mufidah Jusuf Kalla berkenan membuka secara resmi acara ini. 24. Akhir kata, dengan memohon ridho Allah SWT, Bank Indonesia dengan rasa bangga dan penuh suka cita mempersembahkan "Karya Kreatif Indonesia - Pameran Kerajinan UMKM Binaan Bank Indonesia". Semoga Allah SWT senantiasa melindungi, meridhoi dan meringankan setiap langkah perjuangan kita membangun negara dan memakmurkan negeri. Sekian dan terima kasih. Wassalamu'alaikum Wr. Wb Agus D.W. Martowardojo Gubernur Bank Indonesia

Title: Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia, Agus D.W. Martowardojo pada Launching Bank Indonesia Fintech Office, Jakarta, 14 November 2016
text: -Remarks by the Governor of Bank Indonesia- Launching Bank Indonesia Fintech Office Jakarta, 14th November 2016 What we respect: 95 Kepaia Creative Economy Agency, Mr. Triawan Munaf 95 Wakii Minister of Finance, Mr. Mardiasmo 95 Secretary of the Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs, Mr. Lukita Dinarsyah Tuwo 95 Gender Secretary of the Ministry of Trade, Mrs. Srie Agustina 95 Gender Secretary of the Ministry of Communications and Informatics, Mrs. Farida Dwi Cahyarini 95 Director General of Treasury of the Ministry of Finance, Bpk Marwanto Harjowiryono 95 Deputy Governors of Bank Indonesia 95 Deputy Commissioner of Non-Bank Financial Industry Supervisory of the Financial Services Authority, Mr. Du moly F. Pardede 95 Banking Industry Leaders and Associations 95 Investors of Venture Capital Firms 95 The Peiaku Fintech and Start-Up Activists 95 Ladies and Gentlemen, Happy audience Assaiammuaiaikum Wr. Wb. As early as Morning and Saiam Prosperous for all of us, 1. Praise and gratitude let us pray for the presence of God Almighty because only by His consent can we gather in good health in early today. We are happy because this morning we will jointly participate in the launching of the Bank Indonesia Fintech Office (BI-FTO). 2. With the presence of ministries, relevant authorities, and the banking industry, associations and investors, we believe that the various initiatives pursued together will be able to optimize the potential of rapid innovation in the financial sector in Indonesia. We also felt how the presence of Fintech players and Start-up activists at this event created an atmosphere of creativity and innovation that was very good. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 3. Society is currently undergoing major changes in its lifestyle. Through technological advances, especially internet penetration, people can instantly connect with each other. This then changed the way people communicated, worked, and transacted to spend their income. 4. In Indonesia itself, people have become so familiar and close to online shopping activities, or what is commonly referred to as e-commerce. Not surprisingly, when consumers can get their needs and services instantly, they also expect the same for access to financial services. 5. The hope of accessing financial services that are more affordable, fast, and easy, as well as personally connected to various activities of a person in cyberspace has become a demand that needs to be answered by penyedia modern financial services. 6. On the other hand, the global financial crisis that occurred in 2008 has shaken public confidence in the formal financial system. The incident was followed by a response by authorities that tightened the financial institutions' regulatory regime . The two of them then created a wide financing gap. 7. In the midst of these conditions, a Financial Technology (FinTech) company was born as an alternative solution to meet the community's needs for financial services. Armed with creative ideas and technological innovations, FinTech offers new options for consumers in carrying out payment activities, remittances, fund intermediation, and investments. 8. The impressive growth of FinTech in recent years also coincides with the era of the millennial generation who have grown up, making it a very potential market. This "tech-savvy" generation is also a little reluctant to deal with the rigidity that may be felt from formal financial institutions, thus further encouraging the growth of Fintech. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 9. With the breakthroughs that Fintech is trying to present, the real benefits are starting to be felt. Some activities that may have been a decade ago have not been thought of by consumers, saat this is already widely carried out. 10. Examples are payments that are sufficiently made via smartphones, access financing via online sites with peer to peer lending or crowdfunding schemes, and even get investment recommendations automatically via kecerdasan artificial {artificial intelligence}. 11. In Indonesia, of the four main categories of Fintech that we define, namely (1) payment, clearing, settlement, (2) deposit, lending, capital raising, (3) market provisioning, and (4) investment & risk management, pangsa Fintech activities in Indonesia in the year 2016 was dominated by 56O/O by the first group. Then, based on Statista data, in 2016 the value of Fintech transactions in Indonesia is estimated to have reached USD 14.5 billion.I 12. Therefore, Bank Indonesia, which by law of the Republic of Indonesia is assigned as the Payment System Authority take several initiatives to ensure that Fintech's growth trends can provide optimal benefits to society, not create turmoil in the financial system, and are always supported by an adequate regulatory framework. 13. This is also closely related to Bank Indonesia's concern to always maintain the effectiveness of monetary policy transactions and maintain financial system stability. Because the credibility of the entire financial system can be compromised if public trust is not maintained properly by Fintech which in fact carries out activities like banks or non-bank financial institutions. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 14. Bank Indonesia has closely followed and explored the development of technological innovation in financial services offered by Fintech. We have come to the conclusion that technological innovation is a necessity. With the rapid change in landscapes taking place, regulation should not try to preempt innovation. 15. But we believe that regulation needs to always be near innovation. While looking at the various potential risks that arise, a conducive business climate needs to be realized. In this regard, the establishment of BI-FTO is our effort to maintain the level of playing field through a balanced and proportionate regulatory regime without having to turn off the pace of innovation. 16. As a new task force positioned close to industry, there are 4 main functions that will be carried out by BI-FTO, namely: - First, is as a catalyst/facilitator for the exchange of innovative ideas for Fintech development in Indonesia. - Second, as business intelligence, where BI-FTO will regularly provide updates through dissemination of the results of studies and meetings including with relevant ministries and authorities and international institutions. - Third, is the assessment function. In this case, BI-FTO will monitor and map the potential benefits as well as risks of business model innovation and the products offered. The results of the assessment will be the basis for policy formulation at Bank Indonesia. - Fourth, is the coordination and communication function, which plays a role in providing an understanding of the existing regulatory framework, and encouraging cross-authority regulatory harmonization. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 17. As part of the assessment function carried out by BI-FTO, we also introduced an initiative called the Regulatory Sandbox. This initiative can be analogous to a laboratory that is shared by Fintech businesspeople and regulators to test business models and products/services before entering into licensing regime in full. 18. These tests are carried out in a limited environment to ensure the identification and mitigation of all risks that may arise. Therestrictions are granted in the form of limited licensing to the service, term, and/or area of operation. 19. Through the Regulatory Sandbox, regulators can intensively monitor the sustainability of Fintech within a maintained risk perimeter. Anotherse used for evaluation, it will also providing room for regulators to take anticipatory and corrective steps at the appropriate time if needed. 20. Furthermore, the data generated throughout the monitoring and mentoring process can be optimized to improve the quality of policy responses. Because in the midst of its exponential growth trend, data has become a major asset for regulators and industry players as a basis for decision making. 21. As BI-FTO will be implemented, we expect the network of Fintech players to be closer. By consistently improving the knowledge base of fintech processes and functions, we believe BI-FTO will be able to contribute to creating a healthy Fintech industry. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 22. Apart from the development of Fintech, which is a mirror of technological innovation in the financial area, Bank Indonesia also observes the strong technological innovation in the trading area. As we have mentioned before, the growth and adoption of e-commerce by the Indonesian people is extraordinary. The terminology "Market" as a meeting place for sellers and buyers today has been fully realized virtually. 23. Even though it no longer has to be done face-to-face physically, but the need for transactions through the payment system remains an integral part of buying and selling activities . Therefore , Bank Indonesia considers it necessary to complement theprovisions in the existing payment system area, especially complementing the provisions regarding Payment Instruments Using Cards (APMK), Electronic Money, and Fund Transfers that have been in place. 24. We issued Bank Indonesia Regulation on payment transaction processing (PBI No. 18/40/PBI/2016) as a form of our commitment to 4 main things, namely (1) Accommodating innovation; (2) Improve security, including compliance with standards and periodic security audits; (3) Maintain a level of playing field, and (4) Consumer protection, amid cyber security threats that are pursuing innovation. 25. This provision regulates two main subjects in a payment transaction processing activity, namely: - SP Service Provider, as the party responsible for the Authorization, Clearing, and Settlement stages. These parties are switching organizers, Payment Gateways, and Dorn pet Electronic (e-Wallet) is required to have permission from BI. - Payment Transaction Support Providers, such as card providers, ATMs, EDCs, and data centers. In this case, SP Service Providers need to seek cooperation approval and be responsible for ensuring the security and smooth processing of transactions facilitated by them. 26. In addition, in order to increase the resilience and competitiveness of the national payment system industry, this provision also regulates the ownership structure of payment system service providers. 27. In the end, we believe that the entire tour is in line with various initiatives across relevant Ministries and Authorities, especially with the e-Commerce Roadmap that has just been published as a Package Economic Policy Volume XIV on November 10, 2016. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 28. Bank Indonesia welcomes and supports the issuance of this e-Commerce Roadmap. This step is also in line with the Directive of the President of the Republic of Indonesia after a working visit to attend the G20 Conference in China in a Limited Meeting on 27 S2016 on digital economy development. 29. The President of the Republic of Indonesia sees the progress of the digital economy in China as extraordinary, and directed all relevant agencies, including Bank Indonesia, to be able to support the development of the digital economy in Indonesia. Furthermore, this support also needs to be given so that the Younger Generation of Indonesia who prepare Start-Up companies and various initiatives in the field of the digital economy can always be fully helped by us . 30. Therefore, the opportunity of this day is also a response of Bank Indonesia together with relevant ministries and authorities, for us to be able to support the development of the digital economy in Indonesia, including the business world , especially those on a small and medium scale. 31. We note that the Roadmap will be a comprehensive guideline for both regulators and industry. Starting from the aspects of funding, the quality of human resources, to aspects of consumer protection and infrastructure, it is the focus of discussion. Save us the issuance of a mat tepat time and right on target to support the growth of e-commerce and also Fintech in Indonesia. Ladies and Gentlemen, Ladies and Gentlemen whom we respect, 32. Armed with collaboration and the right regulatory support, we are optimistic that Fintech players can go hand in hand with the traditional financial institutions that existed first. Adaptations made by conventional financial institutions, as well as the joining of Fintech as part of the financial system we believe will encourage healthy competition and provide value add as well as alternatives for the community. 33. In that context, we also need to remind conventional financial institutions not to get stuck in a comfort zone. The tide of innovation came unstoppable and created increasingly intense competition. Only actors who have a solid and adaptive business model can grow sustainably in the future . 34. Closing our remarks, we hope that collaboration between actors and authorities, and between authorities can be closer and more productive, so that the positive development of Fintech and e-Commerce in Indonesia can continue retained. 35. In the inauguration procession of BI-FTO today, it will be shown symbolically how the seven Regulators accompanied by seven Fintech/Start-Up actors together build coordination and collaboration to support the development of the digital economy in Indonesia. 36. In addition, this event also facilitated meetings and opportunities for dialogue between Start-Up actors and investors. So that it can be followed carefully how the Start-Up profile is desired by investors, and how Start-Up actors can start building communication to investors in a good way. 37. Even Mr. President in the Limited Meeting as we mentioned earlier, asked specifically for all parties to be able to help guide start-ups. So that they are prepared, and there is no need to give up their investment too quickly. Then, at this event we also facilitated Start-Up Actors to be able to sit down together with regulators to discuss aspects of regulatory fulfillment from various relevant Ministries and Authorities. 38. Hopefully, all these efforts will give a message, that newly established businesses do not need to continue to be small businesses. Within a period of 10 to 15 years, these efforts can be a big undertaking. Bank Indonesia together with the relevant regulators are committed and want to see the Young Generation of Indonesia rise, and we will provide the necessary support and assistance. 39. With joint synergy to increase efficiency, encourage inclusion, and foster innovation, the digital revolution will undoubtedly be able to bring out all its real potential for a better and prosperous life for the better and prosperous indonesian people. That's it and Thank you Wassalammu'alaikum Warrahmatullahi Wabarakatuh. Agus D.W. Martowardojo Governor of Bank Indonesia I Bank Indonesia Data - Payment System Policy Department --------------- ------------------------------------------------------------ --------------- ------------------------------------------------------------
text_original: -Sambutan Gubernur Bank Indonesia- Launching Bank Indonesia Fintech Office Jakarta, 14 November 2016 Yang kami hormati: <95> Kepaia Badan Ekonomi Kreatif, Bpk. Triawan Munaf <95> Wakii Menteri Keuangan, Bpk. Mardiasmo <95> Sekretaris Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Perekonomian, Bpk. Lukita Dinarsyah Tuwo <95> Sekretaris Jenderai Kementerian Perdagangan, Ibu Srie Agustina <95> Sekretaris Jenderai Kementerian Komunikasi dan Informatika, Ibu Farida Dwi Cahyarini <95> Dirjen Perbendaharaan Kementerian Keuangan, Bpk Marwanto Harjowiryono <95> Para Deputi Gubernur Bank Indonesia <95> Deputi Komisioner Pengawas Industri Keuangan Non Bank OtoritasJasa Keuangan, Bpk. Du moly F. Pardede <95> Para Pimpinan Industri Perbankan dan Asosiasi <95> Para Investor dari Perusahaan Modal Ventura <95> Para Peiaku Fintech dan Penggiat Start-Up <95> Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin sekaiian yang berbahagia Assaiammuaiaikum Wr. Wb. Seiamat Pagi dan Saiam Sejahtera bagi kita semua, 1. Puji dan syukur marilah kita panjatkan kehadirat Tuhan YME karena hanya atas perkenan-Nya kita bisa berkumpul dalam kondisi sehat di pagi hari ini. Kami berbahagia karena pada pagi ini kita akan bersama mengikuti acara launching Bank Indonesia Fintech Office (BI-FTO). 2. Dengan turut hadirnya kementerian, otoritas terkait, dan industri perbankan, asosiasi serta para investor, kami meyakini berbagai inisiatif yang diupayakan bersama akan mampu mengoptimalkan potensi dari pesatnya inovasi pada sektor keuangan di Indonesia. Kami juga merasakan bagaimana kehadiran dari para pelaku Fintech serta penggiat Start-up di acara ini menciptakan atmosfir kreativitas dan inovasi yang sangat baik. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 3. Masyarakat saat ini tengah mengalami perubahan besar dalam pola hidupnya. Melalui kemajuan teknologi, khususnya penetrasi internet, masyarakat dapat secara instan terhubung satu dengan yang lain. Ini kemudian mengubah cara masyarakat dalam berkomunikasi, bekerja, dan bertransaksi membelanjakan pendapatannya. 4. Di Indonesia sendiri, masyarakat telah begitu akrab dan dekat dengan aktivitas belanja online, atau yang umum disebut sebagai e- commerce. Tidak mengherankan, ketika konsumen bisa mendapatkan kebutuhan ba rang dan jasa secara instan, mereka juga mengharapkan hal yang sama untuk akses layanan keuangan. 5. Harapan akan akses layanan keuangan yang lebih terjangkau, cepat, dan mudah, serta secara personal terhubung dengan berbagai aktivitas seseorang di dunia maya telah menjadi tuntutan yang perlu dijawab oleh penyedia layanan jasa keuangan modern. 6. Di sisi lain, krisis keuangan global yang terjadi pada tahun 2008 silam telah mengguncang kepercayaan masyarakat akan sistem keuangan formal. Peristiwa itu jg diikuti dengan respons otoritas yang memperketat rezim pengaturan lembaga keuangan. Korn bi nasi keduanya kemudian menciptakan financing gap yang lebar. 7. Ditengah kondisi tersebut, lahirlah perusahaan Financial Technology (FinTech) sebagai solusi alternatif untuk memenuhi kebutuhan masyarakat akan layanan jasa keuangan. Berbekal ide kreatif dan inovasi teknologi, FinTech menawarkan pilihan baru bagi konsumen dalam melakukan aktivitas pembayaran, pengiriman uang, intermediasi dana, dan investasi. 8. Pertumbuhan FinTech yang begitu mengesankan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir juga bertepatan dengan era generasi millenial yang telah beranjak dewasa, sehingga menjadi pasar yang amat potensial. Generasi "melek teknologi" ini juga sedikit enggan berhadapan dengan kekakuan yang mungkin dirasakan dari lembaga keuangan formal, sehingga semakin mendorong pertumbuhan Fintech. Bapak/Ibu, Hadirin yang kami hormati, 9. Dengan terobosan yang coba dihadirkan oleh Fintech, manfaat nyata mulai dirasakan. Beberapa aktivitas yang mungkin satu dekade lalu belum terfikirkan oleh konsumen, saat ini sudah marak dilakukan. 10. Contohnya ialah pembayaran yang cukup dilakukan via smartphone, mengakses pembiayaan via situs online dengan skema peer to peer lending atau crowdfunding, dan bahkan mendapatkan rekomendasi investasi secara otomatis via kecerdasan buatan {artificial intelligence}. 11. Di Indonesia, dari empat kategori utama Fintech yang kami definisikan, yaitu (1) payment, clearing, settlement, (2) deposit, lending, capital raising, (3) market provisioning, serta (4) investment & risk management, pangsa aktivitas Fintech di Indonesia pada tahun 2016 didominasi sebesar 56O/OI oleh kelompok pertama. Kemudian, berdasarkan data Statista, pada tahun 2016 nilai transaksi Fintech di Indonesia diperkirakan telah menembus angka USD 14,5 Miliar. 12. Oleh karena itu, Bank Indonesia yang oleh Undang-Undang Negara Republik Indonesia ditugaskan selaku Otoritas Sistem Pembayaran mengambil beberapa inisiatif guna memastikan tren pertumbuhan Fintech dapat memberi manfaat yang optimal bagi masyarakat, tidak menciptakan gejolak pada sistem keuangan, dan senantiasa didukung kerangka pengaturan yang memadai. 13. Hal ini juga erat kaitannya dengan concern Bank Indonesia untuk senantiasa menjaga efektivitas transimisi kebijakan moneter dan memelihara stabilitas sistem keuangan. Karena kredibilitas seluruh sistem keuangan dapat terganggu apabila kepercayaan masyarakat tidak dijaga dengan baik oleh Fintech yang notabene melakukan aktivitas layaknya bank atau lembaga keuangan non-bank.
